 /* ============================================================
   BLOQUE 15: DISTRIBUCIÓN FINAL STOCK / MINA / SRR

   Prioridad:
   1. Origen oficial desde mov_cam.
   2. IMP provisional:
      - SRR = Es_SRR = 1
      - Camiones = STOCK
      - MINA = 0
   3. Sin origen: proporciones en cero.

   IMPORTANTE:
   IMP no reemplaza Apilado_TMS_Real.
   Solo determina las proporciones de origen.
   ============================================================ */

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #imp_origen_turno;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #origen_apilado;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   15A. Consolidación IMP por Fecha + Turno
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

SELECT
    CAST(i.Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

    CASE
        WHEN i.Turno IN ('TA', 'A') THEN 'A'
        WHEN i.Turno IN ('TB', 'B') THEN 'B'
        ELSE i.Turno
    END COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS Turno,

    CAST
    (
        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(i.Es_SRR, 0) = 1
                    THEN ISNULL(i.Ton, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        AS decimal(38,10)
    ) AS Ton_IMP_SRR,

    CAST
    (
        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(i.Es_SRR, 0) = 0
                 AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(i.Tipo_Registro, ''))))
                     = 'CAMION'
                    THEN ISNULL(i.Ton, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        AS decimal(38,10)
    ) AS Ton_IMP_Camiones,

		  CAST
    (
        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(i.Es_SRR, 0) = 0
                 AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(i.Tipo_Registro, ''))))
                     = 'MINA'
                    THEN ISNULL(i.Ton, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        AS decimal(38,10)
    ) AS Ton_IMP_mina,

    CAST
    (
        SUM(ISNULL(i.Ton, 0))
        AS decimal(38,10)
    ) AS Ton_IMP_Total

INTO #imp_origen_turno

FROM DEV_SIIR.hidro.v_imp_chancado_normalizado AS i

WHERE i.Fecha >= @fecha_inicio
  AND i.Fecha <  @fecha_fin
  AND ISNULL(i.Ton, 0) > 0

GROUP BY
    CAST(i.Fecha AS date),

    CASE
        WHEN i.Turno IN ('TA', 'A') THEN 'A'
        WHEN i.Turno IN ('TB', 'B') THEN 'B'
        ELSE i.Turno
    END COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT;


CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_imp_origen_turno
ON #imp_origen_turno (Fecha, Turno);


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   15B. Determinación de la fuente de origen
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

;WITH origen_base AS
(
    SELECT
        r.Fecha,
        r.Turno,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(r.Apilado_TMS_Real, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Apilado_TMS_Real,

        /* Fuente oficial */

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(p.Ton_Stock_Camiones, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Ton_Stock_Oficial,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(p.Ton_Mina_Camiones, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Ton_Mina_Oficial,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(p.Ton_SRR, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Ton_SRR_Oficial,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(p.Prop_Stock_Camiones, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Prop_Stock_Oficial,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(p.Prop_Mina_Camiones, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Prop_Mina_Oficial,

        /* Fuente IMP */

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(i.Ton_IMP_SRR, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Ton_IMP_SRR,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(i.Ton_IMP_Camiones, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Ton_IMP_Camiones,

				CAST
        (
            ISNULL(i.Ton_IMP_mina, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Ton_IMP_mina,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(i.Ton_IMP_Total, 0)
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Ton_IMP_Total,

        c.Fuente_Dato,

        CASE
            /* Prioridad 1: origen oficial positivo */

            WHEN ISNULL(p.Ton_Stock_Camiones, 0) > 0
              OR ISNULL(p.Ton_Mina_Camiones, 0) > 0
              OR ISNULL(p.Ton_SRR, 0) > 0
                THEN 'OFICIAL'

            /* Prioridad 2: respaldo provisional IMP */

            WHEN UPPER
                 (
                     LTRIM
                     (
                         RTRIM
                         (
                             ISNULL(c.Fuente_Dato, '')
                         )
                     )
                 ) = 'IMP'
             AND ISNULL(i.Ton_IMP_Total, 0) > 0
                THEN 'IMP'

            ELSE 'SIN_ORIGEN'
        END AS Fuente_Origen

    FROM #reales AS r

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_base_mina_stock_srr AS p
        ON p.Fecha = r.Fecha
       AND p.Turno = r.Turno

    LEFT JOIN #imp_origen_turno AS i
        ON i.Fecha = r.Fecha
       AND i.Turno = r.Turno

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_conciliacion_chancado_v2 AS c
        ON c.Fecha = r.Fecha
       AND c.Turno = r.Turno
),

origen_srr AS
(
    SELECT
        b.*,

        /* SRR limitado al Apilado_TMS_Real */

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN b.Apilado_TMS_Real <= 0
                    THEN 0

                WHEN b.Fuente_Origen = 'OFICIAL'
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN b.Ton_SRR_Oficial <= 0
                                THEN 0

                            WHEN b.Ton_SRR_Oficial
                               > b.Apilado_TMS_Real
                                THEN b.Apilado_TMS_Real

                            ELSE b.Ton_SRR_Oficial
                        END

                WHEN b.Fuente_Origen = 'IMP'
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN b.Ton_IMP_SRR <= 0
                                THEN 0

                            WHEN b.Ton_IMP_SRR
                               > b.Apilado_TMS_Real
                                THEN b.Apilado_TMS_Real

                            ELSE b.Ton_IMP_SRR
                        END

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Ton_SRR_Usado,

        /* Proporción de camiones STOCK */

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fuente_Origen = 'OFICIAL'
                    THEN b.Prop_Stock_Oficial

                WHEN b.Fuente_Origen = 'IMP'
                 AND b.Ton_IMP_Camiones > 0
                    THEN (b.Ton_IMP_Camiones/(b.Ton_IMP_Total-b.Ton_IMP_SRR))

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Prop_Stock_Camiones_Usada,

        /* Proporción de camiones MINA */

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fuente_Origen = 'OFICIAL'
                    THEN b.Prop_Mina_Oficial

                WHEN b.Fuente_Origen = 'IMP'
                    AND b.Ton_IMP_mina > 0
                    THEN (b.Ton_IMP_mina/(b.Ton_IMP_Total-b.Ton_IMP_SRR))

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS decimal(38,10)
        ) AS Prop_Mina_Camiones_Usada

    FROM origen_base AS b
),

origen_calculado AS
(
    SELECT
        s.*,

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN s.Apilado_TMS_Real <= 0
                    THEN 0

                ELSE

									((s.Apilado_TMS_Real- s.Ton_SRR_Usado)*
										s.Prop_Stock_Camiones_Usada)/s.Apilado_TMS_Real

            END
            AS decimal(18,8)
        ) AS Prop_Final_Stock,

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN s.Apilado_TMS_Real <= 0
                    THEN 0

                ELSE
								((s.Apilado_TMS_Real- s.Ton_SRR_Usado)*
										s.Prop_Mina_Camiones_Usada)/s.Apilado_TMS_Real


            END
            AS decimal(18,8)
        ) AS Prop_Final_Mina,

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN s.Apilado_TMS_Real <= 0
                    THEN 0

                ELSE
                    s.Ton_SRR_Usado
                    / NULLIF(s.Apilado_TMS_Real, 0)
            END
            AS decimal(18,8)
        ) AS Prop_Final_SRR

    FROM origen_srr AS s
)

SELECT
    o.Fecha,
    o.Turno,

    o.Prop_Final_Stock,
    o.Prop_Final_Mina,
    o.Prop_Final_SRR,

    CAST
    (
        o.Prop_Final_Stock
      + o.Prop_Final_Mina
      + o.Prop_Final_SRR
        AS decimal(18,8)
    ) AS Prop_Final_Total,

    /* Diferencia de tonelaje contra TMS real */

    CAST
    (
        (
            (
                o.Apilado_TMS_Real
              - o.Ton_SRR_Usado
            )
            * o.Prop_Stock_Camiones_Usada
        )
      + (
            (
                o.Apilado_TMS_Real
              - o.Ton_SRR_Usado
            )
            * o.Prop_Mina_Camiones_Usada
        )
      + o.Ton_SRR_Usado
      - o.Apilado_TMS_Real

        AS decimal(18,8)
    ) AS Check_Distribucion_Apilado,

    /* Columnas de auditoría */

    o.Fuente_Origen,
    o.Ton_SRR_Usado,
    o.Ton_IMP_SRR,
    o.Ton_IMP_Camiones,
    o.Ton_Stock_Oficial,
    o.Ton_Mina_Oficial,
    o.Ton_SRR_Oficial

INTO #origen_apilado

FROM origen_calculado AS o;


CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_origen_apilado
ON #origen_apilado (Fecha, Turno);

/* ============================================================
   SELECT FINAL - ORDEN FORMATO BHP
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
    r.Fecha,
    cm.Campania,
    cm.Material,
    cm.Modulo,
    cm.Avance,
    r.Turno,

    /* Apilado */
    r.Apilado_TMS_Real,
    pm.Apilado_TMS_Plan_Mensual,

    /* Distribución de origen */
    CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(oa.Prop_Final_Stock, 0) AS decimal(18, 2)) AS STOCK,
    CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(oa.Prop_Final_Mina, 0) AS decimal(18, 2)) AS MINA,
    CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(oa.Prop_Final_SRR, 0) AS decimal(18, 2)) AS SRR,

    /* Análisis químicos */
    r.CuT_Real,
    pm.CuT_Plan_Mensual,
    ps.CuT_Plan_Semanal,

    r.CuS_Real,
    pm.CuS_Plan_Mensual,
    ps.CuS_Plan_Semanal,

    r.Solubilidad_Real,
    pm.Solubilidad_Plan_Mensual,
    ps.Solubilidad_Plan_Semanal,

    r.CO3_Real,
    pm.CO3_Plan_Mensual,
    ps.CO3_Plan_Semanal,

    r.CuFe_Real,
    pm.CuFe_Plan_Mensual,
    ps.CuFe_Plan_Semanal,

    r.FeT_Real,
    r.FeS_Real,

    /* Dosis / consumo ácido */
    r.ConsH_Real,

    /* Granulometrías */
    r.Malla_Menos_1_2_Real,
    ps.Malla_Menos_1_2_Plan_Semanal,

    r.Malla_Menos_100_Real,
    pm.Malla_Menos_100_Plan_Mensual,
    ps.Malla_Menos_100_Plan_Semanal,

 /* NIR */
r.CaolBeta_Real,
pm.CaolBeta_Plan_Mensual,
ps.CaolBeta_Plan_Semanal,

/* Dosis de ácido */
CAST(
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(r.Solubilidad_Real, 0) < 0.25 THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(r.CO3_Real, 0) <= 0.25
                        THEN 14.0
                    ELSE 11.0 + (15.51 * ISNULL(r.CO3_Real, 0))
                END

            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN r.CuS_Real IS NULL OR r.CuS_Real <= 0
                        THEN 0.0
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN (8.182 * LOG(r.CuS_Real))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(r.CO3_Real, 0)) < 14.0
                                THEN 14.0
                            ELSE (8.182 * LOG(r.CuS_Real))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(r.CO3_Real, 0))
                        END
                END
        END
    , 2)
AS decimal(18, 2)) AS Dosis_Acido_Ideal_TM,

CAST(
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(ps.Solubilidad_Plan_Semanal, 0) < 0.25 THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(ps.CO3_Plan_Semanal, 0) <= 0.25
                        THEN 14.0
                    ELSE 11.0 + (15.51 * ISNULL(ps.CO3_Plan_Semanal, 0))
                END

            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN ps.CuS_Plan_Semanal IS NULL OR ps.CuS_Plan_Semanal <= 0
                        THEN 0.0
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN (8.182 * LOG(ps.CuS_Plan_Semanal))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(ps.CO3_Plan_Semanal, 0)) < 14.0
                                THEN 14.0
                            ELSE (8.182 * LOG(ps.CuS_Plan_Semanal))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(ps.CO3_Plan_Semanal, 0))
                        END
                END
        END
    , 2)
AS decimal(18, 2)) AS Dosis_Acido_Programa_Semanal,

        /* Fuentes de información explícitas */
    CASE
        WHEN r.Apilado_TMS_Real IS NULL
          OR r.Apilado_TMS_Real = 0
            THEN '-'
        ELSE COALESCE(fi.Fuente_Info_Quimica, '-')
    END AS Fuente_Info_Quimica,

    CASE
        WHEN r.Apilado_TMS_Real IS NULL
          OR r.Apilado_TMS_Real = 0
            THEN '-'
        ELSE COALESCE(fi.Fuente_Info_Fisica, '-')
    END AS Fuente_Info_Fisica,

    /* Clasificación técnica original */
    CASE
        WHEN r.Apilado_TMS_Real IS NULL
          OR r.Apilado_TMS_Real = 0
            THEN NULL
        ELSE m.Muestra_Quimica
    END AS Muestra_Quimica,

    CASE
        WHEN r.Apilado_TMS_Real IS NULL
          OR r.Apilado_TMS_Real = 0
            THEN NULL
        ELSE m.Muestra_Fisica
    END AS Muestra_Fisica

FROM #reales r

LEFT JOIN #muestras m
    ON m.Fecha = r.Fecha
   AND m.Turno = r.Turno

LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_turno_fuentes_info_test fi
    ON fi.Fecha = r.Fecha
   AND fi.Turno = r.Turno

LEFT JOIN #campania_modulo cm
    ON cm.Fecha = r.Fecha

LEFT JOIN #origen_apilado oa
    ON oa.Fecha = r.Fecha
   AND oa.Turno = r.Turno

LEFT JOIN #plan_mensual pm
    ON pm.Fecha = r.Fecha

LEFT JOIN #plan_semanal ps
    ON ps.Fecha = r.Fecha

ORDER BY
    r.Fecha,
    r.Turno;
END

name: v_reporte_turno_fuentes_info_test
definition:
CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_turno_fuentes_info_test
AS

WITH fuentes AS
(
    /* ========================================================
       FUENTES QUÍMICAS: TORRES
       ======================================================== */

    SELECT
        l.Fecha,
        l.Turno,
        'QUIMICA' AS Tipo_Muestra,

        CASE
            WHEN l.TM = 'TM1'
             AND
             (
                    l.Fuente_CuT   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_CuS   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_FeT   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_FeS   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_CO3   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_ConsH LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_FeS   LIKE '%ARRASTRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_ConsH LIKE '%ARRASTRE%'
             )
                THEN 'T1'

            WHEN l.TM = 'TM2'
             AND
             (
                    l.Fuente_CuT   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_CuS   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_FeT   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_FeS   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_CO3   LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_ConsH LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_FeS   LIKE '%ARRASTRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_ConsH LIKE '%ARRASTRE%'
             )
                THEN 'T2'
        END AS Fuente_Info

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l

    /* ========================================================
       FUENTES QUÍMICAS: MINA / MB
       ======================================================== */

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        l.Fecha,
        l.Turno,
        'QUIMICA' AS Tipo_Muestra,
        'MB' AS Fuente_Info

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l

    WHERE
           l.Fuente_CuT LIKE '%MINA%'
        OR l.Fuente_CuS LIKE '%MINA%'
        OR l.Fuente_FeT LIKE '%MINA%'
        OR l.Fuente_CO3 LIKE '%MINA%'
        OR l.Fuente_CuT LIKE '%MB%'
        OR l.Fuente_CuS LIKE '%MB%'
        OR l.Fuente_FeT LIKE '%MB%'
        OR l.Fuente_CO3 LIKE '%MB%'

    /* ========================================================
       FUENTES QUÍMICAS: IMP
       ======================================================== */

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        l.Fecha,
        l.Turno,
        'QUIMICA' AS Tipo_Muestra,
        'IMP' AS Fuente_Info

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l

    WHERE
           l.Fuente_CuT = 'IMP'
        OR l.Fuente_CuS = 'IMP'
        OR l.Fuente_FeT = 'IMP'
        OR l.Fuente_CO3 = 'IMP'

    /* ========================================================
       FUENTES FÍSICAS: TORRES
       ======================================================== */

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        l.Fecha,
        l.Turno,
        'FISICA' AS Tipo_Muestra,

        CASE
            WHEN l.TM = 'TM1'
             AND
             (
                    l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_1_2 LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_100 LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_1_2 LIKE '%ARRASTRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_100 LIKE '%ARRASTRE%'
             )
                THEN 'T1'

            WHEN l.TM = 'TM2'
             AND
             (
                    l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_1_2 LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_100 LIKE '%TORRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_1_2 LIKE '%ARRASTRE%'
                 OR l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_100 LIKE '%ARRASTRE%'
             )
                THEN 'T2'
        END AS Fuente_Info

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l

    /* ========================================================
       FUENTES FÍSICAS: MINA / MB
       ======================================================== */

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        l.Fecha,
        l.Turno,
        'FISICA' AS Tipo_Muestra,
        'MB' AS Fuente_Info

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l

    WHERE
           l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_100 LIKE '%MINA%'
        OR l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_100 LIKE '%MB%'

    /* ========================================================
       FUENTES FÍSICAS: IMP
       ======================================================== */

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        l.Fecha,
        l.Turno,
        'FISICA' AS Tipo_Muestra,
        'IMP' AS Fuente_Info

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l

    WHERE l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_100 = 'IMP'
),

fuentes_limpias AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        Tipo_Muestra,
        Fuente_Info

    FROM fuentes

    WHERE Fuente_Info IS NOT NULL
),

fuentes_agrupadas AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        Tipo_Muestra,

        STRING_AGG(Fuente_Info, '; ')
        WITHIN GROUP
        (
            ORDER BY
                CASE Fuente_Info
                    WHEN 'T1'  THEN 1
                    WHEN 'T2'  THEN 2
                    WHEN 'MB'  THEN 3
                    WHEN 'IMP' THEN 4
                    ELSE 9
                END
        ) AS Fuente_Info_Detalle

    FROM fuentes_limpias

    GROUP BY
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        Tipo_Muestra
)

SELECT
    Fecha,
    Turno,

    MAX
    (
        CASE
            WHEN Tipo_Muestra = 'QUIMICA'
                THEN Fuente_Info_Detalle
        END
    ) AS Fuente_Info_Quimica,

    MAX
    (
        CASE
            WHEN Tipo_Muestra = 'FISICA'
                THEN Fuente_Info_Detalle
        END
    ) AS Fuente_Info_Fisica

FROM fuentes_agrupadas

GROUP BY
    Fecha,
    Turno;

name: sp_m6_aplicar_aportes
definition:
-- Auxiliar interno: opera exclusivamente sobre temporales del SP modelo6.
-- No consultar directamente; no escribe mediciones ni devuelve resultsets.
CREATE   PROCEDURE inventar_SpcHidr.sp_m6_aplicar_aportes
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#m6_manual') IS NULL
        THROW 51009, 'Este auxiliar requiere el contexto del SP modelo 6.', 1;
    -- Normalizar componentes F0 antes de aplicar aportes y leer dependencias.
    -- No reemplazar valores presentes ni convertir otros flujos a cero.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#m6_f0') IS NOT NULL
        UPDATE r SET Tonelaje=COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0), Ley_Cu=COALESCE(r.Ley_Cu,0)
        FROM #flujos_resultado r JOIN #m6_fuentes f ON f.origen=r.codigo_flujo
        JOIN #m6_f0 z ON z.destino=f.destino;
    DECLARE @listos TABLE(destino varchar(10) PRIMARY KEY);
    INSERT @listos
    SELECT m.destino FROM #m6_mapa m
    JOIN #m6_manual a ON a.destino=m.destino AND a.aplicado=0
    JOIN #m6_fuentes f ON f.destino=m.destino
    JOIN #flujos_resultado r ON r.codigo_flujo=f.origen
    WHERE m.habilitado=1
    GROUP BY m.destino,m.componentes
    HAVING COUNT(*)=m.componentes;

    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @listos l JOIN #m6_fuentes f ON f.destino=l.destino
              JOIN #flujos_resultado r ON r.codigo_flujo=f.origen
              WHERE r.Tonelaje IS NULL OR r.Ley_Cu IS NULL)
        THROW 51010, 'No se puede sumar un aporte a una base desconocida.', 1;

    -- En un agregado, repartir masa y fino por |masa base|. Si todas son cero,
    -- repartir en partes iguales. Esto conserva el aporte total y permite que
    -- cada consulta dependiente lea ya corregidos sus componentes históricos.
    -- El último componente absorbe residuos de redondeo a seis decimales.
    ;WITH bases AS (
        SELECT f.destino,f.origen,r.Tonelaje,r.Ley_Cu,a.masa,a.fino,
            SUM(ABS(r.Tonelaje)) OVER(PARTITION BY f.destino) AS peso,
            COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY f.destino) AS cantidad,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY f.destino ORDER BY f.origen) AS rn
        FROM @listos l JOIN #m6_fuentes f ON f.destino=l.destino
        JOIN #m6_manual a ON a.destino=l.destino
        JOIN #flujos_resultado r ON r.codigo_flujo=f.origen
        WHERE a.masa<>0 OR a.fino<>0
    ), cuotas AS (
        SELECT *,CONVERT(decimal(18,6),masa *
            CASE WHEN peso=0 THEN 1.0/cantidad ELSE ABS(Tonelaje)/peso END) AS dm,
            CONVERT(decimal(18,6),fino *
            CASE WHEN peso=0 THEN 1.0/cantidad ELSE ABS(Tonelaje)/peso END) AS df
        FROM bases
    ), ajustes AS (
        SELECT *,CASE WHEN rn=cantidad
            THEN masa-SUM(CASE WHEN rn<cantidad THEN dm ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY destino)
            ELSE dm END AS delta_masa,
            CASE WHEN rn=cantidad
            THEN fino-SUM(CASE WHEN rn<cantidad THEN df ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY destino)
            ELSE df END AS delta_fino
        FROM cuotas
    )
    SELECT origen,Tonelaje+delta_masa AS masa_nueva,
           Tonelaje*Ley_Cu/100.0+delta_fino AS fino_nuevo
    INTO #m6_ajuste_actual FROM ajustes;

    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m6_ajuste_actual WHERE masa_nueva=0 AND ABS(fino_nuevo)>0.000001)
        THROW 51011, 'Un aporte deja masa cero y fino no nulo; revisar masa/ley del aporte.', 1;
    UPDATE r SET Tonelaje=a.masa_nueva,
        Ley_Cu=CASE WHEN a.masa_nueva=0 THEN 0 ELSE a.fino_nuevo*100.0/a.masa_nueva END
    FROM #flujos_resultado r JOIN #m6_ajuste_actual a ON a.origen=r.codigo_flujo;
    -- No acotar inventarios negativos ni sustituir la medición por el aporte.
    UPDATE a SET aplicado=1 FROM #m6_manual a JOIN @listos l ON l.destino=a.destino;
END;

name: sp_actualizar_reporte_turno_cache_emision_test
definition:
/* ============================================================================
   ACTUALIZADOR DE LA CACHÉ GEMELA
   ============================================================================ */
CREATE   PROCEDURE
    [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_actualizar_reporte_turno_cache_emision_test]
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin    date
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @fecha_inicio IS NULL OR @fecha_fin IS NULL
        THROW 51010, 'Debe informar @fecha_inicio y @fecha_fin.', 1;

    IF @fecha_inicio >= @fecha_fin
        THROW 51011, '@fecha_fin debe ser posterior a @fecha_inicio.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        DELETE FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[reporte_turno_cache_emision_test]
        WHERE Fecha >= @fecha_inicio
          AND Fecha <  @fecha_fin;

        INSERT INTO [inventar_SpcHidr].[reporte_turno_cache_emision_test]
        (
            Fecha,
            Campania,
            Material,
            Modulo,
            Avance,
            Turno,
            Apilado_TMS_Real,
            Apilado_TMS_Plan_Mensual,
            STOCK,
            MINA,
            SRR,
            CuT_Real,
            CuT_Plan_Mensual,
            CuT_Plan_Semanal,
            CuS_Real,
            CuS_Plan_Mensual,
            CuS_Plan_Semanal,
            Solubilidad_Real,
            Solubilidad_Plan_Mensual,
            Solubilidad_Plan_Semanal,
            CO3_Real,
            CO3_Plan_Mensual,
            CO3_Plan_Semanal,
            CuFe_Real,
            CuFe_Plan_Mensual,
            CuFe_Plan_Semanal,
            FeT_Real,
            FeS_Real,
            ConsH_Real,
            Malla_Menos_1_2_Real,
            Malla_Menos_1_2_Plan_Semanal,
            Malla_Menos_100_Real,
            Malla_Menos_100_Plan_Mensual,
            Malla_Menos_100_Plan_Semanal,
            CaolBeta_Real,
            CaolBeta_Plan_Mensual,
            CaolBeta_Plan_Semanal,
            Dosis_Acido_Ideal_TM,
            Dosis_Acido_Programa_Semanal,
            Fuente_Info_Quimica,
            Fuente_Info_Fisica,
            Muestra_Quimica,
            Muestra_Fisica
        )
        EXEC [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_reporte_turno_emision_test]
            @fecha_inicio = @fecha_inicio,
            @fecha_fin    = @fecha_fin;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

name: fn_generador_reporte_diario_emision_test
definition:
CREATE   FUNCTION
    [inventar_SpcHidr].[fn_generador_reporte_diario_emision_test]
(
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin    date
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    WITH base_turno AS
    (
        SELECT
            Fecha,
            Turno,

            Campania,
            Material,
            Modulo,
            Avance,

            Apilado_TMS_Real,

            STOCK,
            MINA,
            SRR,

            CuT_Real,
            CuS_Real,
            CO3_Real,
            CuFe_Real,
            FeT_Real,
            FeS_Real,
            ConsH_Real,

            Malla_Menos_1_2_Real,
            Malla_Menos_100_Real,
            CaolBeta_Real

        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[reporte_turno_cache_emision_test]

        WHERE Fecha >= @fecha_inicio
          AND Fecha <  @fecha_fin
    ),

    diario_base AS
    (
        SELECT
            Fecha,

            MAX(Campania) AS Campania,
            MAX(Material) AS Material,
            MAX(Modulo)   AS Modulo,
            MAX(Avance)   AS Avance,

            COUNT(DISTINCT Turno) AS Cantidad_Turnos,

            CASE
                WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT Campania) <= 1
                 AND COUNT(DISTINCT Material) <= 1
                 AND COUNT(DISTINCT Modulo) <= 1
                THEN 'OK'
                ELSE 'REVISAR'
            END AS Flag_Contexto_Dia,

            SUM(COALESCE(Apilado_TMS_Real, 0))
                AS Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia,

            /* Distribución STOCK / MINA / SRR */
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN STOCK IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * STOCK
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN STOCK IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS STOCK_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN MINA IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * MINA
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN MINA IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS MINA_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN SRR IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * SRR
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN SRR IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS SRR_Dia,

            /* Análisis químicos */
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CuT_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CuT_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CuT_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CuT_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CuS_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CuS_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CuS_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CuS_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CO3_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CO3_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CO3_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CO3_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CuFe_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CuFe_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CuFe_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CuFe_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN FeT_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * FeT_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN FeT_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS FeT_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN FeS_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * FeS_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN FeS_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS FeS_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN ConsH_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * ConsH_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN ConsH_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS ConsH_Real_Dia,

            /* Granulometrías y NIR */
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN Malla_Menos_1_2_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * Malla_Menos_1_2_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN Malla_Menos_1_2_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS Malla_Menos_1_2_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN Malla_Menos_100_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * Malla_Menos_100_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN Malla_Menos_100_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS Malla_Menos_100_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CaolBeta_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CaolBeta_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CaolBeta_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CaolBeta_Real_Dia

        FROM base_turno

        GROUP BY Fecha
    ),

    diario_derivado AS
    (
        SELECT
            d.*,

            CASE
                WHEN d.CuT_Real_Dia IS NULL
                  OR d.CuT_Real_Dia = 0
                  OR d.CuS_Real_Dia IS NULL
                THEN NULL
                ELSE d.CuS_Real_Dia / d.CuT_Real_Dia
            END AS Solubilidad_Real_Dia

        FROM diario_base d
    ),

    programa AS
    (
        SELECT
            fecha AS Fecha,

            CAST(
    MAX(ton)
    AS decimal(18,6)
) AS Apilado_TMS_Programa,
            MAX(cut)       AS CuT_Programa,
            MAX(cus)       AS CuS_Programa,
            MAX(co3)       AS CO3_Programa,
            MAX(cl_acido)  AS ConsH_Programa,
            MAX(cufe)      AS CuFe_Programa,
            MAX(porc_1_2)  AS Malla_Menos_1_2_Programa,
            MAX(malla_100) AS Malla_Menos_100_Programa,
            MAX(betaclay)  AS CaolBeta_Programa

        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[plan_semanal_reporte_turno]

        WHERE fecha >= @fecha_inicio
          AND fecha <  @fecha_fin

        GROUP BY fecha
    ),

    plan_mensual AS
    (
        SELECT
            fecha AS Fecha,

            MAX(apilamiento) AS Apilado_TMS_Plan,
            MAX(cut)         AS CuT_Plan,
            MAX(cus)         AS CuS_Plan,
            MAX(co3)         AS CO3_Plan,
            MAX(cl_acido)    AS ConsH_Plan,
            MAX(cufe)        AS CuFe_Plan,
            MAX(malla_100)   AS Malla_Menos_100_Plan,
            MAX(caol_beta)   AS CaolBeta_Plan

        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[plan_mensual_reporte_turno]

        WHERE fecha >= @fecha_inicio
          AND fecha <  @fecha_fin

        GROUP BY fecha
    )

    SELECT
        d.Fecha,

        d.Campania,
        d.Material AS Material_Operacion,

        CASE
            WHEN d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia <= 0.25
                THEN 'SULFURO'

            WHEN d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia <= 0.50
                THEN 'MIXTO'

            ELSE 'OXIDO'
        END AS Clasificacion_Solubilidad,

        d.Modulo,
        d.Avance,

        d.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia,
        pr.Apilado_TMS_Programa,
        pl.Apilado_TMS_Plan,

        d.STOCK_Dia,
        d.MINA_Dia,
        d.SRR_Dia,

        d.CuT_Real_Dia,
        pr.CuT_Programa,
        pl.CuT_Plan,

        d.CuS_Real_Dia,
        pr.CuS_Programa,
        pl.CuS_Plan,

        d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia,

        CASE
            WHEN pr.CuT_Programa IS NULL
              OR pr.CuT_Programa = 0
              OR pr.CuS_Programa IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            ELSE pr.CuS_Programa / pr.CuT_Programa
        END AS Solubilidad_Programa,

        CASE
            WHEN pl.CuT_Plan IS NULL
              OR pl.CuT_Plan = 0
              OR pl.CuS_Plan IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            ELSE pl.CuS_Plan / pl.CuT_Plan
        END AS Solubilidad_Plan,

        d.CO3_Real_Dia,
        pr.CO3_Programa,
        pl.CO3_Plan,

        d.CuFe_Real_Dia,
        pr.CuFe_Programa,
        pl.CuFe_Plan,

        d.FeT_Real_Dia,
        d.FeS_Real_Dia,
        d.ConsH_Real_Dia,

        d.Malla_Menos_1_2_Real_Dia,
        pr.Malla_Menos_1_2_Programa,

        d.Malla_Menos_100_Real_Dia,
        pr.Malla_Menos_100_Programa,
        pl.Malla_Menos_100_Plan,

        d.CaolBeta_Real_Dia,
        pr.CaolBeta_Programa,
        pl.CaolBeta_Plan,

CAST
(
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN d.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia IS NULL
              OR d.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia = 0
              OR d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia IS NULL
              OR d.CO3_Real_Dia IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN ISNULL(d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia, 0) < 0.25
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(d.CO3_Real_Dia, 0) <= 0.25
                        THEN 14.0
                    ELSE 11.0 + (15.51 * ISNULL(d.CO3_Real_Dia, 0))
                END

            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN d.CuS_Real_Dia IS NULL OR d.CuS_Real_Dia <= 0
                        THEN 0.0
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN (8.182 * LOG(d.CuS_Real_Dia))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(d.CO3_Real_Dia, 0)) < 14.0
                                THEN 14.0
                            ELSE (8.182 * LOG(d.CuS_Real_Dia))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(d.CO3_Real_Dia, 0))
                        END
                END
        END
    , 2)
    AS decimal(18, 2)
) AS Dosis_Acido_Ideal_Dia,

     CAST
(
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN pr.CuT_Programa IS NULL
              OR pr.CuT_Programa = 0
              OR pr.CuS_Programa IS NULL
              OR pr.CO3_Programa IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN ISNULL(pr.CuS_Programa / NULLIF(pr.CuT_Programa, 0), 0) < 0.25
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(pr.CO3_Programa, 0) <= 0.25
                        THEN 14.0
                    ELSE 11.0 + (15.51 * ISNULL(pr.CO3_Programa, 0))
                END

            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN pr.CuS_Programa IS NULL OR pr.CuS_Programa <= 0
                        THEN 0.0
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN (8.182 * LOG(pr.CuS_Programa))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(pr.CO3_Programa, 0)) < 14.0
                                THEN 14.0
                            ELSE (8.182 * LOG(pr.CuS_Programa))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(pr.CO3_Programa, 0))
                        END
                END
        END
    , 2)
    AS decimal(18, 2)
) AS Dosis_Acido_Programa_Semanal,
        d.Cantidad_Turnos,
        d.Flag_Contexto_Dia

    FROM diario_derivado d

    LEFT JOIN programa pr
        ON pr.Fecha = d.Fecha

    LEFT JOIN plan_mensual pl
        ON pl.Fecha = d.Fecha
);

definition:
CREATE VIEW [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_inventario_chancado_archive_test]
AS

WITH Parametros AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(5.0 AS float) AS Cantidad_Bins,
        CAST(1.6 AS float) AS Densidad_Ton_M3,
        CAST(1200.0 AS float) AS Tolva_Compensacion_TMH,

        /* Cambio confirmado de metodología de descarga:
           antes: niveles horarios;
           desde 30-06-2026: Archive Value diario replicado. */
        CAST('2026-06-30' AS date) AS Fecha_Inicio_Archive_Value
),

/*==============================================================
  1. Base cruda
==============================================================*/
BaseBloqueArchive AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(
            DATEADD(HOUR, -8, df.fecha_inicial)
            AS date
        ) AS Fecha_Operacional,

        df.fecha_inicial,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_silo_a) AS nivel_silo_a,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_silo_b) AS nivel_silo_b,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_a) AS nivel_harnero_a,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_b) AS nivel_harnero_b,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_c) AS nivel_harnero_c,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_d) AS nivel_harnero_d,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_e) AS nivel_harnero_e,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_a) AS nivel_chancado_a,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_b) AS nivel_chancado_b,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_c) AS nivel_chancado_c,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_d) AS nivel_chancado_d,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_e) AS nivel_chancado_e

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados AS df

    WHERE df.fecha_inicial >=
          DATEADD(DAY, -400, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
),

/*==============================================================
  2. Horas físicas esperadas por día operacional

  Chile continental:
      Pacific SA Standard Time

  Posibles duraciones físicas:
      23 h = adelanto horario
      24 h = día normal
      25 h = atraso horario
==============================================================*/
HorasEsperadasArchive AS
(
    SELECT
        f.Fecha_Operacional,

        DATEADD(
            HOUR,
            8,
            CAST(f.Fecha_Operacional AS datetime2)
        ) AS Inicio_Local,

        DATEADD(
            HOUR,
            8,
            CAST(
                DATEADD(DAY, 1, f.Fecha_Operacional)
                AS datetime2
            )
        ) AS Fin_Local,

        CAST
        (
            DATEDIFF
            (
                MINUTE,

                SWITCHOFFSET
                (
                    DATEADD(
                        HOUR,
                        8,
                        CAST(f.Fecha_Operacional AS datetime2)
                    )
                    AT TIME ZONE 'Pacific SA Standard Time',
                    '+00:00'
                ),

                SWITCHOFFSET
                (
                    DATEADD(
                        HOUR,
                        8,
                        CAST(
                            DATEADD(DAY, 1, f.Fecha_Operacional)
                            AS datetime2
                        )
                    )
                    AT TIME ZONE 'Pacific SA Standard Time',
                    '+00:00'
                )
            ) / 60.0

            AS decimal(10,2)
        ) AS Horas_Fisicas_Esperadas

    FROM
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            Fecha_Operacional
        FROM BaseBloqueArchive
    ) AS f
),

/*==============================================================
  3. Registros esperados en datos_filtrados

  Comportamiento observado:
      23 horas físicas -> 23 registros
      24 horas físicas -> 24 registros
      25 horas físicas -> 24 registros

  La hora repetida del cambio a horario de invierno no queda
  almacenada como una fila local adicional.
==============================================================*/
RegistrosEsperadosArchive AS
(
    SELECT
        h.Fecha_Operacional,
        h.Inicio_Local,
        h.Fin_Local,
        h.Horas_Fisicas_Esperadas,

        CASE
            WHEN h.Horas_Fisicas_Esperadas < 24
                THEN CAST(h.Horas_Fisicas_Esperadas AS int)
            ELSE 24
        END AS Registros_Horarios_Esperados

    FROM HorasEsperadasArchive AS h
),

/*==============================================================
  4. Validación del bloque de niveles

  REGLAS COMUNES
  - Cantidad de filas correcta según DST y almacenamiento.
  - Primera fila 08:00.
  - Última fila 07:00 del día siguiente.

  METODOLOGÍA HISTÓRICA (< 30-06-2026)
  - Datos horarios.
  - Para inventario se utiliza snapshot 08:00.
  - Se exige que los 12 sensores estén presentes a las 08:00.
  - NO se exige que todos estén presentes durante las 24 h.
  - NO se exige constancia diaria.

  METODOLOGÍA ARCHIVE VALUE (>= 30-06-2026)
  - Un valor diario replicado.
  - Todos los sensores deben estar presentes en todas las filas.
  - Cada sensor debe tener exactamente un valor distinto.
==============================================================*/
ValidacionBloqueArchive AS
(
    SELECT
        b.Fecha_Operacional,

        MIN(b.fecha_inicial) AS Primera_Fila_Bloque,
        MAX(b.fecha_inicial) AS Ultima_Fila_Bloque,
        COUNT(*) AS Cantidad_Filas_Bloque,

        CASE
            WHEN
                COUNT(*) = h.Registros_Horarios_Esperados

                AND MIN(b.fecha_inicial) =
                    DATEADD(
                        HOUR,
                        8,
                        CAST(b.Fecha_Operacional AS datetime2)
                    )

                AND MAX(b.fecha_inicial) =
                    DATEADD(
                        HOUR,
                        7,
                        DATEADD(
                            DAY,
                            1,
                            CAST(b.Fecha_Operacional AS datetime2)
                        )
                    )

                AND
                (
                    /*==================================================
                      METODOLOGÍA HISTÓRICA
                    ==================================================*/
                    (
                        b.Fecha_Operacional
                            < p.Fecha_Inicio_Archive_Value

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_silo_a IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_silo_b IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_harnero_a IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_harnero_b IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_harnero_c IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_harnero_d IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_harnero_e IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_chancado_a IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_chancado_b IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_chancado_c IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_chancado_d IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1

                        AND SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, b.fecha_inicial) = 8
                                 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, b.fecha_inicial) = 0
                                 AND b.nivel_chancado_e IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1 ELSE 0
                            END
                        ) = 1
                    )

                    OR

                    /*==================================================
                      METODOLOGÍA ARCHIVE VALUE
                    ==================================================*/
                    (
                        b.Fecha_Operacional
                            >= p.Fecha_Inicio_Archive_Value

                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_silo_a) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_silo_b) = COUNT(*)

                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_harnero_a) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_harnero_b) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_harnero_c) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_harnero_d) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_harnero_e) = COUNT(*)

                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_chancado_a) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_chancado_b) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_chancado_c) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_chancado_d) = COUNT(*)
                        AND COUNT(b.nivel_chancado_e) = COUNT(*)

                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_silo_a) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_silo_b) = 1

                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_harnero_a) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_harnero_b) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_harnero_c) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_harnero_d) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_harnero_e) = 1

                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_chancado_a) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_chancado_b) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_chancado_c) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_chancado_d) = 1
                        AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.nivel_chancado_e) = 1
                    )
                )

            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS Flag_Bloque_Archive_Valido

    FROM BaseBloqueArchive AS b

    INNER JOIN RegistrosEsperadosArchive AS h
        ON h.Fecha_Operacional = b.Fecha_Operacional

    CROSS JOIN Parametros AS p

    GROUP BY
        b.Fecha_Operacional,
        h.Registros_Horarios_Esperados,
        p.Fecha_Inicio_Archive_Value
),

/*==============================================================
  5. Selección de la fila de las 08:00
==============================================================*/
RegistrosHora8 AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(df.fecha_inicial AS date) AS Fecha_Lectura_D1,
        df.fecha_inicial,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_silo_a) AS nivel_silo_a,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_silo_b) AS nivel_silo_b,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_a) AS nivel_harnero_a,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_b) AS nivel_harnero_b,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_c) AS nivel_harnero_c,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_d) AS nivel_harnero_d,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_harnero_e) AS nivel_harnero_e,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_a) AS nivel_chancado_a,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_b) AS nivel_chancado_b,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_c) AS nivel_chancado_c,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_d) AS nivel_chancado_d,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, df.nivel_chancado_e) AS nivel_chancado_e

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados AS df

    WHERE DATEPART(HOUR, df.fecha_inicial) = 8
      AND DATEPART(MINUTE, df.fecha_inicial) = 0
      AND df.fecha_inicial >=
          DATEADD(DAY, -400, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
),

/*==============================================================
  6. Consolidación de registros encontrados a las 08:00
==============================================================*/
PromedioHora8 AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha_Lectura_D1,

        MIN(fecha_inicial) AS Primera_Lectura_Hora_8,
        MAX(fecha_inicial) AS Ultima_Lectura_Hora_8,
        COUNT(*) AS Cantidad_Registros_Hora_8,

        AVG(nivel_silo_a) AS nivel_silo_a,
        AVG(nivel_silo_b) AS nivel_silo_b,

        AVG(nivel_harnero_a) AS nivel_harnero_a,
        AVG(nivel_harnero_b) AS nivel_harnero_b,
        AVG(nivel_harnero_c) AS nivel_harnero_c,
        AVG(nivel_harnero_d) AS nivel_harnero_d,
        AVG(nivel_harnero_e) AS nivel_harnero_e,

        AVG(nivel_chancado_a) AS nivel_chancado_a,
        AVG(nivel_chancado_b) AS nivel_chancado_b,
        AVG(nivel_chancado_c) AS nivel_chancado_c,
        AVG(nivel_chancado_d) AS nivel_chancado_d,
        AVG(nivel_chancado_e) AS nivel_chancado_e

    FROM RegistrosHora8

    GROUP BY Fecha_Lectura_D1
),

/*==============================================================
  7. Fecha operacional
==============================================================*/
FechaOperacional AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(p.Fecha_Lectura_D1 AS date) AS Fecha,

        p.Fecha_Lectura_D1,
        p.Primera_Lectura_Hora_8,
        p.Ultima_Lectura_Hora_8,
        p.Cantidad_Registros_Hora_8,

        p.nivel_silo_a,
        p.nivel_silo_b,

        p.nivel_harnero_a,
        p.nivel_harnero_b,
        p.nivel_harnero_c,
        p.nivel_harnero_d,
        p.nivel_harnero_e,

        p.nivel_chancado_a,
        p.nivel_chancado_b,
        p.nivel_chancado_c,
        p.nivel_chancado_d,
        p.nivel_chancado_e

    FROM PromedioHora8 AS p
),

/*==============================================================
  8. Promedio de sensores por instalación
==============================================================*/
NivelesPromedio AS
(
    SELECT
        f.*,

        silo.Nivel_Inventario_Silo,
        silo.Sensores_Silo_Validos,

        harnero.Nivel_Inventario_Harnero,
        harnero.Sensores_Harnero_Validos,

        chancado.Nivel_Inventario_Chancado,
        chancado.Sensores_Chancado_Validos

    FROM FechaOperacional AS f

    CROSS APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            AVG(v.Valor) AS Nivel_Inventario_Silo,
            COUNT(v.Valor) AS Sensores_Silo_Validos
        FROM
        (
            VALUES
                (f.nivel_silo_a),
                (f.nivel_silo_b)
        ) AS v(Valor)
    ) AS silo

    CROSS APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            AVG(v.Valor) AS Nivel_Inventario_Harnero,
            COUNT(v.Valor) AS Sensores_Harnero_Validos
        FROM
        (
            VALUES
                (f.nivel_harnero_a),
                (f.nivel_harnero_b),
                (f.nivel_harnero_c),
                (f.nivel_harnero_d),
                (f.nivel_harnero_e)
        ) AS v(Valor)
    ) AS harnero

    CROSS APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            AVG(v.Valor) AS Nivel_Inventario_Chancado,
            COUNT(v.Valor) AS Sensores_Chancado_Validos
        FROM
        (
            VALUES
                (f.nivel_chancado_a),
                (f.nivel_chancado_b),
                (f.nivel_chancado_c),
                (f.nivel_chancado_d),
                (f.nivel_chancado_e)
        ) AS v(Valor)
    ) AS chancado
),

/*==============================================================
  9. Humedad, parámetros y validación del bloque
==============================================================*/
BaseConHumedad AS
(
    SELECT
        n.*,

        va.Primera_Fila_Bloque,
        va.Ultima_Fila_Bloque,
        va.Cantidad_Filas_Bloque,

        ISNULL(
            va.Flag_Bloque_Archive_Valido,
            0
        ) AS Flag_Bloque_Archive_Valido,

        h.Humedad_Inventario,
        h.Regla_Humedad_Inventario,
        h.Flag_Humedad_Inventario_Valida,

        h.Fecha_Humedad_TM1,
        h.Torre_Humedad_TM1,
        h.Turno_Humedad_TM1,
        h.Fuente_Humedad_TM1,

        h.Fecha_Humedad_TM2,
        h.Torre_Humedad_TM2,
        h.Turno_Humedad_TM2,
        h.Fuente_Humedad_TM2,

        p.Cantidad_Bins,
        p.Densidad_Ton_M3,
        p.Tolva_Compensacion_TMH,

        0.0957 * n.Nivel_Inventario_Harnero
            + 0.43 AS Y_Harnero,

        0.0957 * n.Nivel_Inventario_Chancado
            + 0.43 AS Y_Chancado

    FROM NivelesPromedio AS n

    CROSS JOIN Parametros AS p

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_humedad_inventario_test AS h
        ON h.Fecha = n.Fecha

    LEFT JOIN ValidacionBloqueArchive AS va
        ON va.Fecha_Operacional = n.Fecha
),

/*==============================================================
  10. Cálculo de inventarios húmedos TMH
==============================================================*/
InventariosTMH AS
(
    SELECT
        b.*,

        CASE
            WHEN b.Nivel_Inventario_Silo IS NULL
                THEN NULL
            ELSE
                PI()
                * POWER(CAST(7.5 AS float), 2)
                * CAST(11.0 AS float)
                * b.Nivel_Inventario_Silo
                * CAST(b.Densidad_Ton_M3 AS float)
                / CAST(100.0 AS float)
        END AS TMH_Silo,

        CASE
            WHEN b.Nivel_Inventario_Harnero IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN b.Y_Harnero > 0
             AND b.Y_Harnero <= 2.268
                THEN
                    (
                        31.6468254 * POWER(b.Y_Harnero, 2)
                        + 63.8 * b.Y_Harnero
                    )
                    * (
                        b.Cantidad_Bins
                        * b.Densidad_Ton_M3
                        / 5.0
                    )

            WHEN b.Y_Harnero > 2.268
             AND b.Y_Harnero <= 2.52
                THEN
                    (
                        25.3173746 * POWER(b.Y_Harnero, 2)
                        + 92.51 * b.Y_Harnero
                        - 32.55714
                    )
                    * (
                        b.Cantidad_Bins
                        * b.Densidad_Ton_M3
                        / 5.0
                    )

            ELSE
                (
                    220.11 * b.Y_Harnero
                    - 193.33314
                )
                * (
                    b.Cantidad_Bins
                    * b.Densidad_Ton_M3
                    / 5.0
                )
        END AS TMH_Harnero,

        CASE
            WHEN b.Nivel_Inventario_Chancado IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN b.Y_Chancado > 0
             AND b.Y_Chancado <= 2.268
                THEN
                    (
                        31.6468254 * POWER(b.Y_Chancado, 2)
                        + 63.8 * b.Y_Chancado
                    )
                    * (
                        b.Cantidad_Bins
                        * b.Densidad_Ton_M3
                        / 5.0
                    )

            WHEN b.Y_Chancado > 2.268
             AND b.Y_Chancado <= 2.52
                THEN
                    (
                        25.3173746 * POWER(b.Y_Chancado, 2)
                        + 92.51 * b.Y_Chancado
                        - 32.55714
                    )
                    * (
                        b.Cantidad_Bins
                        * b.Densidad_Ton_M3
                        / 5.0
                    )

            ELSE
                (
                    220.11 * b.Y_Chancado
                    - 193.33314
                )
                * (
                    b.Cantidad_Bins
                    * b.Densidad_Ton_M3
                    / 5.0
                )
        END AS TMH_Chancado

    FROM BaseConHumedad AS b
),

/*==============================================================
  11. Inventario total húmedo
==============================================================*/
Totales AS
(
    SELECT
        i.*,

        CASE
            WHEN i.TMH_Silo IS NOT NULL
             AND i.TMH_Harnero IS NOT NULL
             AND i.TMH_Chancado IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    i.TMH_Silo
                    + i.TMH_Harnero
                    + i.TMH_Chancado
                    + i.Tolva_Compensacion_TMH
            ELSE NULL
        END AS Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMH

    FROM InventariosTMH AS i
),

/*==============================================================
  12. Conversión a toneladas secas
==============================================================*/
TotalesSecos AS
(
    SELECT
        t.*,

        CASE
            WHEN t.Flag_Bloque_Archive_Valido = 1
             AND t.Flag_Humedad_Inventario_Valida = 1
             AND t.Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMH IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    t.Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMH
                    * (1.0 - t.Humedad_Inventario / 100.0)

            ELSE NULL
        END AS Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS

    FROM Totales AS t
),

/*==============================================================
  13. Inventario inmediatamente anterior mediante LAG
==============================================================*/
ConLagInventario AS
(
    SELECT
        t.*,

        LAG(t.Fecha)
            OVER (ORDER BY t.Fecha)
            AS Fecha_Inventario_Anterior_Lag,

        LAG(t.Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS)
            OVER (ORDER BY t.Fecha)
            AS Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior_Lag

    FROM TotalesSecos AS t
),

/*==============================================================
  14. Resolución entre semilla oficial y LAG
==============================================================*/
ConInventarioAnterior AS
(
    SELECT
        l.*,

        CASE
            WHEN s.Inventario_Chancado_TMS IS NOT NULL
                THEN s.Fecha

            WHEN l.Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior_Lag IS NOT NULL
                THEN l.Fecha_Inventario_Anterior_Lag

            ELSE NULL
        END AS Fecha_Inventario_Anterior,

        COALESCE
        (
            TRY_CONVERT(float, s.Inventario_Chancado_TMS),
            l.Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior_Lag
        ) AS Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior,

        CASE
            WHEN s.Inventario_Chancado_TMS IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'SEMILLA_OFICIAL'

            WHEN l.Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior_Lag IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'LAG_VISTA'

            ELSE 'SIN_INVENTARIO_ANTERIOR'
        END AS Fuente_Inventario_Anterior

    FROM ConLagInventario AS l

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.semilla_inventario_chancado AS s
        ON s.Fecha = DATEADD(DAY, -1, l.Fecha)
       AND s.Activo = 1
),

/*==============================================================
  15. Delta diario de inventario
==============================================================*/
Resultado AS
(
    SELECT
        c.*,

        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(
                    DAY,
                    c.Fecha_Inventario_Anterior,
                    c.Fecha
                 ) = 1
             AND c.Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS IS NOT NULL
             AND c.Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior IS NOT NULL
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS Flag_Continuidad_Diaria,

        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(
                    DAY,
                    c.Fecha_Inventario_Anterior,
                    c.Fecha
                 ) = 1
             AND c.Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS IS NOT NULL
             AND c.Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    c.Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS
                    - c.Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior
            ELSE NULL
        END AS Delta_Inventario_Chancado_TMS

    FROM ConInventarioAnterior AS c
)

/*==============================================================
  16. Salida final
==============================================================*/
SELECT
    Fecha,

    Fecha_Lectura_D1,
    Primera_Lectura_Hora_8,
    Ultima_Lectura_Hora_8,
    Cantidad_Registros_Hora_8,

    Primera_Fila_Bloque,
    Ultima_Fila_Bloque,
    Cantidad_Filas_Bloque,
    Flag_Bloque_Archive_Valido,

    Nivel_Inventario_Silo,
    Sensores_Silo_Validos,

    Nivel_Inventario_Harnero,
    Sensores_Harnero_Validos,

    Nivel_Inventario_Chancado,
    Sensores_Chancado_Validos,

    TMH_Silo,
    TMH_Harnero,
    TMH_Chancado,

    Tolva_Compensacion_TMH,
    Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMH,

    Humedad_Inventario,
    Regla_Humedad_Inventario,
    Flag_Humedad_Inventario_Valida,

    Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS,

    Fecha_Inventario_Anterior,
    Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior,
    Fuente_Inventario_Anterior,

    Flag_Continuidad_Diaria,
    Delta_Inventario_Chancado_TMS,

    Fecha_Humedad_TM1,
    Torre_Humedad_TM1,
    Turno_Humedad_TM1,
    Fuente_Humedad_TM1,

    Fecha_Humedad_TM2,
    Torre_Humedad_TM2,
    Turno_Humedad_TM2,
    Fuente_Humedad_TM2,

    CASE
        WHEN Cantidad_Registros_Hora_8 = 1
         AND Flag_Bloque_Archive_Valido = 1
         AND Sensores_Silo_Validos = 2
         AND Sensores_Harnero_Validos = 5
         AND Sensores_Chancado_Validos = 5
         AND Flag_Humedad_Inventario_Valida = 1
         AND Flag_Continuidad_Diaria = 1
            THEN 1

        ELSE 0
    END AS Flag_Inventario_Valido

FROM Resultado;

CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_sal_ajustada AS

WITH sal_marcas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(fecha_turno AS date) AS Fecha,

        CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 8, CAST(CAST(fecha_turno AS date) AS datetime2)) AS datetime2)
            AS ts_08_dia,

        CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 20, CAST(CAST(fecha_turno AS date) AS datetime2)) AS datetime2)
            AS ts_20_dia,

        CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 8, DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(CAST(fecha_turno AS date) AS datetime2))) AS datetime2)
            AS ts_08_dia_siguiente

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados
),

sal_base AS (
    SELECT
        m.Fecha,

        CAST(t08.cv201_tot AS float)  AS CV201_08,
        CAST(t20.cv201_tot AS float)  AS CV201_20,
        CAST(t08s.cv201_tot AS float) AS CV201_08_sig,

        CAST(t08.cv202_tot AS float)  AS CV202_08,
        CAST(t20.cv202_tot AS float)  AS CV202_20,
        CAST(t08s.cv202_tot AS float) AS CV202_08_sig

    FROM sal_marcas m

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados t08
        ON t08.fecha_final = m.ts_08_dia

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados t20
        ON t20.fecha_final = m.ts_20_dia

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados t08s
        ON t08s.fecha_final = m.ts_08_dia_siguiente
),

sal_calc AS (
    SELECT
        Fecha,

        (CV201_20 - CV201_08) / 1000.0 AS CV201_TA_Bruto,
        (CV201_08_sig - CV201_20) / 1000.0 AS CV201_TB_Bruto,

        (CV202_20 - CV202_08) / 1000.0 AS CV202_TA_Bruto,
        (CV202_08_sig - CV202_20) / 1000.0 AS CV202_TB_Bruto

    FROM sal_base
),

sal_validacion AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,

        CASE
            WHEN CV201_TA_Bruto IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN CV201_TB_Bruto IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN CV202_TA_Bruto IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN CV202_TB_Bruto IS NULL THEN 0

            WHEN CV201_TA_Bruto < 0 THEN 0
            WHEN CV201_TB_Bruto < 0 THEN 0
            WHEN CV202_TA_Bruto < 0 THEN 0
            WHEN CV202_TB_Bruto < 0 THEN 0

            ELSE 1
        END AS Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida

    FROM sal_calc c
),

sal_total AS (
    SELECT
        Fecha,

        CASE WHEN Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 1 THEN CV201_TA_Bruto ELSE 0 END AS CV201_TA,
        CASE WHEN Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 1 THEN CV201_TB_Bruto ELSE 0 END AS CV201_TB,
        CASE WHEN Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 1 THEN CV202_TA_Bruto ELSE 0 END AS CV202_TA,
        CASE WHEN Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 1 THEN CV202_TB_Bruto ELSE 0 END AS CV202_TB,

        Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida

    FROM sal_validacion
),

sal_ajuste_base AS (
    SELECT
        s.Fecha,

        s.CV201_TA,
        s.CV201_TB,
        s.CV202_TA,
        s.CV202_TB,

        s.CV201_TA + s.CV202_TA AS Sal_Pesometros_TA,
        s.CV201_TB + s.CV202_TB AS Sal_Pesometros_TB,

        s.CV201_TA
      + s.CV201_TB
      + s.CV202_TA
      + s.CV202_TB AS Sal_Pesometros_Dia,

        CAST(topo.tonelaje_topografia AS float) AS Sal_Topografia_Dia,

        s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida,

        CASE
            WHEN s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 0 THEN 0
            WHEN topo.tonelaje_topografia IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN topo.tonelaje_topografia <= 0 THEN 0

            WHEN s.CV201_TA + s.CV202_TA <= 0 THEN 0
            WHEN s.CV201_TB + s.CV202_TB <= 0 THEN 0

            WHEN s.CV201_TA
               + s.CV201_TB
               + s.CV202_TA
               + s.CV202_TB <= 0 THEN 0

            ELSE 1
        END AS Flag_Sal_Ajuste_Valido

    FROM sal_total s

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.topografia_sal topo
        ON topo.fecha = s.Fecha
)

SELECT
    Fecha,

    CV201_TA,
    CV201_TB,
    CV202_TA,
    CV202_TB,

    Sal_Pesometros_TA,
    Sal_Pesometros_TB,
    Sal_Pesometros_Dia,

    Sal_Topografia_Dia,

    Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida,
    Flag_Sal_Ajuste_Valido,

    CASE
        WHEN Flag_Sal_Ajuste_Valido = 1 THEN
            Sal_Pesometros_TA
            * Sal_Topografia_Dia
            / NULLIF(Sal_Pesometros_Dia, 0)
        ELSE 0
    END AS Sal_Ajustada_TA,

    CASE
        WHEN Flag_Sal_Ajuste_Valido = 1 THEN
            Sal_Pesometros_TB
            * Sal_Topografia_Dia
            / NULLIF(Sal_Pesometros_Dia, 0)
        ELSE 0
    END AS Sal_Ajustada_TB,

    CASE
        WHEN Flag_Sal_Ajuste_Valido = 1 THEN
            Sal_Topografia_Dia
        ELSE 0
    END AS Sal_Ajustada_Dia

FROM sal_ajuste_base;
