CREATE VIEW [inventar_SpcHidr].[aasdsad] AS SELECT
    inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc.ID AS ID,
    inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc.ID AS id_flujo,
    inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc.Flujos AS Etiqueta,
    flujo_modelos_hc.Descripcion AS Descripcion,
    Data_balance_rec_hc.fecha_bm AS fecha,
    inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc.X AS X,
    inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc.Y AS Y,
    inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc.X_l AS X_l,
    inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc.Y_l AS Y_l,
    '1' AS modelo,
    Data_balance_rec_hc.Masa_medida AS Medido,
    Data_balance_rec_hc.Masa_recon AS Reconciliado,
    Data_balance_rec_hc.Cu AS Medido_cu,
    Data_balance_rec_hc.Ley_recon_Cu AS Reconciliado_cu,
    Data_balance_rec_hc.Tolerancia AS Tolerancia,
    Data_balance_rec_hc.Tolerancia_cu AS Tolerancia_cu,
    Data_balance_rec_hc.caso_id AS caso
FROM flujo_modelos_hc
JOIN Data_balance_rec_hc 
    ON flujo_modelos_hc.Flujos = Data_balance_rec_hc.Codigo 
   AND flujo_modelos_hc.modelo = 1
JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc 
    ON flujo_modelos_hc.Id_flujo = inventar_SpcHidr.flujo_coord_hc.ID;

name: v_apilado_tms_con_sal_srr
definition:
CREATE   VIEW
    [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_apilado_tms_con_sal_srr]
AS

WITH fechas AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Flag_Apilado_Valido,

        TMH_CV008_A,
        TMH_CV008_B,
        TMH_CV108_A,
        TMH_CV108_B,

        TMH_Apilado_Total_A,
        TMH_Apilado_Total_B,
        TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_datos_apilado_tmh_v2
),

/* ============================================================
   HUMEDAD INFORMADA POR LABORATORIO
   ============================================================ */
hum AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,
        Torre,
        Turno,

        AVG
        (
            CAST(Humedad_Prom_Pct AS float)
        ) AS Humedad_Prom_Pct

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.Informe_TM_lab

    WHERE Humedad_Prom_Pct IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        CAST(Fecha AS date),
        Torre,
        Turno
),

/* ============================================================
   HUMEDAD + REPRESENTATIVIDAD FÍSICA
   ============================================================ */
hum_rep AS
(
    SELECT
        h.Fecha,
        h.Torre,
        h.Turno,
        h.Humedad_Prom_Pct,

        CASE
            WHEN h.Torre = 'T1'
             AND h.Turno = 'A'
                THEN r.TM1_TurnoA_Fisico

            WHEN h.Torre = 'T1'
             AND h.Turno = 'B'
                THEN r.TM1_TurnoB_Fisico

            WHEN h.Torre = 'T2'
             AND h.Turno = 'A'
                THEN r.TM2_TurnoA_Fisico

            WHEN h.Torre = 'T2'
             AND h.Turno = 'B'
                THEN r.TM2_TurnoB_Fisico
        END AS Representatividad_Fisica

    FROM hum AS h

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_representatividad_diaria_calculada AS r
        ON r.Dia = h.Fecha
),

/* ============================================================
   HUMEDADES REPRESENTATIVAS POR FECHA + TURNO
   ============================================================ */
hum_validas AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Torre,
        Turno,
        Humedad_Prom_Pct,
        Representatividad_Fisica,

        DATEADD
        (
            HOUR,
            CASE
                WHEN Turno = 'A' THEN 8
                ELSE 20
            END,
            CAST(Fecha AS datetime2(0))
        ) AS FechaTurno_Origen

    FROM hum_rep

    WHERE Humedad_Prom_Pct IS NOT NULL
      AND Representatividad_Fisica >= 0.75
),

/* ============================================================
   PERIODOS A/B QUE DEBEN RESOLVERSE
   ============================================================ */
periodos AS
(
    SELECT
        f.Fecha,
        t.Turno_Objetivo,

        DATEADD
        (
            HOUR,
            CASE
                WHEN t.Turno_Objetivo = 'A' THEN 8
                ELSE 20
            END,
            CAST(f.Fecha AS datetime2(0))
        ) AS FechaTurno_Objetivo

    FROM fechas AS f

    CROSS JOIN
    (
        VALUES
            ('A'),
            ('B')
    ) AS t(Turno_Objetivo)
),

/* ============================================================
   RESOLUCIÓN CRONOLÓGICA POR FECHA + TURNO
   ============================================================ */
resuelta_turno AS
(
    SELECT
        p.Fecha,
        p.Turno_Objetivo,

        /* TM1 */
        tm1.Humedad_Prom_Pct
            AS Humedad_TM1,

        tm1.Fecha
            AS Fecha_Origen_TM1,

        tm1.Torre
            AS Torre_Origen_TM1,

        tm1.Turno
            AS Turno_Origen_TM1,

        tm1.Fuente_Humedad
            AS Fuente_Humedad_TM1,

        /* TM2 */
        tm2.Humedad_Prom_Pct
            AS Humedad_TM2,

        tm2.Fecha
            AS Fecha_Origen_TM2,

        tm2.Torre
            AS Torre_Origen_TM2,

        tm2.Turno
            AS Turno_Origen_TM2,

        tm2.Fuente_Humedad
            AS Fuente_Humedad_TM2

    FROM periodos AS p

    /* ========================================================
       HUMEDAD RESUELTA PARA TM1
       ======================================================== */
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            c.Fecha,
            c.Torre,
            c.Turno,
            c.Humedad_Prom_Pct,
            c.FechaTurno_Origen,
            c.Fuente_Humedad,
            c.Prioridad

        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                h.Fecha,
                h.Torre,
                h.Turno,
                h.Humedad_Prom_Pct,
                h.FechaTurno_Origen,

                CAST
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN h.Torre = 'T1'
                            THEN 'PROPIA_TM1'
                        ELSE 'ALINEADA_DESDE_TM2'
                    END
                    AS varchar(18)
                ) AS Fuente_Humedad,

                CASE
                    WHEN h.Torre = 'T1' THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END AS Prioridad

            FROM hum_validas AS h

            WHERE h.FechaTurno_Origen
                    <= p.FechaTurno_Objetivo
              AND h.Torre IN ('T1', 'T2')

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                CAST(s.fecha_origen AS date),
                CAST(s.torre AS varchar(20)),
                CAST(NULL AS varchar(5)),
                CAST(s.humedad_pct AS float),
                CAST(s.fecha_origen AS datetime2(0)),

                CAST
                (
                    'SEMILLA_PERIODO'
                    AS varchar(18)
                ),

                3

            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.humedad_inicial_tm_periodo AS s

            WHERE s.tm = 'TM1'
              AND CAST(s.fecha_origen AS datetime2(0))
                    <= p.FechaTurno_Objetivo
        ) AS c

        ORDER BY
            c.FechaTurno_Origen DESC,
            c.Prioridad ASC

    ) AS tm1

    /* ========================================================
       HUMEDAD RESUELTA PARA TM2
       ======================================================== */
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            c.Fecha,
            c.Torre,
            c.Turno,
            c.Humedad_Prom_Pct,
            c.FechaTurno_Origen,
            c.Fuente_Humedad,
            c.Prioridad

        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                h.Fecha,
                h.Torre,
                h.Turno,
                h.Humedad_Prom_Pct,
                h.FechaTurno_Origen,

                CAST
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN h.Torre = 'T2'
                            THEN 'PROPIA_TM2'
                        ELSE 'ALINEADA_DESDE_TM1'
                    END
                    AS varchar(18)
                ) AS Fuente_Humedad,

                CASE
                    WHEN h.Torre = 'T2' THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END AS Prioridad

            FROM hum_validas AS h

            WHERE h.FechaTurno_Origen
                    <= p.FechaTurno_Objetivo
              AND h.Torre IN ('T1', 'T2')

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                CAST(s.fecha_origen AS date),
                CAST(s.torre AS varchar(20)),
                CAST(NULL AS varchar(5)),
                CAST(s.humedad_pct AS float),
                CAST(s.fecha_origen AS datetime2(0)),

                CAST
                (
                    'SEMILLA_PERIODO'
                    AS varchar(18)
                ),

                3

            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.humedad_inicial_tm_periodo AS s

            WHERE s.tm = 'TM2'
              AND CAST(s.fecha_origen AS datetime2(0))
                    <= p.FechaTurno_Objetivo
        ) AS c

        ORDER BY
            c.FechaTurno_Origen DESC,
            c.Prioridad ASC

    ) AS tm2
),

/* ============================================================
   PIVOT A/B A UNA FILA DIARIA

   Las cuatro humedades por turno quedan disponibles internamente.
   Humedad_TM1 y Humedad_TM2 representan el valor vigente al
   cierre del día para mantener compatibilidad.
   ============================================================ */
humedad_resuelta AS
(
    SELECT
        f.*,

        /* Humedades TM1 por turno */
        a.Humedad_TM1 AS Humedad_TM1_A,
        b.Humedad_TM1 AS Humedad_TM1_B,

        /* Humedades TM2 por turno */
        a.Humedad_TM2 AS Humedad_TM2_A,
        b.Humedad_TM2 AS Humedad_TM2_B,

        /* Valor vigente al cierre del día */
        COALESCE
        (
            b.Humedad_TM1,
            a.Humedad_TM1
        ) AS Humedad_TM1,

        COALESCE
        (
            b.Humedad_TM2,
            a.Humedad_TM2
        ) AS Humedad_TM2,

        /* Trazabilidad TM1 */
        COALESCE
        (
            b.Fecha_Origen_TM1,
            a.Fecha_Origen_TM1
        ) AS Fecha_Humedad_TM1,

        COALESCE
        (
            b.Torre_Origen_TM1,
            a.Torre_Origen_TM1
        ) AS Torre_Humedad_TM1,

        COALESCE
        (
            b.Turno_Origen_TM1,
            a.Turno_Origen_TM1
        ) AS Turno_Humedad_TM1,

        COALESCE
        (
            b.Fuente_Humedad_TM1,
            a.Fuente_Humedad_TM1
        ) AS Fuente_Humedad_TM1,

        /* Trazabilidad TM2 */
        COALESCE
        (
            b.Fecha_Origen_TM2,
            a.Fecha_Origen_TM2
        ) AS Fecha_Humedad_TM2,

        COALESCE
        (
            b.Torre_Origen_TM2,
            a.Torre_Origen_TM2
        ) AS Torre_Humedad_TM2,

        COALESCE
        (
            b.Turno_Origen_TM2,
            a.Turno_Origen_TM2
        ) AS Turno_Humedad_TM2,

        COALESCE
        (
            b.Fuente_Humedad_TM2,
            a.Fuente_Humedad_TM2
        ) AS Fuente_Humedad_TM2

    FROM fechas AS f

    LEFT JOIN resuelta_turno AS a
        ON a.Fecha = f.Fecha
       AND a.Turno_Objetivo = 'A'

    LEFT JOIN resuelta_turno AS b
        ON b.Fecha = f.Fecha
       AND b.Turno_Objetivo = 'B'
),

/* ============================================================
   FACTOR DE AJUSTE DE CAMIONES
   ============================================================ */
base AS
(
    SELECT
        h.*,

        COALESCE
        (
            fac.factor_ajuste,
            1.0
        ) AS Factor_Ajuste_Camiones_Usado,

        h.TMH_Apilado_Total_A
        * COALESCE(fac.factor_ajuste, 1.0)
            AS TMH_Apilado_Total_A_Factor,

        h.TMH_Apilado_Total_B
        * COALESCE(fac.factor_ajuste, 1.0)
            AS TMH_Apilado_Total_B_Factor,

        h.TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia
        * COALESCE(fac.factor_ajuste, 1.0)
            AS TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia_Factor

    FROM humedad_resuelta AS h

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            f.factor_ajuste

        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.factor_ajuste_camiones AS f

        WHERE f.activo = 1
          AND h.Fecha >= f.fecha_inicio
          AND
          (
              f.fecha_fin IS NULL
              OR h.Fecha <= f.fecha_fin
          )

        ORDER BY
            f.fecha_inicio DESC,
            f.id_factor DESC

    ) AS fac
),

/* ============================================================
   CÁLCULO DE TMS POR TORRE Y TURNO
   ============================================================ */
tms AS
(
    SELECT
        b.*,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TMH_CV008_A = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN b.Humedad_TM1_A IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                b.TMH_CV008_A
                * (1 - b.Humedad_TM1_A / 100.0)
        END AS TMS_CV008_A,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TMH_CV008_B = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN b.Humedad_TM1_B IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                b.TMH_CV008_B
                * (1 - b.Humedad_TM1_B / 100.0)
        END AS TMS_CV008_B,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TMH_CV108_A = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN b.Humedad_TM2_A IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                b.TMH_CV108_A
                * (1 - b.Humedad_TM2_A / 100.0)
        END AS TMS_CV108_A,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TMH_CV108_B = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN b.Humedad_TM2_B IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                b.TMH_CV108_B
                * (1 - b.Humedad_TM2_B / 100.0)
        END AS TMS_CV108_B

    FROM base AS b
)

SELECT
    Fecha,

    Flag_Apilado_Valido,

    Factor_Ajuste_Camiones_Usado,

    /* Humedad vigente al cierre del día */
    Humedad_TM1,
    Humedad_TM2,

    /* Humedad equivalente ponderada usando A/B */
    CASE
        WHEN TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia = 0
            THEN 0

        WHEN TMH_CV008_A > 0
         AND Humedad_TM1_A IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN TMH_CV008_B > 0
         AND Humedad_TM1_B IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN TMH_CV108_A > 0
         AND Humedad_TM2_A IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN TMH_CV108_B > 0
         AND Humedad_TM2_B IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            (
                  TMH_CV008_A * Humedad_TM1_A
                + TMH_CV008_B * Humedad_TM1_B
                + TMH_CV108_A * Humedad_TM2_A
                + TMH_CV108_B * Humedad_TM2_B
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia,
                0
            )
    END AS Humedad_Equivalente_Dia,

    /* Trazabilidad TM1 */
    Fecha_Humedad_TM1,
    Torre_Humedad_TM1,
    Turno_Humedad_TM1,
    Fuente_Humedad_TM1,

    /* Trazabilidad TM2 */
    Fecha_Humedad_TM2,
    Torre_Humedad_TM2,
    Turno_Humedad_TM2,
    Fuente_Humedad_TM2,

    /* TMH por torre */
    TMH_CV008_A AS TMH_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMH_CV008_B AS TMH_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B,
    TMH_CV108_A AS TMH_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMH_CV108_B AS TMH_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B,

    /* TMH total */
    TMH_Apilado_Total_A
        AS TMH_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A,

    TMH_Apilado_Total_B
        AS TMH_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B,

    TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia
        AS TMH_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_Dia,

    /* TMH con factor */
    TMH_Apilado_Total_A_Factor
        AS TMH_Total_Con_Factor_A,

    TMH_Apilado_Total_B_Factor
        AS TMH_Total_Con_Factor_B,

    TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia_Factor
        AS TMH_Total_Con_Factor_Dia,

    /* Controles del factor */
    TMH_Apilado_Total_A_Factor
      - TMH_Apilado_Total_A
        AS Check_Factor_TMH_A,

    TMH_Apilado_Total_B_Factor
      - TMH_Apilado_Total_B
        AS Check_Factor_TMH_B,

    TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia_Factor
      - TMH_Apilado_Total_Dia
        AS Check_Factor_TMH_Dia,

    /* TMS por torre */
    TMS_CV008_A AS TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMS_CV008_B AS TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B,
    TMS_CV108_A AS TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMS_CV108_B AS TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B,

    /* TMS turno A */
    CASE
        WHEN TMS_CV008_A IS NULL
          OR TMS_CV108_A IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            TMS_CV008_A
          + TMS_CV108_A
    END AS TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A,

    /* TMS turno B */
    CASE
        WHEN TMS_CV008_B IS NULL
          OR TMS_CV108_B IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            TMS_CV008_B
          + TMS_CV108_B
    END AS TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B,

    /* TMS día */
    CASE
        WHEN TMS_CV008_A IS NULL
          OR TMS_CV008_B IS NULL
          OR TMS_CV108_A IS NULL
          OR TMS_CV108_B IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
              TMS_CV008_A
            + TMS_CV008_B
            + TMS_CV108_A
            + TMS_CV108_B
    END AS TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_Dia,

    /* Flag de validez */
    CASE
        WHEN Flag_Apilado_Valido = 0
            THEN 0

        WHEN TMH_CV008_A > 0
         AND Humedad_TM1_A IS NULL
            THEN 0

        WHEN TMH_CV008_B > 0
         AND Humedad_TM1_B IS NULL
            THEN 0

        WHEN TMH_CV108_A > 0
         AND Humedad_TM2_A IS NULL
            THEN 0

        WHEN TMH_CV108_B > 0
         AND Humedad_TM2_B IS NULL
            THEN 0

        ELSE 1
    END AS Flag_TMS_Valido,

    /* Observación */
    CASE
        WHEN Flag_Apilado_Valido = 0
            THEN 'APILADO_TMH_INVALIDO_O_CERO'

        WHEN TMH_CV008_A > 0
         AND Humedad_TM1_A IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_HUMEDAD_REPRESENTATIVA_TM1'

        WHEN TMH_CV008_B > 0
         AND Humedad_TM1_B IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_HUMEDAD_REPRESENTATIVA_TM1'

        WHEN TMH_CV108_A > 0
         AND Humedad_TM2_A IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_HUMEDAD_REPRESENTATIVA_TM2'

        WHEN TMH_CV108_B > 0
         AND Humedad_TM2_B IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_HUMEDAD_REPRESENTATIVA_TM2'

        ELSE 'TMS_VALIDO_SEGUN_REGLA_PROVISIONAL'
    END AS Observacion_TMS

FROM tms;

sulfuro_base AS (

        CAST(v.parcela_columna AS varchar(20))     AS parcela_columna_origen,

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.flujos_reales_sulfuro AS src
    CROSS APPLY (

            (18, 50, 'parcela_18', src.parcela_18),
            (19, 51, 'parcela_19', src.parcela_19),
            (20, 52, 'parcela_20', src.parcela_20),
            (21, 53, 'parcela_21', src.parcela_21),
            (22, 54, 'parcela_22', src.parcela_22),
            (23, 55, 'parcela_23', src.parcela_23),
            (24, 56, 'parcela_24', src.parcela_24),
            (25, 57, 'parcela_25', src.parcela_25),
            (26, 58, 'parcela_26', src.parcela_26),
            (27, 59, 'parcela_27', src.parcela_27),
            (28, 60, 'parcela_28', src.parcela_28)
    ) AS v(nro_parcela_pad, parcela_id_global, parcela_columna, flujo_valor)
),
union_base AS (
    SELECT * FROM oxido_base
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM sulfuro_base
)
SELECT
    id_origen_registro,
    fecha_registro,
    fecha_dia,
    DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(fecha_dia), MONTH(fecha_dia), 1) AS mes_inicio,
    YEAR(fecha_dia)                                     AS anio,
    MONTH(fecha_dia)                                    AS mes,
    pad_id_legacy,
    pad_nombre,
    parcela_id_global,
    nro_parcela_pad,
    parcela_columna_origen,

    flujo_m3_d_raw,

    CASE
        WHEN flujo_m3_d_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN ABS(flujo_m3_d_raw) < CONVERT(decimal(18, 6), 0.000001)
            THEN CONVERT(decimal(18, 6), 0)
        ELSE flujo_m3_d_raw
    END AS flujo_m3_d,

    CAST(
        CASE WHEN flujo_m3_d_raw IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        AS bit
    ) AS flag_no_convertible,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN flujo_m3_d_raw IS NOT NULL
             AND ABS(flujo_m3_d_raw) < CONVERT(decimal(18, 6), 0.000001)
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
        AS bit
    ) AS flag_ruido_cercano_cero,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN flujo_m3_d_raw IS NOT NULL
             AND flujo_m3_d_raw < 0
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
        AS bit
    ) AS flag_valor_negativo,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN pad_id_legacy = 1 THEN 'inventar_SpcHidr.flujos_reales_oxido'
            WHEN pad_id_legacy = 2 THEN 'inventar_SpcHidr.flujos_reales_sulfuro'
            ELSE 'desconocido'
        END
        AS varchar(128)
    ) AS tabla_origen
FROM union_base;

CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr AS

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,

        s.Sal_Pesometros_TA,
        s.Sal_Pesometros_TB,
        s.Sal_Pesometros_Dia,

        s.Sal_Topografia_Dia,
        s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida,
        s.Flag_Sal_Ajuste_Valido,

        s.Sal_Ajustada_TA,
        s.Sal_Ajustada_TB,
        s.Sal_Ajustada_Dia,

        CASE
            WHEN t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE
                COALESCE(s.Sal_Ajustada_TA, 0)
                * t.TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A
                / NULLIF(t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A, 0)
        END AS Sal_Asignada_TM1_A,

        CASE
            WHEN t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE
                COALESCE(s.Sal_Ajustada_TA, 0)
                * t.TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A
                / NULLIF(t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A, 0)
        END AS Sal_Asignada_TM2_A,

        CASE
            WHEN t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE
                COALESCE(s.Sal_Ajustada_TB, 0)
                * t.TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B
                / NULLIF(t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B, 0)
        END AS Sal_Asignada_TM1_B,

        CASE
            WHEN t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE
                COALESCE(s.Sal_Ajustada_TB, 0)
                * t.TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B
                / NULLIF(t.TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B, 0)
        END AS Sal_Asignada_TM2_B

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_con_sal_srr t

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_sal_ajustada s
        ON s.Fecha = t.Fecha
),

tms_sin_sal AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE b.TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A - COALESCE(b.Sal_Asignada_TM1_A, 0)
        END AS TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE b.TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B - COALESCE(b.Sal_Asignada_TM1_B, 0)
        END AS TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE b.TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A - COALESCE(b.Sal_Asignada_TM2_A, 0)
        END AS TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE b.TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B - COALESCE(b.Sal_Asignada_TM2_B, 0)
        END AS TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B

    FROM base b
)

SELECT
    Fecha,

    Flag_Apilado_Valido,
    Flag_TMS_Valido,
    Observacion_TMS,

    Factor_Ajuste_Camiones_Usado,

    Humedad_TM1,
    Humedad_TM2,
    Humedad_Equivalente_Dia,

    Fecha_Humedad_TM1,
    Torre_Humedad_TM1,
    Turno_Humedad_TM1,
    Fuente_Humedad_TM1,

    Fecha_Humedad_TM2,
    Torre_Humedad_TM2,
    Turno_Humedad_TM2,
    Fuente_Humedad_TM2,

    TMH_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMH_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B,
    TMH_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMH_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B,

    TMH_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMH_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B,
    TMH_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_Dia,

    TMH_Total_Con_Factor_A,
    TMH_Total_Con_Factor_B,
    TMH_Total_Con_Factor_Dia,

    Check_Factor_TMH_A,
    Check_Factor_TMH_B,
    Check_Factor_TMH_Dia,

    TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B,
    TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B,

    TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_A,
    TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_B,
    TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_Dia,

    Sal_Pesometros_TA,
    Sal_Pesometros_TB,
    Sal_Pesometros_Dia,

    Sal_Topografia_Dia,

    Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida,
    Flag_Sal_Ajuste_Valido,

    Sal_Ajustada_TA,
    Sal_Ajustada_TB,
    Sal_Ajustada_Dia,

    Sal_Asignada_TM1_A,
    Sal_Asignada_TM1_B,
    Sal_Asignada_TM2_A,
    Sal_Asignada_TM2_B,

    Sal_Asignada_TM1_A + Sal_Asignada_TM2_A AS Sal_Distribuida_A,
    Sal_Asignada_TM1_B + Sal_Asignada_TM2_B AS Sal_Distribuida_B,

    Sal_Asignada_TM1_A
      + Sal_Asignada_TM1_B
      + Sal_Asignada_TM2_A
      + Sal_Asignada_TM2_B AS Sal_Distribuida_Dia,

    TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A,
    TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B,
    TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A,
    TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B,

    TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A
      + TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A AS TMS_Total_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A,

    TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B
      + TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B AS TMS_Total_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B,

    TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A
      + TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B
      + TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A
      + TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B AS TMS_Total_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_Dia,

    TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_Dia - COALESCE(Sal_Ajustada_Dia, 0)
        AS TMS_Total_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_Dia_Check,

    (Sal_Asignada_TM1_A + Sal_Asignada_TM2_A)
        - COALESCE(Sal_Ajustada_TA, 0) AS Check_Sal_A,

    (Sal_Asignada_TM1_B + Sal_Asignada_TM2_B)
        - COALESCE(Sal_Ajustada_TB, 0) AS Check_Sal_B,

    (
        Sal_Asignada_TM1_A
      + Sal_Asignada_TM1_B
      + Sal_Asignada_TM2_A
      + Sal_Asignada_TM2_B
    ) - COALESCE(Sal_Ajustada_Dia, 0) AS Check_Sal_Dia,

    (
        TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A
      + TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B
      + TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A
      + TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B
    )
    -
    (
        TMS_Total_Con_Sal_SRR_Dia - COALESCE(Sal_Ajustada_Dia, 0)
    ) AS Check_TMS_Sin_Sal_Dia

FROM tms_sin_sal;

name: vw_siir_riego_resumen_pad_diario

CREATE   VIEW siir_mart.vw_siir_riego_resumen_pad_diario
AS
SELECT
    f.fecha_dia,
    f.mes_inicio,
    f.anio,
    f.mes,
    f.pad_id_legacy,
    f.pad_nombre,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad_parcelas_esperadas,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.flujo_m3_d IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_parcelas_con_dato,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.flujo_m3_d > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_parcelas_activas,
    AVG(CAST(f.flujo_m3_d AS decimal(18,6))) AS flujo_promedio_m3_d,
    SUM(CAST(f.flujo_m3_d AS decimal(18,6))) AS flujo_total_m3_d,
    MIN(CAST(f.flujo_m3_d AS decimal(18,6))) AS flujo_min_m3_d,
    MAX(CAST(f.flujo_m3_d AS decimal(18,6))) AS flujo_max_m3_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.flag_valor_negativo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_valores_negativos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.flag_ruido_cercano_cero = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_valores_ruido_cero
FROM siir_curated.vw_siir_riego_flujo_parcela_diario AS f
GROUP BY
    f.fecha_dia,
    f.mes_inicio,
    f.anio,
    f.mes,
    f.pad_id_legacy,
    f.pad_nombre;

name: sp_calcular_datos_conciliados
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_calcular_balance_flujos_copy1]
(
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin    date
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0) NORMALIZAR FECHAS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @fecha_inicio > @fecha_fin
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @tmp date = @fecha_inicio;
        SET @fecha_inicio = @fecha_fin;
        SET @fecha_fin = @tmp;
    END;

    DECLARE @ff_mas_1 date = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin);

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) TABLA TEMPORAL DE RESULTADOS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#flujos_resultado') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #flujos_resultado;

    CREATE TABLE #flujos_resultado
    (
        codigo_flujo varchar(10)  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        TMS_Inicial  decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu_1     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        TMS_Final    decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu_2     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Tonelaje     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu       decimal(18,6) NULL
    );

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) FLUJOS BASE F1..F15, F20..F25
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    -- F1
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F1',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Origen = 'Stock'
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F2
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F2',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Origen = 'Mina'
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F3
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F3',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F4
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F4',
        ROUND(
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(CV006_tot)
                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                  AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
            ), 0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0),
            2
        ) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
            WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
              AND Fase <> 'SRR'
              AND Destino = 'CH01'
        ), 0) AS Ley_Cu;

    -- F5
    ;WITH
    tms_i AS (
        SELECT
            AVG(31.1017672705390 * ((v.niv_silo_a + v.niv_silo_b) / 2.0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0)) AS total_tms
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados v
        WHERE CAST(v.Fecha_turno AS date) = @fecha_inicio
    ),
    tms_f AS (
        SELECT
            AVG(31.1017672705390 * ((v.niv_silo_a + v.niv_silo_b) / 2.0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0)) AS total_tms
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados v
        WHERE CAST(v.Fecha_turno AS date) = @fecha_fin
    ),
    ley_i AS (
        SELECT
            (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0 AS ley_cu
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
        WHERE fecha = @fecha_inicio
          AND Fase <> 'SRR'
          AND Destino = 'CH01'
    ),
    ley_f AS (
        SELECT
            (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0 AS ley_cu
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
        WHERE fecha = @fecha_fin
          AND Fase <> 'SRR'
          AND Destino = 'CH01'
    )
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, TMS_Inicial, Ley_Cu_1, TMS_Final, Ley_Cu_2, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F5',
        COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0) AS TMS_Inicial,
        COALESCE(ley_i.ley_cu, ley_f.ley_cu, 0) AS Ley_Cu_1,
        COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) AS TMS_Final,
        COALESCE(ley_f.ley_cu, ley_i.ley_cu, 0) AS Ley_Cu_2,
        COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) - COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(
            (
                (
                    COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) * COALESCE(ley_f.ley_cu, ley_i.ley_cu, 0) / 100.0
                ) -
                (
                    COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0) * COALESCE(ley_i.ley_cu, ley_f.ley_cu, 0) / 100.0
                )
            ) / NULLIF(COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) - COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0), 0) * 100.0,
            0
        ) AS Ley_Cu
    FROM tms_i
    CROSS JOIN tms_f
    CROSS JOIN ley_i
    CROSS JOIN ley_f;

    -- F6
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F6',
        (
            ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd), 2)
                    FROM (
                        SELECT
                            SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0) AS tsd
                        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                        JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                            ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                        WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                          AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                          AND i.id_torre = 1
                        GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                    ) D
                ), 0
            )
            - ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT SUM(cv002_tot) * 0.97
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                    WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                ), 0
            )
            - ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT SUM(cv201_tot)
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                    WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                ), 0
            )
        ) AS Tonelaje,
        (
            (
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT SUM(D.Finos)
                        FROM (
                            SELECT
                                (SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0)) * AVG(i.CuT_Dia) / 100.0 AS Finos
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                                ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                              AND i.id_torre = 1
                            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                        ) D
                    ), 0
                )
                -
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT
                            (
                                SELECT SUM(cv002_tot) * 0.97
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                                WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                                  AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                            ) * (
                                SELECT SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
                                WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
                                  AND Fase = 'SRR'
                                  AND (Destino = 'prueba' OR Destino = 'CH01')
                            )
                    ), 0
                )
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                (
                    ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd), 2)
                            FROM (
                                SELECT
                                    SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0) AS tsd
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                                JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                                    ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                                WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                                  AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                                  AND i.id_torre = 1
                                GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                            ) D
                        ), 0
                    )
                    - ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT SUM(cv002_tot) * 0.97
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                            WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                        ), 0
                    )
                    - ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT SUM(cv201_tot)
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                            WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                        ), 0
                    )
                ), 0
            )
        ) * 100.0 AS Ley_Cu;

    -- F7
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F7',
        (
            ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd), 2)
                    FROM (
                        SELECT
                            SUM(vrdf.cv108_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0) AS tsd
                        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                        JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                            ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                        WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                          AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                          AND i.id_torre = 2
                        GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                    ) D
                ), 0
            )
            - ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT SUM(cv003_tot) * 0.97
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                    WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                ), 0
            )
            - ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT SUM(cv202_tot)
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                    WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                ), 0
            )
        ) AS Tonelaje,
        (
            (
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT SUM(D.Finos)
                        FROM (
                            SELECT
                                (SUM(vrdf.cv108_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0)) * AVG(i.CuT_Dia) / 100.0 AS Finos
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                                ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                              AND i.id_torre = 2
                            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                        ) D
                    ), 0
                )
                -
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT
                            (
                                SELECT SUM(cv003_tot) * 0.97
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                                WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                                  AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                            ) * (
                                SELECT SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
                                WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
                                  AND Fase = 'SRR'
                                  AND (Destino = 'prueba' OR Destino = 'CH01')
                            )
                    ), 0
                )
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                (
                    ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd), 2)
                            FROM (
                                SELECT
                                    SUM(vrdf.cv108_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0) AS tsd
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                                JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                                    ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                                WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                                  AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                                  AND i.id_torre = 2
                                GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                            ) D
                        ), 0
                    )
                    - ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT SUM(cv003_tot) * 0.97
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                            WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                        ), 0
                    )
                    - ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT SUM(cv202_tot)
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                            WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                        ), 0
                    )
                ), 0
            )
        ) * 100.0 AS Ley_Cu;

    -- F8
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F8',

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) F18
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp_f18_oficial') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #tmp_f18_oficial;

    ;WITH
    Tms_Apilado_Por_Modulo AS (
        SELECT
            mt.[campaña_id],
            mt.modulo_id,
            SUM(mt.TMS) AS tms_total_apilado
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.modulos_turnos mt
        GROUP BY mt.[campaña_id], mt.modulo_id
    ),
    Pct_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            CAST(crd.fecha AS date) AS fecha,
            crd.pad_id,
            crd.[campaña_id],
            crd.modulo_id,
            CASE
                WHEN MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje) < 0 THEN 0
                WHEN MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje) > 1 THEN 1
                ELSE MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje)
            END AS pct_clip
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_reclamo_diario crd
        WHERE CAST(crd.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
        GROUP BY CAST(crd.fecha AS date), crd.pad_id, crd.[campaña_id], crd.modulo_id
    ),
    Pct_Segmentado AS (
        SELECT
            p.*,
            CASE
                WHEN p.pct_clip < LAG(p.pct_clip, 1, 0) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pad_id
                    ORDER BY p.fecha
                ) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS reset_flag
        FROM Pct_Diario p
    ),
    Pct_Seg_Id AS (
        SELECT
            ps.*,
            SUM(ps.reset_flag) OVER (
                PARTITION BY ps.[campaña_id], ps.modulo_id, ps.pad_id
                ORDER BY ps.fecha
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) AS seg_id
        FROM Pct_Segmentado ps
    ),
    Avance_Incremental_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            p.fecha,
            p.pad_id,
            p.[campaña_id],
            p.modulo_id,
            p.pct_clip AS avance_porcentaje,
            CASE
                WHEN (p.pct_clip - LAG(p.pct_clip, 1, 0) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pad_id, p.seg_id
                    ORDER BY p.fecha
                )) < 0 THEN 0
                ELSE (p.pct_clip - LAG(p.pct_clip, 1, 0) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pad_id, p.seg_id
                    ORDER BY p.fecha
                ))
            END AS avance_incremental
        FROM Pct_Seg_Id p
    ),
    Volumen_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            CAST(fecha AS date) AS fecha,
            pad_id,
            [campaña_id],
            modulo_id,
            MAX(volumen_diario_m3) AS vol_m3
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_reclamo_diario
        WHERE CAST(fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
        GROUP BY CAST(fecha AS date), pad_id, [campaña_id], modulo_id
    ),
    Reclamo_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            DATEADD(DAY, -1, a.fecha) AS fecha_operacion,
            a.[campaña_id],
            a.modulo_id,
            (tm.tms_total_apilado * a.avance_incremental) AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario
        FROM Avance_Incremental_Diario a
        JOIN Tms_Apilado_Por_Modulo tm
          ON tm.[campaña_id] = a.[campaña_id]
         AND tm.modulo_id = a.modulo_id
        JOIN Volumen_Diario vd
          ON vd.fecha = a.fecha
         AND vd.pad_id = a.pad_id
         AND vd.[campaña_id] = a.[campaña_id]
         AND vd.modulo_id = a.modulo_id
        WHERE a.pad_id = 2
          AND vd.vol_m3 > 0
    ),
    Calculo_Tonelaje AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario), 0) AS Tonelaje
        FROM Reclamo_Diario r
        WHERE r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
    ),
    ModulosActivos AS (
        SELECT
            r.[campaña_id],
            r.modulo_id,
            SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario) AS tms_reclamado_modulo
        FROM Reclamo_Diario r
        WHERE r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
        GROUP BY r.[campaña_id], r.modulo_id
        HAVING SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario) > 0
    ),
    Calculo_Ley AS (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                (
                    SUM(ma.tms_reclamado_modulo * clr.ley_ripio / 100.0)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(ma.tms_reclamado_modulo), 0)
                ) * 100.0,
                0
            ) AS Ley_Cu
        FROM ModulosActivos ma
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.campaña c
            ON ma.[campaña_id] = c.[id_campaña]
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.modulo m
            ON ma.modulo_id = m.id_modulo
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.parcela p
            ON m.id_parcela = p.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.pad pd
            ON p.id_pad = pd.id_pad
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.control_ley_ripio clr
            ON clr.Campana = c.[numero_campaña]
           AND clr.Parcela = p.numero
           AND UPPER(clr.PAD) LIKE UPPER(pd.nombre) + '%'
        WHERE pd.id_pad = 2
    )
    SELECT
        t.Tonelaje,
        l.Ley_Cu
    INTO #tmp_f18_oficial
    FROM Calculo_Tonelaje t
    CROSS JOIN Calculo_Ley l;

    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT 'F18', Tonelaje, Ley_Cu
    FROM #tmp_f18_oficial;

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
    JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
        ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
    WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
      AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)

    GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)

          AND cad.volumen_diario_m3 > 0
    )

-- F120: flujo de agua make-up hacia la piscina Feed DUMP.
-- No existe medición directa por flujómetro, por lo que se estima por balance de masa/volumen del nodo.
-- Balance del nodo Feed DUMP:
--     Entradas = F52 + F120
--     Salidas  = F38 + F70 + F72
-- Despejando:
--     F120 = F38 + F70 + F72 - F52
-- donde:
--     F70 = variación de inventario del nodo en el período
--     F72 = pérdida por evaporación
-- y como:
--     F72 = 0.05 * F38
-- entonces:
--     F120 = 1.05 * F38 + F70 - F52
-- Si el resultado es negativo, se interpreta como que no se requiere make-up externo en el período,
-- dado que la entrada F52 y/o la disminución de inventario cubren las salidas del sistema.
-- F120
;WITH f38 AS (
    SELECT Tonelaje
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F38'
),
f70 AS (
    SELECT Tonelaje
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F70'
),
f52 AS (
    SELECT Tonelaje
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F52'
)
INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
SELECT
    'F120',
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(f38.Tonelaje, 0) * 1.05) + COALESCE(f70.Tonelaje, 0) - COALESCE(f52.Tonelaje, 0) < 0
            THEN 0
        ELSE (COALESCE(f38.Tonelaje, 0) * 1.05) + COALESCE(f70.Tonelaje, 0) - COALESCE(f52.Tonelaje, 0)
    END,
    0.0
FROM f38
CROSS JOIN f70
CROSS JOIN f52;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9) SALIDA FINAL
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        codigo_flujo AS Flujo,
        TMS_Inicial,
        Ley_Cu_1,
        TMS_Final,
        Ley_Cu_2,
        Tonelaje,
        Ley_Cu,
        Tonelaje * Ley_Cu / 100.0 AS FCu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    ORDER BY
        TRY_CONVERT(int, REPLACE(codigo_flujo, 'F', ''));

END;

-- inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_turnos_dia source

CREATE VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_turnos_dia AS

WITH ValoresLimite AS (
    SELECT
        fecha_turno,

        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 8  THEN cv201_tot END) AS cv201_0800,
        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 20 THEN cv201_tot END) AS cv201_2000,

        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 8  THEN cv202_tot END) AS cv202_0800,
        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 20 THEN cv202_tot END) AS cv202_2000,

        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 8  THEN cv001_tot END) AS cv001_0800,
        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 20 THEN cv001_tot END) AS cv001_2000,

        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 8  THEN cv002_tot END) AS cv002_0800,
        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 20 THEN cv002_tot END) AS cv002_2000,

        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 8  THEN cv003_tot END) AS cv003_0800,
        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 20 THEN cv003_tot END) AS cv003_2000,

        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 8  THEN cv008_tot END) AS cv008_0800,
        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 20 THEN cv008_tot END) AS cv008_2000,

        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 8  THEN cv108_tot END) AS cv108_0800,
        MAX(CASE WHEN DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) = 20 THEN cv108_tot END) AS cv108_2000

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados
    WHERE DATEPART(hour, fecha_inicial) IN (8,20)
    GROUP BY fecha_turno
),

CalculosFinales AS (
    SELECT
        vl.fecha_turno AS Fecha,

        LEAD(vl.cv201_0800) OVER (ORDER BY vl.fecha_turno) AS cv201_0800_next,
        LEAD(vl.cv202_0800) OVER (ORDER BY vl.fecha_turno) AS cv202_0800_next,
        LEAD(vl.cv001_0800) OVER (ORDER BY vl.fecha_turno) AS cv001_0800_next,
        LEAD(vl.cv002_0800) OVER (ORDER BY vl.fecha_turno) AS cv002_0800_next,
        LEAD(vl.cv003_0800) OVER (ORDER BY vl.fecha_turno) AS cv003_0800_next,
        LEAD(vl.cv008_0800) OVER (ORDER BY vl.fecha_turno) AS cv008_0800_next,
        LEAD(vl.cv108_0800) OVER (ORDER BY vl.fecha_turno) AS cv108_0800_next,

        vl.*
    FROM ValoresLimite vl
),

Resultados AS (
    SELECT
        cf.Fecha,

        /* =========================
           CV201
           ========================= */
        (cf.cv201_2000 - cf.cv201_0800) / 1000.0 AS cv201_tot_TurnoA,
        (cf.cv201_0800_next - cf.cv201_2000) / 1000.0 AS cv201_tot_TurnoB,

        /* =========================
           CV202
           ========================= */
        (cf.cv202_2000 - cf.cv202_0800) / 1000.0 AS cv202_tot_TurnoA,
        (cf.cv202_0800_next - cf.cv202_2000) / 1000.0 AS cv202_tot_TurnoB,

        /* =========================
           CV001
           ========================= */
        (cf.cv001_2000 - cf.cv001_0800) AS cv001_tot_TurnoA,
        (cf.cv001_0800_next - cf.cv001_2000) AS cv001_tot_TurnoB,

        /* =========================
           CV002
           ========================= */
        (cf.cv002_2000 - cf.cv002_0800) AS cv002_tot_TurnoA,
        (cf.cv002_0800_next - cf.cv002_2000) AS cv002_tot_TurnoB,

        /* =========================
           CV003
           ========================= */
        (cf.cv003_2000 - cf.cv003_0800) AS cv003_tot_TurnoA,
        (cf.cv003_0800_next - cf.cv003_2000) AS cv003_tot_TurnoB,

        /* =========================
           008 NETA (008 - 201)
           ========================= */
        ((cf.cv008_2000 - cf.cv008_0800)
         - ((cf.cv201_2000 - cf.cv201_0800) / 1000.0)
        ) AS cv008_ton_TurnoA,

        ((cf.cv008_0800_next - cf.cv008_2000)
         - ((cf.cv201_0800_next - cf.cv201_2000) / 1000.0)
        ) AS cv008_ton_TurnoB,

        /* =========================
           108 NETA (108 - 202)
           ========================= */
        ((cf.cv108_2000 - cf.cv108_0800)
         - ((cf.cv202_2000 - cf.cv202_0800) / 1000.0)
        ) AS cv108_ton_TurnoA,

        ((cf.cv108_0800_next - cf.cv108_2000)
         - ((cf.cv202_0800_next - cf.cv202_2000) / 1000.0)
        ) AS cv108_ton_TurnoB

    FROM CalculosFinales cf
    WHERE
        cf.Fecha IS NOT NULL
        AND cf.cv201_0800_next IS NOT NULL
        AND cf.cv008_0800_next IS NOT NULL
        AND cf.cv108_0800_next IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    r.Fecha,

    r.cv201_tot_TurnoA, r.cv201_tot_TurnoB, (r.cv201_tot_TurnoA + r.cv201_tot_TurnoB) AS cv201_tot_Dia,
    r.cv202_tot_TurnoA, r.cv202_tot_TurnoB, (r.cv202_tot_TurnoA + r.cv202_tot_TurnoB) AS cv202_tot_Dia,
    r.cv001_tot_TurnoA, r.cv001_tot_TurnoB, (r.cv001_tot_TurnoA + r.cv001_tot_TurnoB) AS cv001_tot_Dia,
    r.cv002_tot_TurnoA, r.cv002_tot_TurnoB, (r.cv002_tot_TurnoA + r.cv002_tot_TurnoB) AS cv002_tot_Dia,
    r.cv003_tot_TurnoA, r.cv003_tot_TurnoB, (r.cv003_tot_TurnoA + r.cv003_tot_TurnoB) AS cv003_tot_Dia,

    r.cv008_ton_TurnoA, r.cv008_ton_TurnoB,
    (r.cv008_ton_TurnoA + r.cv008_ton_TurnoB) AS cv008_ton_Dia,

    r.cv108_ton_TurnoA, r.cv108_ton_TurnoB,
    (r.cv108_ton_TurnoA + r.cv108_ton_TurnoB) AS cv108_ton_Dia,

    /* =========================
       Apilado NETO
       ========================= */
    (r.cv008_ton_TurnoA + r.cv108_ton_TurnoA) AS apilado_ton_TurnoA,
    (r.cv008_ton_TurnoB + r.cv108_ton_TurnoB) AS apilado_ton_TurnoB,
    ((r.cv008_ton_TurnoA + r.cv108_ton_TurnoA)
     + (r.cv008_ton_TurnoB + r.cv108_ton_TurnoB)) AS apilado_ton_Dia

FROM Resultados r;

name: vw_siir_riego_resumen_parcela_semanal
definition:
CREATE   VIEW siir_mart.vw_siir_riego_resumen_parcela_semanal
AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        f.fecha_dia,
        DATEADD(day, - (DATEDIFF(day, '19000101', f.fecha_dia) % 7), f.fecha_dia) AS semana_inicio,
        f.pad_id_legacy,
        f.pad_nombre,
        f.parcela_id_global,
        f.nro_parcela_pad,
        f.flujo_m3_d,
        f.flag_valor_negativo,
        f.flag_ruido_cercano_cero
    FROM siir_curated.vw_siir_riego_flujo_parcela_diario AS f
)
SELECT
    semana_inicio,
    YEAR(semana_inicio) AS anio_semana,
    MONTH(semana_inicio) AS mes_semana,
    pad_id_legacy,
    pad_nombre,
    parcela_id_global,
    nro_parcela_pad,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad_dias_semana,
    SUM(CASE WHEN flujo_m3_d IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_dias_con_dato,
    SUM(CASE WHEN flujo_m3_d > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_dias_activa,
    AVG(CAST(flujo_m3_d AS decimal(18,6))) AS flujo_promedio_m3_d,
    SUM(CAST(flujo_m3_d AS decimal(18,6))) AS flujo_total_m3_semana,
    MIN(CAST(flujo_m3_d AS decimal(18,6))) AS flujo_min_m3_d,
    MAX(CAST(flujo_m3_d AS decimal(18,6))) AS flujo_max_m3_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN flag_valor_negativo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_valores_negativos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN flag_ruido_cercano_cero = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_valores_ruido_cero
FROM base
GROUP BY
    semana_inicio,
    pad_id_legacy,
    pad_nombre,
    parcela_id_global,
    nro_parcela_pad;

-- Generado por scripts/generar_sp_modelo6_v2.py. No modifica los SP actuales.
-- No necesita ejecutar ni instalar los procedimientos anteriores.
CREATE   PROCEDURE [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_calcular_balance_flujos_modelo6_v2]
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin date,
    @caso_id int = NULL,
    @debug bit = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF @fecha_inicio IS NULL OR @fecha_fin IS NULL
        THROW 51002, 'Se requieren ambas fechas.', 1;
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0) NORMALIZAR FECHAS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @fecha_inicio > @fecha_fin
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @tmp date = @fecha_inicio;
        SET @fecha_inicio = @fecha_fin;
        SET @fecha_fin = @tmp;
    END;
    DECLARE @ff_mas_1 date = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin);
    -- Dias del periodo a balancear (inclusive), usado por el criterio de evaporacion (seccion 8, F61/F62/F64/F71/F72/F74/F75/F77)
    DECLARE @dias_periodo int = DATEDIFF(DAY, @fecha_inicio, @fecha_fin) + 1;

DECLARE @FechaInicioContingenciaTUM date = '2026-09-01';

DECLARE @FechaInicioContingenciaPeriodo date =
    CASE
        WHEN @fecha_inicio > @FechaInicioContingenciaTUM
            THEN @fecha_inicio
        ELSE @FechaInicioContingenciaTUM
    END;

/* ================================================================
   ÚLTIMO DÍA OPERACIONAL COMPLETO

   El balance no debe exigir PI/TUM para:
       - el día operacional actualmente abierto
       - días futuros incluidos en @fecha_fin

   Ejemplo:
       si hoy es 10-09,
       el último día operacional completamente cerrado es 09-09.
================================================================ */
DECLARE @UltimoDiaOperacionalCompleto date =
    CASE
        /* Desde las 08:00 de hoy, ayer ya está completamente cerrado */
        WHEN CAST(GETDATE() AS time) >= '08:00:00'
            THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))

        /* Antes de las 08:00, el día operacional de ayer todavía está abierto */
        ELSE DATEADD(DAY, -2, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
    END;

DECLARE @FechaFinContingenciaPeriodo date =
    CASE
        WHEN @fecha_fin < @UltimoDiaOperacionalCompleto
            THEN @fecha_fin
        ELSE @UltimoDiaOperacionalCompleto
    END;

    -- 1) TABLA TEMPORAL DE RESULTADOS

    (
        codigo_flujo varchar(64)  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,

       La sustitucion es por DIA COMPLETO.
       Si existe MOV_CAM para una fecha, no se mezcla POWER BI
       para esa misma fecha.
================================================================ */

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Base_BASE_CHANCADO;

;WITH FechasMovCam AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(m.fecha AS date) AS Fecha
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam m
    WHERE CAST(m.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND m.Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND m.Destino = 'CH01'
),
Base_BASE_CHANCADO AS
(
    /* ============================================================
       1. FUENTE OFICIAL: MOV_CAM
       ============================================================ */
    SELECT
        CAST(m.fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

CASE
    WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.Origen, ''))))
         IN ('STOCK', 'REMANEJO')
        THEN 'Stock'

    WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.Origen, ''))))
         IN ('MINA', 'EXPIT')
        THEN 'Mina'

    ELSE m.Origen
END AS Origen,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, m.Ton)     AS Ton,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, m.CuTG00)  AS CuTG00,

        CAST('MOV_CAM' AS varchar(30)) AS Fuente

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam m

    WHERE CAST(m.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND m.Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND m.Destino = 'CH01'


    UNION ALL


    /* ============================================================
       2. FALLBACK: POWER BI
       Solo dias donde no existe MOV_CAM
       ============================================================ */
    SELECT
        CAST(p.fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.tipo_movimiento, ''))))
                 = 'REMANEJO'
                THEN 'Stock'

            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.tipo_movimiento, ''))))
                 = 'EXPIT'
                THEN 'Mina'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS Origen,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, p.tonelaje_descarga_tms) AS Ton,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, p.cut_ponderado)          AS CuTG00,

        CAST('POWERBI_PRELIMINAR' AS varchar(30)) AS Fuente

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam_powerbi p

    WHERE CAST(p.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin

      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.fase, '')))) <> 'SRR'

      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.destino_descarga, ''))))
          = 'CH01'

      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM FechasMovCam mc
          WHERE mc.Fecha = CAST(p.fecha AS date)
      )
)

SELECT
    Fecha,
    Origen,
    Ton,
    CuTG00,
    Fuente
INTO #Base_BASE_CHANCADO
FROM Base_BASE_CHANCADO;


/* ================================================================
   F2 - STOCK
   MOV_CAM  : Origen = Stock
   POWER BI : tipo_movimiento = REMANEJO
================================================================ */
INSERT INTO #valores_m6
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT

    ISNULL(
        SUM(Ton),
        0

    ISNULL(
        (
            SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0)
            /

        ) * 100.0,

    )

FROM #Base_BASE_CHANCADO
WHERE Origen = 'Stock';

/* ================================================================
   F3 - TOTAL ALIMENTACION CH01 NO SRR

   Mantiene la logica del SP actual:
   F3 no filtra por Origen.
================================================================ */
INSERT INTO #valores_m6
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu

        ) * 100.0,

FROM #Base_BASE_CHANCADO;

    
    -- Público F3 = F1 + F2, después de sus aportes; fino ponderado.
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #valores_m6 WHERE codigo_flujo IN ('F2','F1')
        HAVING COUNT(Tonelaje)=2 AND COUNT(Ley_Cu)=2 AND SUM(Tonelaje)=0
        AND ABS(SUM(Tonelaje*Ley_Cu/100.0))>0.000001)
        THROW 51012, 'F3: la suma tiene masa cero y fino distinto de cero.', 1;
    UPDATE r SET Tonelaje=s.masa,
        Ley_Cu=CASE WHEN s.masa=0 THEN 0 ELSE s.fino*100.0/s.masa END
    FROM #valores_m6 r CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(Tonelaje)=2 THEN SUM(Tonelaje) END masa,
            CASE WHEN COUNT(Tonelaje)=2 AND COUNT(Ley_Cu)=2
                 THEN SUM(Tonelaje*Ley_Cu/100.0) END fino
        FROM #valores_m6 WHERE codigo_flujo IN ('F2','F1')) s
    WHERE r.codigo_flujo='F3';

/* ================================================================
   BASE CONTINGENCIA CORREAS PARA BALANCE
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Equipos:
       CHANCADOR_CV006
       PRINCIPAL_CV008
       PRINCIPAL_CV108

   Metodología temporal:
       < 01-09-2026
           fuente histórica vigente

       >= 01-09-2026 y día operacional cerrado
           fuente resuelta PI/TUM por turno

       Día operacional abierto / futuro
           se conserva la fuente PI histórica/provisional

   IMPORTANTE:
       - No incluye CV025.
       - Un valor resuelto = 0 es válido.
       - Para días cerrados no se permite continuar con un
         equipo-turno SIN_RESOLVER.
================================================================ */

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Contingencia_Correas;

CREATE TABLE #Contingencia_Correas
(
    fecha_operacional     date          NOT NULL,
    turno                 char(1)       NOT NULL,
    equipo_codigo         varchar(40)   NOT NULL,
    estado_tecnico_pi     varchar(50)   NULL,
    fuente_resuelta       varchar(30)   NULL,
    valor_final_resuelto  decimal(28,6) NULL,
    tipo_tum              varchar(30)   NULL,
    motivo_decision       varchar(80)   NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (fecha_operacional, turno, equipo_codigo)
);

IF @FechaInicioContingenciaPeriodo <= @FechaFinContingenciaPeriodo
BEGIN
    ;WITH Fechas AS
    (
        SELECT @FechaInicioContingenciaPeriodo AS fecha_operacional

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATEADD(DAY, 1, fecha_operacional)
        FROM Fechas
        WHERE fecha_operacional < @FechaFinContingenciaPeriodo
    ),
    Turnos AS
    (
        SELECT CAST('A' AS char(1)) AS turno
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CAST('B' AS char(1))
    ),
    Equipos AS
    (
        SELECT CAST('CHANCADOR_CV006' AS varchar(40)) AS equipo_codigo
        UNION ALL SELECT CAST('PRINCIPAL_CV008' AS varchar(40))
        UNION ALL SELECT CAST('PRINCIPAL_CV108' AS varchar(40))
    )
    INSERT INTO #Contingencia_Correas
    (
        fecha_operacional,
        turno,
        equipo_codigo,
        estado_tecnico_pi,
        fuente_resuelta,
        valor_final_resuelto,
        tipo_tum,
        motivo_decision
    )
    SELECT
        f.fecha_operacional,
        t.turno,
        e.equipo_codigo,
        r.estado_tecnico_pi,
        r.fuente_resuelta,
        r.valor_final_resuelto,
        r.tipo_tum,
        r.motivo_decision
    FROM Fechas AS f
    CROSS JOIN Turnos AS t
    CROSS JOIN Equipos AS e
    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_totalizador_resuelto_turno AS r
        ON  r.fecha_operacional = f.fecha_operacional
        AND r.turno             = t.turno
        AND r.equipo_codigo     = e.equipo_codigo
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #Contingencia_Correas
        WHERE fuente_resuelta IS NULL
           OR fuente_resuelta = 'SIN_RESOLVER'
           OR valor_final_resuelto IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51002,
        'Contingencia correas: existen turnos cerrados sin resolver PI/TUM para CV006/CV008/CV108. El balance no puede continuar con información parcial.',
        1;
    END;
END;

/* ================================================================
   BASE TMH PRINCIPAL PARA BALANCE
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   TM1 = PRINCIPAL_CV008
   TM2 = PRINCIPAL_CV108

   Esta tabla temporal centraliza únicamente la FUENTE de TMH.
   Las reglas posteriores de humedad, CuT, TMS, FCu y PAD no cambian.
================================================================ */

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMH_Principal_Balance;

CREATE TABLE #TMH_Principal_Balance
(
    Fecha       date        NOT NULL,
    Turno       char(1)     NOT NULL,
    TM          varchar(3)  NOT NULL,
    TMH         float       NULL,
    Fuente_TMH  varchar(30) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Fecha, Turno, TM)
);

/* Histórico pre-cutover + día operacional abierto/futuro. */
INSERT INTO #TMH_Principal_Balance
(
    Fecha,
    Turno,
    TM,
    TMH,
    Fuente_TMH
)
SELECT
    v.Fecha,
    x.Turno,
    x.TM,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, x.TMH), 0)) > 150000
            THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, x.TMH), 0)
    END AS TMH,
    CASE
        WHEN v.Fecha < @FechaInicioContingenciaTUM
            THEN 'PI_HISTORICO'
        ELSE 'PI_DIA_ABIERTO'
    END AS Fuente_TMH
FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_datos_apilado_tmh_v2 AS v
CROSS APPLY
(
    VALUES
        ('A', 'TM1', v.TMH_CV008_A),
        ('B', 'TM1', v.TMH_CV008_B),
        ('A', 'TM2', v.TMH_CV108_A),
        ('B', 'TM2', v.TMH_CV108_B)
) AS x(Turno, TM, TMH)
WHERE v.Fecha >= @fecha_inicio
  AND v.Fecha < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
  AND
  (
         v.Fecha < @FechaInicioContingenciaTUM
      OR v.Fecha > @FechaFinContingenciaPeriodo
  );

/* Días cerrados desde el cutover: PI/TUM resuelto. */
INSERT INTO #TMH_Principal_Balance
(
    Fecha,
    Turno,
    TM,
    TMH,
    Fuente_TMH
)
SELECT
    c.fecha_operacional,
    c.turno,
    CASE
        WHEN c.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008' THEN 'TM1'
        WHEN c.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108' THEN 'TM2'
    END AS TM,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(TRY_CONVERT(float, c.valor_final_resuelto)) > 150000
            THEN 0
        ELSE TRY_CONVERT(float, c.valor_final_resuelto)
    END AS TMH,
    c.fuente_resuelta AS Fuente_TMH
FROM #Contingencia_Correas AS c
WHERE c.equipo_codigo IN ('PRINCIPAL_CV008','PRINCIPAL_CV108');

/* ================================================================
   F4 - DESCARGA SECA CHANCADO CV006 HACIA SILO
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   TONELAJE:
       < 01-09-2026 / día abierto:
           vista_resumen_datos_filtrados.CV006_tot

       >= 01-09-2026, día operacional cerrado:
           #Contingencia_Correas / CHANCADOR_CV006
           (PI prioritario; TUM sólo en contingencia)

       Humedad : 2.5 %
       TMS     : TMH resuelto * 0.975

   LEY Cu:
       Se utiliza la Ley_Cu calculada para F3.

       F3 ya resuelve la jerarquia:
           1. MOV_CAM
           2. POWER BI preliminar cuando falta MOV_CAM

       Esto es equivalente a la logica historica de F4, ya que
       F3 y F4 utilizaban exactamente la misma ley de cabeza:
           Fase <> 'SRR'
           Destino = 'CH01'

   IMPORTANTE:
       Power BI NO reemplaza el tonelaje de F4.
       El tonelaje de F4 sigue viniendo de CV006.
================================================================ */

INSERT INTO #valores_m6
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F4',

    ROUND
    (
        (
            /* Histórico pre-cutover + día operacional abierto/futuro. */
            COALESCE
            (
                (
                    SELECT SUM(TRY_CONVERT(float, v.CV006_tot))
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados AS v
                    WHERE v.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND v.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                      AND
                      (
                             v.fecha_turno < @FechaInicioContingenciaTUM
                          OR v.fecha_turno >= DATEADD(DAY, 1, @FechaFinContingenciaPeriodo)
                      )
                ),
                0
            )
            +
            /* Días cerrados desde el cutover: PI/TUM resuelto por turno. */
            COALESCE
            (
                (
                    SELECT SUM(TRY_CONVERT(float, c.valor_final_resuelto))
                    FROM #Contingencia_Correas AS c
                    WHERE c.equipo_codigo = 'CHANCADOR_CV006'
                ),
                0
            )
        ) * 0.975,
        2
    ) AS Tonelaje,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT f3.Ley_Cu
            FROM #valores_m6 f3
            WHERE f3.codigo_flujo = 'F3'
        ),
        0
    ) AS Ley_Cu;
    
    END;

    -- ETAPA 5; lee resultados M6: F8
    IF @etapa=5

/* ================================================================
   F8 - DELTA INVENTARIO CHANCADO
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   NUEVA FUENTE DE INVENTARIO:
       inventar_SpcHidr.v_inventario_chancado_test

   INVENTARIO:
       Apertura periodo:
           Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior de @fecha_inicio

       Cierre periodo:
           Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS de @fecha_fin

       Delta:
           Cierre - Apertura

   La vista ya incorpora:
       - Silo A-B
       - Harnero A-E
       - Chancado A-E
       - Tolva de compensacion
       - Humedad de inventario
       - Validacion Archive Value
       - Continuidad diaria / semilla

   LEY Cu:
       Se mantiene la metodologia vigente del F8:
       ley CH01 no-SRR en los extremos.

       La fuente de ley respeta ahora:
           MOV_CAM > POWERBI_PRELIMINAR

   IMPORTANTE:
       #Base_BASE_CHANCADO debe seguir existiendo hasta terminar F8.
================================================================ */

;WITH
inv_i AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(i.Flag_Continuidad_Diaria) = 1
             AND MAX(i.Flag_Inventario_Valido) = 1
            THEN MAX(
                TRY_CONVERT(
                    float,
                    i.Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior
                )
            )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS total_tms

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_inventario_chancado_test i

    WHERE i.Fecha = @fecha_inicio
),

inv_f AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(i.Flag_Inventario_Valido) = 1
            THEN MAX(
                TRY_CONVERT(
                    float,
                    i.Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS
                )
            )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS total_tms

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_inventario_chancado_test i

    WHERE i.Fecha = @fecha_fin
),

/* ============================================================
   Ley inicial

   Utiliza la misma base normalizada F2-F3:
       MOV_CAM cuando existe
       POWER BI cuando falta MOV_CAM
   ============================================================ */
ley_i AS
(
    SELECT
        (
            SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0)
            /
            NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
        ) * 100.0 AS ley_cu

    FROM #Base_BASE_CHANCADO

    WHERE Fecha = @fecha_inicio
),

/* ============================================================
   Ley final
   ============================================================ */
ley_f AS
(
    SELECT
        (
            SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0)
            /
            NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
        ) * 100.0 AS ley_cu

    FROM #Base_BASE_CHANCADO

    WHERE Fecha = @fecha_fin
)

INSERT INTO #valores_m6
(
    codigo_flujo,
    TMS_Inicial,
    Ley_Cu_1,
    TMS_Final,
    Ley_Cu_2,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F8',

    /* Inventario apertura */
    inv_i.total_tms AS TMS_Inicial,

    /* Ley apertura */
    CASE
        WHEN inv_i.total_tms IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(
            ley_i.ley_cu,
            ley_f.ley_cu
        )
    END AS Ley_Cu_1,

    /* Inventario cierre */
    inv_f.total_tms AS TMS_Final,

    /* Ley cierre */
    CASE
        WHEN inv_f.total_tms IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(
            ley_f.ley_cu,
            ley_i.ley_cu
        )
    END AS Ley_Cu_2,

    /* Delta inventario */
    CASE
        WHEN inv_i.total_tms IS NULL
          OR inv_f.total_tms IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            inv_f.total_tms
            - inv_i.total_tms
    END AS Tonelaje,

    /* ============================================================
       Ley equivalente del delta de inventario
       ============================================================ */
    CASE
        WHEN inv_i.total_tms IS NULL
          OR inv_f.total_tms IS NULL
          OR (inv_f.total_tms - inv_i.total_tms) = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            (
                (
                    inv_f.total_tms
                    *
                    COALESCE(
                        ley_f.ley_cu,
                        ley_i.ley_cu
                    )
                    / 100.0
                )
                -
                (
                    inv_i.total_tms
                    *
                    COALESCE(
                        ley_i.ley_cu,
                        ley_f.ley_cu
                    )
                    / 100.0
                )
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                inv_f.total_tms
                - inv_i.total_tms,
                0
            )
            * 100.0
    END AS Ley_Cu

FROM inv_i
CROSS JOIN inv_f
CROSS JOIN ley_i
CROSS JOIN ley_f;

    
    -- Público F5 y F8 comparten base histórica F5, no sus aportes manuales.
    INSERT #valores_m6
    SELECT 'F5',TMS_Inicial,Ley_Cu_1,TMS_Final,Ley_Cu_2,Tonelaje,Ley_Cu
    FROM #valores_m6 WHERE codigo_flujo='F8';
    
    END;

    -- ETAPA 6; lee resultados M6: fuentes operacionales / inicialización
    IF @etapa=6
