CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_informe_tm_lab_base
AS
SELECT
    Torre,
    Fecha,
    Hora,
    Turno AS turno_lab,

    ts_toma_muestra =
        CASE
            WHEN Fecha IS NULL OR Hora IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE DATETIMEFROMPARTS(
                YEAR(Fecha), MONTH(Fecha), DAY(Fecha),
                DATEPART(HOUR, Hora), DATEPART(MINUTE, Hora), DATEPART(SECOND, Hora),
                0
            )
        END,

    turno_op =
        CASE
            WHEN Turno IN ('A','B') THEN Turno
            WHEN Hora IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN Hora >= '08:00:00' AND Hora < '20:00:00' THEN 'A'
            ELSE 'B'
        END,

    fecha_turno =
        CASE
            WHEN Fecha IS NULL OR Hora IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN (
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno IN ('A','B') THEN Turno
                    WHEN Hora >= '08:00:00' AND Hora < '20:00:00' THEN 'A'
                    ELSE 'B'
                END
            ) = 'B'
            AND Hora < '08:00:00'
            THEN DATEADD(day, -1, Fecha)
            ELSE Fecha
        END,

    Peso_Quimico_kg,
    Peso_Total_kg
FROM inventar_SpcHidr.Informe_TM_lab;

name: fn_generador_reporte_diario
definition:
CREATE   FUNCTION
    [inventar_SpcHidr].[fn_generador_reporte_diario]
(
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin    date
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    WITH base_turno AS
    (
        SELECT
            Fecha,
            Turno,

            Campania,
            Material,
            Modulo,
            Avance,

            Apilado_TMS_Real,

            STOCK,
            MINA,
            SRR,

            CuT_Real,
            CuS_Real,
            CO3_Real,
            CuFe_Real,
            FeT_Real,
            FeS_Real,
            ConsH_Real,

            Malla_Menos_1_2_Real,
            Malla_Menos_100_Real,
            CaolBeta_Real

        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[reporte_turno_cache]

        WHERE Fecha >= @fecha_inicio
          AND Fecha <  @fecha_fin
    ),

    diario_base AS
    (
        SELECT
            Fecha,

            MAX(Campania) AS Campania,
            MAX(Material) AS Material,
            MAX(Modulo)   AS Modulo,
            MAX(Avance)   AS Avance,

            COUNT(DISTINCT Turno) AS Cantidad_Turnos,

            CASE
                WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT Campania) <= 1
                 AND COUNT(DISTINCT Material) <= 1
                 AND COUNT(DISTINCT Modulo) <= 1
                THEN 'OK'
                ELSE 'REVISAR'
            END AS Flag_Contexto_Dia,

            SUM(COALESCE(Apilado_TMS_Real, 0))
                AS Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia,

            /* Distribución STOCK / MINA / SRR */
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN STOCK IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * STOCK
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN STOCK IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS STOCK_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN MINA IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * MINA
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN MINA IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS MINA_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN SRR IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * SRR
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN SRR IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS SRR_Dia,

            /* Análisis químicos */
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CuT_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CuT_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CuT_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CuT_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CuS_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CuS_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CuS_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CuS_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CO3_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CO3_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CO3_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CO3_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CuFe_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CuFe_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CuFe_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CuFe_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN FeT_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * FeT_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN FeT_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS FeT_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN FeS_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * FeS_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN FeS_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS FeS_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN ConsH_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * ConsH_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN ConsH_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS ConsH_Real_Dia,

            /* Granulometrías y NIR */
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN Malla_Menos_1_2_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * Malla_Menos_1_2_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN Malla_Menos_1_2_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS Malla_Menos_1_2_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN Malla_Menos_100_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * Malla_Menos_100_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN Malla_Menos_100_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS Malla_Menos_100_Real_Dia,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN CaolBeta_Real IS NOT NULL
                    THEN Apilado_TMS_Real * CaolBeta_Real
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN CaolBeta_Real IS NOT NULL
                        THEN Apilado_TMS_Real
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ) AS CaolBeta_Real_Dia

        FROM base_turno

        GROUP BY Fecha
    ),

    diario_derivado AS
    (
        SELECT
            d.*,

            CASE
                WHEN d.CuT_Real_Dia IS NULL
                  OR d.CuT_Real_Dia = 0
                  OR d.CuS_Real_Dia IS NULL
                THEN NULL
                ELSE d.CuS_Real_Dia / d.CuT_Real_Dia
            END AS Solubilidad_Real_Dia

        FROM diario_base d
    ),

    programa AS
    (
        SELECT
            fecha AS Fecha,

            CAST(
    MAX(ton)
    AS decimal(18,6)
) AS Apilado_TMS_Programa,
            MAX(cut)       AS CuT_Programa,
            MAX(cus)       AS CuS_Programa,
            MAX(co3)       AS CO3_Programa,
            MAX(cl_acido)  AS ConsH_Programa,
            MAX(cufe)      AS CuFe_Programa,
            MAX(porc_1_2)  AS Malla_Menos_1_2_Programa,
            MAX(malla_100) AS Malla_Menos_100_Programa,
            MAX(betaclay)  AS CaolBeta_Programa

        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[plan_semanal_reporte_turno]

        WHERE fecha >= @fecha_inicio
          AND fecha <  @fecha_fin

        GROUP BY fecha
    ),

    plan_mensual AS
    (
        SELECT
            fecha AS Fecha,

            MAX(apilamiento) AS Apilado_TMS_Plan,
            MAX(cut)         AS CuT_Plan,
            MAX(cus)         AS CuS_Plan,
            MAX(co3)         AS CO3_Plan,
            MAX(cl_acido)    AS ConsH_Plan,
            MAX(cufe)        AS CuFe_Plan,
            MAX(malla_100)   AS Malla_Menos_100_Plan,
            MAX(caol_beta)   AS CaolBeta_Plan

        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[plan_mensual_reporte_turno]

        WHERE fecha >= @fecha_inicio
          AND fecha <  @fecha_fin

        GROUP BY fecha
    )

    SELECT
        d.Fecha,

        d.Campania,
        d.Material AS Material_Operacion,

        CASE
            WHEN d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia <= 0.25
                THEN 'SULFURO'

            WHEN d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia <= 0.50
                THEN 'MIXTO'

            ELSE 'OXIDO'
        END AS Clasificacion_Solubilidad,

        d.Modulo,
        d.Avance,

        d.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia,
        pr.Apilado_TMS_Programa,
        pl.Apilado_TMS_Plan,

        d.STOCK_Dia,
        d.MINA_Dia,
        d.SRR_Dia,

        d.CuT_Real_Dia,
        pr.CuT_Programa,
        pl.CuT_Plan,

        d.CuS_Real_Dia,
        pr.CuS_Programa,
        pl.CuS_Plan,

        d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia,

        CASE
            WHEN pr.CuT_Programa IS NULL
              OR pr.CuT_Programa = 0
              OR pr.CuS_Programa IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            ELSE pr.CuS_Programa / pr.CuT_Programa
        END AS Solubilidad_Programa,

        CASE
            WHEN pl.CuT_Plan IS NULL
              OR pl.CuT_Plan = 0
              OR pl.CuS_Plan IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            ELSE pl.CuS_Plan / pl.CuT_Plan
        END AS Solubilidad_Plan,

        d.CO3_Real_Dia,
        pr.CO3_Programa,
        pl.CO3_Plan,

        d.CuFe_Real_Dia,
        pr.CuFe_Programa,
        pl.CuFe_Plan,

        d.FeT_Real_Dia,
        d.FeS_Real_Dia,
        d.ConsH_Real_Dia,

        d.Malla_Menos_1_2_Real_Dia,
        pr.Malla_Menos_1_2_Programa,

        d.Malla_Menos_100_Real_Dia,
        pr.Malla_Menos_100_Programa,
        pl.Malla_Menos_100_Plan,

        d.CaolBeta_Real_Dia,
        pr.CaolBeta_Programa,
        pl.CaolBeta_Plan,

CAST
(
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN d.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia IS NULL
              OR d.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia = 0
              OR d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia IS NULL
              OR d.CO3_Real_Dia IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN ISNULL(d.Solubilidad_Real_Dia, 0) < 0.25
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(d.CO3_Real_Dia, 0) <= 0.25
                        THEN 15.0
                    ELSE 11.0 + (15.51 * ISNULL(d.CO3_Real_Dia, 0))
                END

            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN d.CuS_Real_Dia IS NULL OR d.CuS_Real_Dia <= 0
                        THEN 0.0
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN (8.182 * LOG(d.CuS_Real_Dia))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(d.CO3_Real_Dia, 0)) < 15.0
                                THEN 15.0
                            ELSE (8.182 * LOG(d.CuS_Real_Dia))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(d.CO3_Real_Dia, 0))
                        END
                END
        END
    , 2)
    AS decimal(18, 2)
) AS Dosis_Acido_Ideal_Dia,

     CAST
(
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN pr.CuT_Programa IS NULL
              OR pr.CuT_Programa = 0
              OR pr.CuS_Programa IS NULL
              OR pr.CO3_Programa IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN ISNULL(pr.CuS_Programa / NULLIF(pr.CuT_Programa, 0), 0) < 0.25
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(pr.CO3_Programa, 0) <= 0.25
                        THEN 15.0
                    ELSE 11.0 + (15.51 * ISNULL(pr.CO3_Programa, 0))
                END

            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN pr.CuS_Programa IS NULL OR pr.CuS_Programa <= 0
                        THEN 0.0
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN (8.182 * LOG(pr.CuS_Programa))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(pr.CO3_Programa, 0)) < 15.0
                                THEN 15.0
                            ELSE (8.182 * LOG(pr.CuS_Programa))
                               + 18.99
                               + (15.51 * ISNULL(pr.CO3_Programa, 0))
                        END
                END
        END
    , 2)
    AS decimal(18, 2)
) AS Dosis_Acido_Programa_Semanal,
        d.Cantidad_Turnos,
        d.Flag_Contexto_Dia

    FROM diario_derivado d

    LEFT JOIN programa pr
        ON pr.Fecha = d.Fecha

    LEFT JOIN plan_mensual pl
        ON pl.Fecha = d.Fecha
);

name: v_srr_totalizadores_turno_test
definition:
CREATE VIEW [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_srr_totalizadores_turno_test]
AS

WITH DatosHora AS
(
SELECT
fecha_inicial,
fecha_final,
fecha_turno,

    TRY_CONVERT(decimal(20,6), cv001_tot) AS cv001_tot,
    TRY_CONVERT(decimal(20,6), cv002_tot) AS cv002_tot,
    TRY_CONVERT(decimal(20,6), cv003_tot) AS cv003_tot,

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
    (
        PARTITION BY fecha_inicial
        ORDER BY fecha_final DESC
    ) AS rn

FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[datos_filtrados]

WHERE fecha_turno IS NOT NULL

),

FechasOperacion AS
(
SELECT DISTINCT
fecha_turno AS Fecha

FROM DatosHora

WHERE rn = 1

),

Periodos AS
(
SELECT
Fecha,
CAST('A' AS varchar(1)) AS Turno,

    DATEADD
    (
        HOUR,
        8,
        CAST(Fecha AS datetime2)
    ) AS Inicio_Turno,

    DATEADD
    (
        HOUR,
        20,
        CAST(Fecha AS datetime2)
    ) AS Fin_Turno

FROM FechasOperacion

UNION ALL

SELECT
    Fecha,
    CAST('B' AS varchar(1)) AS Turno,

    DATEADD
    (
        HOUR,
        20,
        CAST(Fecha AS datetime2)
    ) AS Inicio_Turno,

    DATEADD
    (
        HOUR,
        32,
        CAST(Fecha AS datetime2)
    ) AS Fin_Turno

FROM FechasOperacion

),

Lecturas AS
(
SELECT
p.Fecha,
p.Turno,
p.Inicio_Turno,
p.Fin_Turno,

    ini.cv001_tot AS CV001_Inicio,
    fin.cv001_tot AS CV001_Fin,

    ini.cv002_tot AS CV002_Inicio,
    fin.cv002_tot AS CV002_Fin,

    ini.cv003_tot AS CV003_Inicio,
    fin.cv003_tot AS CV003_Fin

FROM Periodos p

LEFT JOIN DatosHora ini
    ON ini.fecha_inicial = p.Inicio_Turno
   AND ini.rn = 1

LEFT JOIN DatosHora fin
    ON fin.fecha_inicial = p.Fin_Turno
   AND fin.rn = 1

),

Incrementos AS
(
SELECT
*,

    CASE
        WHEN CV001_Inicio IS NULL
          OR CV001_Fin IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN CV001_Fin < CV001_Inicio
            THEN NULL

        ELSE CV001_Fin - CV001_Inicio
    END AS TMH_CV001,

    CASE
        WHEN CV002_Inicio IS NULL
          OR CV002_Fin IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN CV002_Fin < CV002_Inicio
            THEN NULL

        ELSE CV002_Fin - CV002_Inicio
    END AS TMH_CV002,

    CASE
        WHEN CV003_Inicio IS NULL
          OR CV003_Fin IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN CV003_Fin < CV003_Inicio
            THEN NULL

        ELSE CV003_Fin - CV003_Inicio
    END AS TMH_CV003

FROM Lecturas

),

Comparacion AS
(
SELECT
*,

    TMH_CV002 + TMH_CV003
        AS TMH_CV002_003,

    TMH_CV001
    - (TMH_CV002 + TMH_CV003)
        AS Diferencia_TMH,

    CASE
        WHEN TMH_CV001 IS NULL
          OR TMH_CV002 IS NULL
          OR TMH_CV003 IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN TMH_CV001 = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            (
                TMH_CV001
                - (TMH_CV002 + TMH_CV003)
            )
            / TMH_CV001
            * 100.0
    END AS Diferencia_Porcentaje,

    CASE
        WHEN TMH_CV001 IS NULL
          OR TMH_CV002 IS NULL
          OR TMH_CV003 IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN TMH_CV001 = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            (
                TMH_CV002
                + TMH_CV003
            )
            / TMH_CV001
            * 100.0
    END AS Cierre_CV002_003_Sobre_CV001

FROM Incrementos

)

SELECT
Fecha,
Turno,
Inicio_Turno,
Fin_Turno,

CV001_Inicio,
CV001_Fin,

CV002_Inicio,
CV002_Fin,

CV003_Inicio,
CV003_Fin,

TMH_CV001,
TMH_CV002,
TMH_CV003,
TMH_CV002_003,

Diferencia_TMH,
Diferencia_Porcentaje,
Cierre_CV002_003_Sobre_CV001,

TMH_CV001 AS SRR_TMH_Oficial,

CAST
(
    'CV001_TOTALIZADOR_CORREGIDO'
    AS varchar(40)
) AS Fuente_SRR,

CASE
    WHEN CV001_Inicio IS NULL
      OR CV001_Fin IS NULL
      OR CV002_Inicio IS NULL
      OR CV002_Fin IS NULL
      OR CV003_Inicio IS NULL
      OR CV003_Fin IS NULL
        THEN 'SIN_LECTURA_LIMITE'

    WHEN CV001_Fin < CV001_Inicio
        THEN 'RESETEO_CV001'

    WHEN CV002_Fin < CV002_Inicio
        THEN 'RESETEO_CV002'

    WHEN CV003_Fin < CV003_Inicio
        THEN 'RESETEO_CV003'

    ELSE 'OK'
END AS Flag_Totalizadores,

CASE
    WHEN TMH_CV001 IS NULL
      OR TMH_CV002 IS NULL
      OR TMH_CV003 IS NULL
        THEN 'SIN_DATOS'

    WHEN ABS
    (
        TMH_CV001
        - (TMH_CV002 + TMH_CV003)
    ) <= 0.01
        THEN 'COINCIDE'

    ELSE 'DIFIERE'
END AS Flag_Comparacion

FROM Comparacion;

name: v_contingencia_diagnostico_turno
definition:
CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_diagnostico_turno
AS

SELECT
    pi.fecha_operacional,
    pi.turno,
    pi.equipo_codigo,

    /* =========================
       Estado técnico PI
       ========================= */
    pi.estado_tecnico_pi,
    pi.registros,
    pi.registros_esperados,
    pi.cobertura_pct,
    pi.valores_distintos,

    pi.lectura_inicial_pi,
    pi.lectura_final_pi,
    pi.delta_observado_pi,

    pi.ultima_fecha_con_cambio,
    pi.segundos_sin_cambio_al_cierre,
    pi.cantidad_gaps_anormales,

    /* =========================
       Apoyo operacional MINA / IMP
       ========================= */
    apoyo.tonelaje_apoyo,
    apoyo.fuente_apoyo,

    COALESCE
    (
        apoyo.estado_apoyo,
        'SIN_INFORMACION'
    ) AS estado_apoyo,

    /* =========================
       Diagnóstico combinado
       SIN decidir PI vs TUM todavía
       ========================= */
    CAST
    (
        CASE

            /* PI varía y existe movimiento operacional */
            WHEN pi.estado_tecnico_pi = 'CON_VARIACION'
             AND apoyo.estado_apoyo = 'MOVIMIENTO_CONFIRMADO'
                THEN 'PI_COHERENTE_CON_OPERACION'

            /* PI tuvo gap, pero sigue mostrando movimiento */
            WHEN pi.estado_tecnico_pi = 'CON_VARIACION_COBERTURA_PARCIAL'
             AND apoyo.estado_apoyo = 'MOVIMIENTO_CONFIRMADO'
                THEN 'PI_CON_GAP_REQUIERE_VALIDACION'

            /* PI está plano todo el turno, pero sabemos que hubo alimentación */
            WHEN pi.estado_tecnico_pi = 'SIN_CAMBIO_TURNO_COMPLETO'
             AND apoyo.estado_apoyo = 'MOVIMIENTO_CONFIRMADO'
                THEN 'PI_INCONSISTENTE_CON_OPERACION'

            /* PI está plano y la fuente de apoyo reporta cero */
            WHEN pi.estado_tecnico_pi = 'SIN_CAMBIO_TURNO_COMPLETO'
             AND apoyo.estado_apoyo = 'SIN_MOVIMIENTO_REPORTADO'
                THEN 'PI_COHERENTE_CON_POSIBLE_PARADA'

            /* PI está plano pero no tenemos apoyo */
            WHEN pi.estado_tecnico_pi = 'SIN_CAMBIO_TURNO_COMPLETO'
             AND apoyo.estado_apoyo IS NULL
                THEN 'SIN_APOYO_PARA_DECIDIR'

            WHEN pi.estado_tecnico_pi = 'SIN_CAMBIO_TURNO_COMPLETO'
             AND apoyo.estado_apoyo = 'SIN_INFORMACION'
                THEN 'SIN_APOYO_PARA_DECIDIR'

            /* PI varía pero no tenemos apoyo */
            WHEN pi.estado_tecnico_pi IN
                 ('CON_VARIACION',
                  'CON_VARIACION_COBERTURA_PARCIAL')
             AND
             (
                 apoyo.estado_apoyo IS NULL
                 OR apoyo.estado_apoyo = 'SIN_INFORMACION'
             )
                THEN 'PI_CON_VARIACION_SIN_APOYO'

            ELSE 'REQUIERE_REVISION'

        END
        AS varchar(50)
    ) AS diagnostico_operacional

FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_pi_totalizador_turno pi

LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_apoyo_operacional_turno apoyo
    ON  apoyo.fecha_operacional = pi.fecha_operacional
    AND apoyo.turno             = pi.turno;

name: sp_refrescar_clays_cufe
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE

    [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_refrescar_clays_cufe]

(

    @FechaInicio date = NULL,

    @FechaFin date = NULL,

    @SoloVistaPrevia bit = 1

)

AS

BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET XACT_ABORT ON;



    /* ========================================================

       CONFIGURACIÓN Y FECHAS

       ======================================================== */



    DECLARE @FechaCorteProtegida date = '20260801';



    DECLARE @FechaFinEfectiva date;



    DECLARE @FechaInicioSolicitada date;



    DECLARE @FechaInicioEfectiva date;



    DECLARE @IdEjecucion uniqueidentifier = NEWID();



    DECLARE @FechaProceso datetime2(3) = SYSDATETIME();



    SET @FechaFinEfectiva =

        ISNULL

        (

            @FechaFin,

            DATEADD

            (

                DAY,

                -1,

                CONVERT(date, GETDATE())

            )

        );



    SET @FechaInicioSolicitada =

        ISNULL

        (

            @FechaInicio,

            DATEADD

            (

                DAY,

                -7,

                @FechaFinEfectiva

            )

        );



    SET @FechaInicioEfectiva =

        CASE

            WHEN @FechaInicioSolicitada < @FechaCorteProtegida

                THEN @FechaCorteProtegida

            ELSE @FechaInicioSolicitada

        END;



    /* ========================================================

       VALIDACIONES

       ======================================================== */



    IF OBJECT_ID

    (

        N'[inventar_SpcHidr].[v_clays_cufe_calculado_v2_test]',

        N'V'

    ) IS NULL

    BEGIN

        THROW 50001,

            'No existe la vista v_clays_cufe_calculado_v2_test.',

            1;

    END;



    IF OBJECT_ID

    (

        N'[inventar_SpcHidr].[Clays_CuFe]',

        N'U'

    ) IS NULL

    BEGIN

        THROW 50002,

            'No existe la tabla Clays_CuFe.',

            1;

    END;



    IF @SoloVistaPrevia = 0

       AND OBJECT_ID

       (

           N'[inventar_SpcHidr].[Clays_CuFe_trazabilidad]',

           N'U'

       ) IS NULL

    BEGIN

        THROW 50003,

            'No existe la tabla Clays_CuFe_trazabilidad.',

            1;

    END;



    IF @FechaFinEfectiva < @FechaCorteProtegida

    BEGIN

        THROW 50004,

            'El período solicitado termina antes del corte protegido 01-08-2026.',

            1;

    END;



    IF @FechaInicioEfectiva > @FechaFinEfectiva

    BEGIN

        THROW 50005,

            'La fecha inicial efectiva es posterior a la fecha final.',

            1;

    END;



    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #fuente;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #destino;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #acciones;



    /* ========================================================

       FUENTE CALCULADA

       ======================================================== */



    SELECT

        v.Fecha,

        v.Turno,

        v.Torre,



        CASE

            WHEN v.Torre = 'TM1' THEN 'TM-1'

            WHEN v.Torre = 'TM2' THEN 'TM-2'

        END AS Torre_Destino,



        CASE

            WHEN v.Turno = 'A' THEN 'TA'

            WHEN v.Turno = 'B' THEN 'TB'

        END AS Turno_Destino,



        v.Representatividad_Quimica,

        v.Representatividad_Quimica_TM2,



        v.ID_NIR,

        v.Muestra_NIR,

        v.CaolBeta_NIR,

        v.Fecha_Carga_NIR,

        v.Cantidad_Registros_NIR,



        v.ID_NIR_TM2,

        v.Muestra_NIR_TM2,

        v.CaolBeta_NIR_TM2,

        v.Fecha_Carga_NIR_TM2,



        v.CaolBeta_MB,

        v.CaolBeta_Final,



        CAST

        (

            v.CaolBeta_Final_2D

            AS decimal(18,2)

        ) AS CaolBeta_Nuevo,



        v.Fuente_CaolBeta,



        v.ID_Registro_CuFe,

        v.CuFe_Laboratorio,

        v.Fecha_Carga_Laboratorio,

        v.Cantidad_Registros_Laboratorio,



        v.ID_Registro_CuFe_TM2,

        v.CuFe_Laboratorio_TM2,

        v.Fecha_Carga_Laboratorio_TM2,



        v.CuFe_MB,

        v.CuFe_Final,



        CAST

        (

            v.CuFe_Final_2D

            AS decimal(18,2)

        ) AS CuFe_Nuevo,



        v.Fuente_CuFe,

        v.Cantidad_Registros_MB



    INTO #fuente



    FROM

        [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_clays_cufe_calculado_v2_test] AS v



    WHERE

        v.Fecha BETWEEN

            @FechaInicioEfectiva

            AND @FechaFinEfectiva



        AND

        (

            v.CaolBeta_Final_2D IS NOT NULL

            OR v.CuFe_Final_2D IS NOT NULL

        );



    /* ========================================================

       CONTROL DE DUPLICADOS EN LA FUENTE

       ======================================================== */



    IF EXISTS

    (

        SELECT

            Fecha,

            Turno,

            Torre

        FROM #fuente

        GROUP BY

            Fecha,

            Turno,

            Torre

        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

    )

    BEGIN

        THROW 50006,

            'La vista calculada contiene claves duplicadas.',

            1;

    END;



    /* ========================================================

       DESTINO ACTUAL NORMALIZADO

       ======================================================== */



    SELECT

        c.Fecha,



        c.Torre AS Torre_Original,

        c.Turno AS Turno_Original,



        CASE

            WHEN norm.Torre_Normalizada

                 IN ('TM1', 'T1', 'TORRE1')

                THEN 'TM1'



            WHEN norm.Torre_Normalizada

                 IN ('TM2', 'T2', 'TORRE2')

                THEN 'TM2'

        END AS Torre,



        CASE

            WHEN norm.Turno_Normalizado

                 IN ('A', 'TA', 'TURNOA')

                THEN 'A'



            WHEN norm.Turno_Normalizado

                 IN ('B', 'TB', 'TURNOB')

                THEN 'B'

        END AS Turno,



        TRY_CONVERT

        (

            decimal(18,2),

            c.CaolBeta

        ) AS CaolBeta_Anterior,



        TRY_CONVERT

        (

            decimal(18,2),

            c.CuFe

        ) AS CuFe_Anterior,

        hist.Fuente_CaolBeta
            AS Fuente_CaolBeta_Anterior,

        hist.Fuente_CuFe
            AS Fuente_CuFe_Anterior



    INTO #destino



    FROM

        [inventar_SpcHidr].[Clays_CuFe] AS c



    CROSS APPLY

    (

        VALUES

        (

            REPLACE

            (

                REPLACE

                (

                    REPLACE

                    (

                        UPPER

                        (

                            LTRIM

                            (

                                RTRIM

                                (

                                    ISNULL(c.Torre, '')

                                )

                            )

                        ),

                        ' ',

                        ''

                    ),

                    '-',

                    ''

                ),

                '_',

                ''

            ),



            REPLACE

            (

                REPLACE

                (

                    REPLACE

                    (

                        UPPER

                        (

                            LTRIM

                            (

                                RTRIM

                                (

                                    ISNULL(c.Turno, '')

                                )

                            )

                        ),

                        ' ',

                        ''

                    ),

                    '-',

                    ''

                ),

                '_',

                ''

            )

        )

    ) AS norm

    (

        Torre_Normalizada,

        Turno_Normalizado

    )

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            t.Fuente_CaolBeta,
            t.Fuente_CuFe
        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[Clays_CuFe_trazabilidad] AS t
        WHERE t.Fecha = c.Fecha
          AND t.Torre = CASE
                WHEN norm.Torre_Normalizada IN ('TM1', 'T1', 'TORRE1') THEN 'TM1'
                WHEN norm.Torre_Normalizada IN ('TM2', 'T2', 'TORRE2') THEN 'TM2'
              END
          AND t.Turno = CASE
                WHEN norm.Turno_Normalizado IN ('A', 'TA', 'TURNOA') THEN 'A'
                WHEN norm.Turno_Normalizado IN ('B', 'TB', 'TURNOB') THEN 'B'
              END
        ORDER BY t.fecha_proceso DESC, t.id_trazabilidad DESC
    ) AS hist



    WHERE

        c.Fecha BETWEEN

            @FechaInicioEfectiva

            AND @FechaFinEfectiva;



    /* ========================================================

       CONTROL DE DUPLICADOS EN CLAYS_CUFE

       ======================================================== */



    IF EXISTS

    (

        SELECT

            Fecha,

            Turno,

            Torre

        FROM #destino

        WHERE

            Turno IS NOT NULL

            AND Torre IS NOT NULL

        GROUP BY

            Fecha,

            Turno,

            Torre

        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

    )

    BEGIN

        THROW 50007,

            'Clays_CuFe contiene claves duplicadas en el período solicitado.',

            1;

    END;



    /* ========================================================

       CLASIFICACIÓN DE ACCIONES

       ======================================================== */



    SELECT

        f.*,



        d.CaolBeta_Anterior,

        d.CuFe_Anterior,

        d.Fuente_CaolBeta_Anterior,
        d.Fuente_CuFe_Anterior,



        CASE

            WHEN d.Fecha IS NULL

                THEN 'INSERTAR'



            WHEN

            (

                f.CaolBeta_Nuevo IS NOT NULL

                AND

                (

                    d.CaolBeta_Anterior IS NULL

                    OR d.CaolBeta_Anterior <> f.CaolBeta_Nuevo

                )

            )

            OR

            (

                f.CuFe_Nuevo IS NOT NULL

                AND

                (

                    d.CuFe_Anterior IS NULL

                    OR d.CuFe_Anterior <> f.CuFe_Nuevo

                )

            )

                THEN 'ACTUALIZAR'



            WHEN
            (
                d.Fuente_CaolBeta_Anterior IS NOT NULL
                AND ISNULL(d.Fuente_CaolBeta_Anterior, '') <> ISNULL(f.Fuente_CaolBeta, '')
            )
            OR
            (
                d.Fuente_CuFe_Anterior IS NOT NULL
                AND ISNULL(d.Fuente_CuFe_Anterior, '') <> ISNULL(f.Fuente_CuFe, '')
            )
                THEN 'TRAZABILIDAD'

            ELSE 'SIN_CAMBIO'

        END AS Accion



    INTO #acciones



    FROM #fuente AS f



    LEFT JOIN #destino AS d

        ON d.Fecha = f.Fecha

       AND d.Turno = f.Turno

       AND d.Torre = f.Torre;



    /* ========================================================

       VISTA PREVIA

       ======================================================== */



    IF @SoloVistaPrevia = 1

    BEGIN

        SELECT

            @IdEjecucion AS id_ejecucion,

            @FechaInicioSolicitada AS fecha_inicio_solicitada,

            @FechaInicioEfectiva AS fecha_inicio_efectiva,

            @FechaFinEfectiva AS fecha_fin_efectiva,

            @FechaCorteProtegida AS fecha_corte_protegida;



        SELECT

            Accion,

            COUNT(*) AS Cantidad

        FROM #acciones

        GROUP BY

            Accion

        ORDER BY

            Accion;



        SELECT

            Fecha,

            Turno,

            Torre,

            Accion,



            Representatividad_Quimica,

            Representatividad_Quimica_TM2,



            CaolBeta_Anterior,

            CaolBeta_Nuevo,

            Fuente_CaolBeta,



            CuFe_Anterior,

            CuFe_Nuevo,

            Fuente_CuFe



        FROM #acciones



        ORDER BY

            Fecha,

            Turno,

            Torre;



        RETURN;

    END;



    /* ========================================================

       EJECUCIÓN REAL

       ======================================================== */



    BEGIN TRY

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;



        DECLARE @ResultadoLock int;



        EXEC @ResultadoLock = sys.sp_getapplock

            @Resource =

                N'inventar_SpcHidr.sp_refrescar_clays_cufe',

            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',

            @LockOwner = N'Transaction',

            @LockTimeout = 10000;



        IF @ResultadoLock < 0

        BEGIN

            THROW 50008,

                'No fue posible obtener el bloqueo exclusivo del proceso.',

                1;

        END;



        /* ====================================================

           ACTUALIZACIÓN

           ==================================================== */



        UPDATE c

        SET

            c.CaolBeta =

                CASE

                    WHEN a.CaolBeta_Nuevo IS NOT NULL

                        THEN CONVERT(float, a.CaolBeta_Nuevo)

                    ELSE c.CaolBeta

                END,



            c.CuFe =

                CASE

                    WHEN a.CuFe_Nuevo IS NOT NULL

                        THEN CONVERT(float, a.CuFe_Nuevo)

                    ELSE c.CuFe

                END



        FROM

            [inventar_SpcHidr].[Clays_CuFe] AS c



        CROSS APPLY

        (

            VALUES

            (

                CASE

                    WHEN REPLACE

                    (

                        REPLACE

                        (

                            REPLACE

                            (

                                UPPER

                                (

                                    LTRIM

                                    (

                                        RTRIM

                                        (

                                            ISNULL(c.Torre, '')

                                        )

                                    )

                                ),

                                ' ',

                                ''

                            ),

                            '-',

                            ''

                        ),

                        '_',

                        ''

                    ) IN ('TM1', 'T1', 'TORRE1')

                        THEN 'TM1'



                    WHEN REPLACE

                    (

                        REPLACE

                        (

                            REPLACE

                            (

                                UPPER

                                (

                                    LTRIM

                                    (

                                        RTRIM

                                        (

                                            ISNULL(c.Torre, '')

                                        )

                                    )

                                ),

                                ' ',

                                ''

                            ),

                            '-',

                            ''

                        ),

                        '_',

                        ''

                    ) IN ('TM2', 'T2', 'TORRE2')

                        THEN 'TM2'

                END,



                CASE

                    WHEN REPLACE

                    (

                        REPLACE

                        (

                            REPLACE

                            (

                                UPPER

                                (

                                    LTRIM

                                    (

                                        RTRIM

                                        (

                                            ISNULL(c.Turno, '')

                                        )

                                    )

                                ),

                                ' ',

                                ''

                            ),

                            '-',

                            ''

                        ),

                        '_',

                        ''

                    ) IN ('A', 'TA', 'TURNOA')

                        THEN 'A'



                    WHEN REPLACE

                    (

                        REPLACE

                        (

                            REPLACE

                            (

                                UPPER

                                (

                                    LTRIM

                                    (

                                        RTRIM

                                        (

                                            ISNULL(c.Turno, '')

                                        )

                                    )

                                ),

                                ' ',

                                ''

                            ),

                            '-',

                            ''

                        ),

                        '_',

                        ''

                    ) IN ('B', 'TB', 'TURNOB')

                        THEN 'B'

                END

            )

        ) AS norm

        (

            Torre_Normalizada,

            Turno_Normalizado

        )



        INNER JOIN #acciones AS a

            ON a.Fecha = c.Fecha

           AND a.Torre = norm.Torre_Normalizada

           AND a.Turno = norm.Turno_Normalizado

           AND a.Accion = 'ACTUALIZAR';



        /* ====================================================

           INSERCIÓN

           ==================================================== */



        INSERT INTO

            [inventar_SpcHidr].[Clays_CuFe]

        (

            Fecha,

            Torre,

            Turno,

            Caolinita,

            Qz,

            CaolBeta,

            CuFe

        )

        SELECT

            a.Fecha,

            a.Torre_Destino,

            a.Turno_Destino,

            NULL,

            NULL,

            CONVERT(float, a.CaolBeta_Nuevo),

            CONVERT(float, a.CuFe_Nuevo)



        FROM #acciones AS a



        WHERE

            a.Accion = 'INSERTAR'

            AND

            (

                a.CaolBeta_Nuevo IS NOT NULL

                OR a.CuFe_Nuevo IS NOT NULL

            );



        /* ====================================================

           TRAZABILIDAD

           ==================================================== */



        INSERT INTO

            [inventar_SpcHidr].[Clays_CuFe_trazabilidad]

        (

            id_ejecucion,

            fecha_proceso,

            fecha_inicio_proceso,

            fecha_fin_proceso,

            accion,



            Fecha,

            Turno,

            Torre,



            Representatividad_Quimica,

            Representatividad_Quimica_TM2,



            ID_NIR,

            Muestra_NIR,

            CaolBeta_NIR,

            Fecha_Carga_NIR,



            ID_NIR_TM2,

            Muestra_NIR_TM2,

            CaolBeta_NIR_TM2,

            Fecha_Carga_NIR_TM2,



            CaolBeta_MB,

            CaolBeta_Final,

            CaolBeta_Final_2D,

            Fuente_CaolBeta,



            ID_Registro_CuFe,

            CuFe_Laboratorio,

            Fecha_Carga_Laboratorio,



            ID_Registro_CuFe_TM2,

            CuFe_Laboratorio_TM2,

            Fecha_Carga_Laboratorio_TM2,



            CuFe_MB,

            CuFe_Final,

            CuFe_Final_2D,

            Fuente_CuFe,



            CaolBeta_Anterior,

            CuFe_Anterior,



            usuario_ejecucion,

            host_ejecucion,

            aplicacion_ejecucion

        )

        SELECT

            @IdEjecucion,

            @FechaProceso,

            @FechaInicioEfectiva,

            @FechaFinEfectiva,

            a.Accion,



            a.Fecha,

            a.Turno,

            a.Torre,



            a.Representatividad_Quimica,

            a.Representatividad_Quimica_TM2,



            a.ID_NIR,

            a.Muestra_NIR,

            a.CaolBeta_NIR,

            a.Fecha_Carga_NIR,



            a.ID_NIR_TM2,

            a.Muestra_NIR_TM2,

            a.CaolBeta_NIR_TM2,

            a.Fecha_Carga_NIR_TM2,



            a.CaolBeta_MB,

            a.CaolBeta_Final,

            a.CaolBeta_Nuevo,

            a.Fuente_CaolBeta,



            a.ID_Registro_CuFe,

            a.CuFe_Laboratorio,

            a.Fecha_Carga_Laboratorio,



            a.ID_Registro_CuFe_TM2,

            a.CuFe_Laboratorio_TM2,

            a.Fecha_Carga_Laboratorio_TM2,



            a.CuFe_MB,

            a.CuFe_Final,

            a.CuFe_Nuevo,

            a.Fuente_CuFe,



            a.CaolBeta_Anterior,

            a.CuFe_Anterior,



            ORIGINAL_LOGIN(),

            HOST_NAME(),

            APP_NAME()



        FROM #acciones AS a



        WHERE

            a.Accion IN

            (

                'INSERTAR',

                'ACTUALIZAR',

                'TRAZABILIDAD'

            );



        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    END TRY



    BEGIN CATCH

        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0

            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;



        THROW;

    END CATCH;



    /* ========================================================

       RESULTADO DE LA EJECUCIÓN

       ======================================================== */



    SELECT

        @IdEjecucion AS id_ejecucion,

        @FechaInicioEfectiva AS fecha_inicio_efectiva,

        @FechaFinEfectiva AS fecha_fin_efectiva,

        @FechaProceso AS fecha_proceso,



        SUM

        (

            CASE

                WHEN Accion = 'INSERTAR' THEN 1

                ELSE 0

            END

        ) AS Registros_Insertados,



        SUM

        (

            CASE

                WHEN Accion = 'ACTUALIZAR' THEN 1

                ELSE 0

            END

        ) AS Registros_Actualizados,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN Accion = 'TRAZABILIDAD' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Registros_Trazabilidad_Actualizada,



        SUM

        (

            CASE

                WHEN Accion = 'SIN_CAMBIO' THEN 1

                ELSE 0

            END

        ) AS Registros_Sin_Cambio



    FROM #acciones;



    SELECT

        Fecha,

        Turno,

        Torre,

        Accion,



        CaolBeta_Anterior,

        CaolBeta_Nuevo,

        Fuente_CaolBeta,



        CuFe_Anterior,

        CuFe_Nuevo,

        Fuente_CuFe



    FROM #acciones



    WHERE

        Accion IN

        (

            'INSERTAR',

            'ACTUALIZAR',

            'TRAZABILIDAD'

        )



    ORDER BY

        Fecha,

        Turno,

        Torre;

END;

name: v_srr_totalizadores_diario_test
definition:
CREATE   VIEW
    [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_srr_totalizadores_diario_test]
AS

WITH Turnos AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'A'
                 THEN TMH_CV001
            END
        ) AS TMH_CV001_Turno_A,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'B'
                 THEN TMH_CV001
            END
        ) AS TMH_CV001_Turno_B,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'A'
                 THEN TMH_CV002
            END
        ) AS TMH_CV002_Turno_A,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'B'
                 THEN TMH_CV002
            END
        ) AS TMH_CV002_Turno_B,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'A'
                 THEN TMH_CV003
            END
        ) AS TMH_CV003_Turno_A,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'B'
                 THEN TMH_CV003
            END
        ) AS TMH_CV003_Turno_B,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'A'
                 THEN Flag_Totalizadores
            END
        ) AS Flag_Totalizadores_A,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'B'
                 THEN Flag_Totalizadores
            END
        ) AS Flag_Totalizadores_B,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'A'
                 THEN Flag_Comparacion
            END
        ) AS Flag_Comparacion_A,

        MAX
        (
            CASE WHEN Turno = 'B'
                 THEN Flag_Comparacion
            END
        ) AS Flag_Comparacion_B

    FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_srr_totalizadores_turno_test]

    GROUP BY Fecha
),

Diario AS
(
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN TMH_CV001_Turno_A IS NULL
              OR TMH_CV001_Turno_B IS NULL
                THEN NULL
            ELSE
                TMH_CV001_Turno_A
                + TMH_CV001_Turno_B
        END AS TMH_CV001_Dia,

        CASE
            WHEN TMH_CV002_Turno_A IS NULL
              OR TMH_CV002_Turno_B IS NULL
                THEN NULL
            ELSE
                TMH_CV002_Turno_A
                + TMH_CV002_Turno_B
        END AS TMH_CV002_Dia,

        CASE
            WHEN TMH_CV003_Turno_A IS NULL
              OR TMH_CV003_Turno_B IS NULL
                THEN NULL
            ELSE
                TMH_CV003_Turno_A
                + TMH_CV003_Turno_B
        END AS TMH_CV003_Dia

    FROM Turnos
),

Comparacion AS
(
    SELECT
        *,

        TMH_CV002_Dia
        + TMH_CV003_Dia
            AS TMH_CV002_003_Dia,

        TMH_CV001_Dia
        -
        (
            TMH_CV002_Dia
            + TMH_CV003_Dia
        ) AS Diferencia_TMH_Dia

    FROM Diario
)

SELECT
    Fecha,

    /* CV001: fuente oficial del parche */
    TMH_CV001_Turno_A,
    TMH_CV001_Turno_B,
    TMH_CV001_Dia,

    /* CV002 */
    TMH_CV002_Turno_A,
    TMH_CV002_Turno_B,
    TMH_CV002_Dia,

    /* CV003 */
    TMH_CV003_Turno_A,
    TMH_CV003_Turno_B,
    TMH_CV003_Dia,

    /* Comparación CV002 + CV003 */
    TMH_CV002_003_Dia,
    Diferencia_TMH_Dia,

    CASE
        WHEN TMH_CV001_Dia IS NULL
          OR TMH_CV002_003_Dia IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN TMH_CV001_Dia = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            Diferencia_TMH_Dia
            / TMH_CV001_Dia
            * 100.0
    END AS Diferencia_Porcentaje_Dia,

    CASE
        WHEN TMH_CV001_Dia IS NULL
          OR TMH_CV002_003_Dia IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN TMH_CV001_Dia = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            TMH_CV002_003_Dia
            / TMH_CV001_Dia
            * 100.0
    END AS Cierre_CV002_003_Sobre_CV001_Dia,

    /* Valores oficiales para SRR */
    TMH_CV001_Turno_A AS SRR_TMH_Turno_A,
    TMH_CV001_Turno_B AS SRR_TMH_Turno_B,
    TMH_CV001_Dia     AS SRR_TMH_Dia,

    CAST('PARCHE_CV001' AS varchar(30))
        AS Fuente_SRR,

    Flag_Totalizadores_A,
    Flag_Totalizadores_B,

    CASE
        WHEN Flag_Totalizadores_A = 'OK'
         AND Flag_Totalizadores_B = 'OK'
            THEN 'OK'
        ELSE 'REVISAR'
    END AS Flag_Totalizadores_Dia,

    Flag_Comparacion_A,
    Flag_Comparacion_B,

    CASE
        WHEN TMH_CV001_Dia IS NULL
          OR TMH_CV002_003_Dia IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_DATOS'

        WHEN ABS(Diferencia_TMH_Dia) <= 0.01
            THEN 'COINCIDE'

        ELSE 'DIFIERE'
    END AS Flag_Comparacion_Dia

FROM Comparacion;

name: v_contingencia_pi_frontera_turno
definition:
CREATE   VIEW
inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_pi_frontera_turno
AS

WITH fronteras AS
(
    SELECT
        pi.fecha_operacional,
        pi.turno,
        pi.equipo_codigo,

        /* Ya traemos directamente el resultado del totalizador.
           Evitamos volver a expandir la misma vista. */
        pi.delta_observado_pi,

        CASE
            WHEN pi.turno = 'A'
                THEN DATEADD
                (
                    HOUR,
                    8,
                    CAST(pi.fecha_operacional AS datetime2)
                )

            WHEN pi.turno = 'B'
                THEN DATEADD
                (
                    HOUR,
                    20,
                    CAST(pi.fecha_operacional AS datetime2)
                )
        END AS fecha_hora_inicio,

        CASE
            WHEN pi.turno = 'A'
                THEN DATEADD
                (
                    HOUR,
                    20,
                    CAST(pi.fecha_operacional AS datetime2)
                )

            WHEN pi.turno = 'B'
                THEN DATEADD
                (
                    HOUR,
                    8,
                    CAST
                    (
                        DATEADD(DAY, 1, pi.fecha_operacional)
                        AS datetime2
                    )
                )
        END AS fecha_hora_fin

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_pi_totalizador_turno
         AS pi
)

SELECT
    f.fecha_operacional,
    f.turno,
    f.equipo_codigo,

    f.fecha_hora_inicio,
    f.fecha_hora_fin,

    ini.valor_pi AS lectura_inicio_pi,
    fin.valor_pi AS lectura_fin_pi,

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            /* SRR CV001 mantiene EXACTAMENTE su integración temporal */
            WHEN f.equipo_codigo = 'SRR_CV001'
                THEN f.delta_observado_pi

            /* Resto: frontera final - inicial */
            WHEN ini.valor_pi IS NOT NULL
             AND fin.valor_pi IS NOT NULL
                THEN fin.valor_pi - ini.valor_pi

            ELSE NULL
        END
        AS decimal(28,6)
    ) AS delta_frontera_pi,

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ini.valor_pi IS NULL
             AND fin.valor_pi IS NULL
                THEN 'SIN_AMBAS_FRONTERAS'

            WHEN ini.valor_pi IS NULL
                THEN 'SIN_FRONTERA_INICIAL'

            WHEN fin.valor_pi IS NULL
                THEN 'SIN_FRONTERA_FINAL'

            ELSE 'FRONTERAS_COMPLETAS'
        END
        AS varchar(40)
    ) AS estado_fronteras

FROM fronteras AS f

LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_pi_serie AS ini
    ON  ini.equipo_codigo     = f.equipo_codigo
    AND ini.fecha_operacional = f.fecha_operacional
    AND ini.turno             = f.turno
    AND ini.fecha_hora        = f.fecha_hora_inicio

/* Deliberadamente se conserva EXACTO el JOIN productivo */
LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_pi_serie AS fin
    ON  fin.equipo_codigo = f.equipo_codigo
    AND fin.fecha_hora    = f.fecha_hora_fin;

name: v_srr_tms_turno_test
definition:
CREATE VIEW
    [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_srr_tms_turno_test]
AS

WITH Base AS
(
    SELECT
        s.Fecha,
        s.Turno,
        s.Inicio_Turno,
        s.Fin_Turno,

        /* Totalizadores */
        s.TMH_CV001,
        s.TMH_CV002,
        s.TMH_CV003,
        s.TMH_CV002_003,
        s.Diferencia_TMH,
        s.Diferencia_Porcentaje,

        /* SRR oficial provisional */
        s.SRR_TMH_Oficial,
        s.Fuente_SRR,
        s.Flag_Totalizadores,
        s.Flag_Comparacion,

        /* Humedad diaria resuelta por torre */
        h.Humedad_TM1,
        h.Humedad_TM2,

        h.Fecha_Humedad_TM1,
        h.Torre_Humedad_TM1,
        h.Turno_Humedad_TM1,
        h.Fuente_Humedad_TM1,

        h.Fecha_Humedad_TM2,
        h.Torre_Humedad_TM2,
        h.Turno_Humedad_TM2,
        h.Fuente_Humedad_TM2

    FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_srr_totalizadores_turno_test] s

    LEFT JOIN
        [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_apilado_tms_con_sal_srr_reporte_test] h
        ON h.Fecha = s.Fecha
),

Distribucion AS
(
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN SRR_TMH_Oficial IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE SRR_TMH_Oficial / 2.0
        END AS SRR_TMH_TM1,

        CASE
            WHEN SRR_TMH_Oficial IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE SRR_TMH_Oficial / 2.0
        END AS SRR_TMH_TM2

    FROM Base
),

Calculo AS
(
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN SRR_TMH_Oficial IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN SRR_TMH_Oficial = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN Humedad_TM1 IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN Humedad_TM1 < 0
              OR Humedad_TM1 >= 100
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                SRR_TMH_TM1
                * (1.0 - Humedad_TM1 / 100.0)
        END AS SRR_TMS_TM1,

        CASE
            WHEN SRR_TMH_Oficial IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN SRR_TMH_Oficial = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN Humedad_TM2 IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN Humedad_TM2 < 0
              OR Humedad_TM2 >= 100
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                SRR_TMH_TM2
                * (1.0 - Humedad_TM2 / 100.0)
        END AS SRR_TMS_TM2

    FROM Distribucion
)

SELECT
    Fecha,
    Turno,
    Inicio_Turno,
    Fin_Turno,

    /* Comparación de correas */
    TMH_CV001,
    TMH_CV002,
    TMH_CV003,
    TMH_CV002_003,
    Diferencia_TMH,
    Diferencia_Porcentaje,

    /* Distribución 50/50 del SRR oficial */
    SRR_TMH_Oficial,
    SRR_TMH_TM1,
    SRR_TMH_TM2,

    CASE
        WHEN SRR_TMH_TM1 IS NULL
          OR SRR_TMH_TM2 IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE
            SRR_TMH_TM1
            + SRR_TMH_TM2
            - SRR_TMH_Oficial
    END AS Check_Distribucion_TMH,

    /* Humedades utilizadas */
    Humedad_TM1,
    Humedad_TM2,

    CASE
        WHEN Humedad_TM1 IS NULL
          OR Humedad_TM2 IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE
            (Humedad_TM1 + Humedad_TM2) / 2.0
    END AS Humedad_Equivalente_SRR,

    Fecha_Humedad_TM1,
    Torre_Humedad_TM1,
    Turno_Humedad_TM1,
    Fuente_Humedad_TM1,

    Fecha_Humedad_TM2,
    Torre_Humedad_TM2,
    Turno_Humedad_TM2,
    Fuente_Humedad_TM2,

    /* SRR seco */
    SRR_TMS_TM1,
    SRR_TMS_TM2,

    CASE
        WHEN SRR_TMS_TM1 IS NULL
          OR SRR_TMS_TM2 IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE
            SRR_TMS_TM1 + SRR_TMS_TM2
    END AS SRR_TMS_Oficial,

    Fuente_SRR,

    CAST
    (
        'CV001_CORREGIDO_50_50_HUMEDAD_DIARIA_POR_TORRE'
        AS varchar(60)
    ) AS Metodo_Calculo_SRR,

    Flag_Totalizadores,
    Flag_Comparacion,

    CASE
        WHEN Flag_Totalizadores <> 'OK'
            THEN 'REVISAR_TOTALIZADORES'

        WHEN SRR_TMH_Oficial IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_SRR_TMH'

        WHEN SRR_TMH_Oficial = 0
            THEN 'OK_SIN_SRR'

        WHEN Humedad_TM1 IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_HUMEDAD_TM1'

        WHEN Humedad_TM2 IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_HUMEDAD_TM2'

        WHEN Humedad_TM1 < 0
          OR Humedad_TM1 >= 100
            THEN 'HUMEDAD_TM1_INVALIDA'

        WHEN Humedad_TM2 < 0
          OR Humedad_TM2 >= 100
            THEN 'HUMEDAD_TM2_INVALIDA'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_SRR_TMS

FROM Calculo;
