name: v_reporte_torres_excel_exacto
definition:
-- inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_torres_excel_exacto source

CREATE VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_torres_excel_exacto
AS
WITH b AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_base_turno_torre_excel
),
/* =========================================================
   0) Calendario operacional (grid día-turno)
   ========================================================= */
dias AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Fecha AS Dia_Op
    FROM b
),
turnos AS (
    SELECT 'A' AS Turno
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B'
),
grid AS (
    SELECT d.Dia_Op, t.Turno
    FROM dias d
    CROSS JOIN turnos t
),
/* =========================================================
   1) Bitácora agregada por día-turno (min/max)
   ========================================================= */
bt_stats AS (
    SELECT
        Dia_Op  = bt.fecha_turno,
        Turno   = bt.turno,
        ts_min  = MIN(bt.ts_toma_muestra),
        ts_max  = MAX(bt.ts_toma_muestra)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.bitacora_turnos_consolidada bt
    GROUP BY bt.fecha_turno, bt.turno
),
/* =========================================================
   2) Horario “raw” preferido (ts_max)
   ========================================================= */
hor_raw AS (
    SELECT
        g.Dia_Op,
        g.Turno,
        ts_raw = s.ts_max,
        ts_min = s.ts_min
    FROM grid g
    LEFT JOIN bt_stats s
        ON s.Dia_Op = g.Dia_Op
       AND s.Turno  = g.Turno
),
/* =========================================================
   3) Horario final con relleno:
      - Si existe => ts_max
      - Si falta B y mañana hay ts_min (ej 08:00) => enganchar
      - Si falta => carry-last del mismo turno (ajustando fecha)
   ========================================================= */
hor_seed AS (
    SELECT
        r.Dia_Op,
        r.Turno,
        ts_seed =
        CASE
            WHEN r.ts_raw IS NOT NULL THEN r.ts_raw

            WHEN r.Turno = 'B'
                 AND EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM bt_stats nx
                     WHERE nx.Dia_Op = DATEADD(DAY, 1, r.Dia_Op)
                       AND nx.Turno  = 'B'
                       AND nx.ts_min IS NOT NULL
                       AND CAST(nx.ts_min AS date) = DATEADD(DAY, 1, r.Dia_Op)
                 )
            THEN (
                SELECT nx.ts_min
                FROM bt_stats nx
                WHERE nx.Dia_Op = DATEADD(DAY, 1, r.Dia_Op)
                  AND nx.Turno  = 'B'
            )

            ELSE NULL
        END
    FROM hor_raw r
),
hor_final AS (
    SELECT
        s.Dia_Op,
        s.Turno,
        ts_final =
        COALESCE(
            s.ts_seed,
            (
                SELECT
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.Turno = 'A'
                            THEN DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, 0, s.Dia_Op),
                                         CAST(CAST(p.ts_seed AS time(0)) AS datetime2(0)))
                        ELSE
                            DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, 0, DATEADD(DAY, 1, s.Dia_Op)),
                                         CAST(CAST(p.ts_seed AS time(0)) AS datetime2(0)))
                    END
                FROM (
                    SELECT TOP (1) ts_seed
                    FROM hor_seed p0
                    WHERE p0.Turno = s.Turno
                      AND p0.Dia_Op < s.Dia_Op
                      AND p0.ts_seed IS NOT NULL
                    ORDER BY p0.Dia_Op DESC
                ) p
            )
        )
    FROM hor_seed s
),
/* =========================================================
   4) LAB: usar fecha original (NO recalcular fecha_turno)
   ========================================================= */
lab_norm AS (
    SELECT
        Torre = l.Torre,
        Turno = l.Turno,
        fecha_turno = CAST(l.Fecha AS date),
        Peso_Quimico_kg = l.Peso_Quimico_kg,
        Peso_Total_kg   = l.Peso_Total_kg
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.Informe_TM_lab l
),
lab_agg AS (
    SELECT
        Torre,
        Turno,
        fecha_turno,
        Peso_Quimico_kg = MAX(Peso_Quimico_kg),
        Peso_Total_kg   = MAX(Peso_Total_kg)
    FROM lab_norm
    GROUP BY Torre, Turno, fecha_turno
),
/* =========================================================
   5) Unir base + horarios + pesos reales
   ========================================================= */
b_join AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        Dia_Op = b.Fecha,
        ts_muestra = hf.ts_final,
        Peso_Quimico_kg_fix = la.Peso_Quimico_kg,
        Peso_Total_kg_fix   = la.Peso_Total_kg
    FROM b
    LEFT JOIN hor_final hf
        ON hf.Dia_Op = b.Fecha
       AND hf.Turno  = b.Turno
    LEFT JOIN lab_agg la
        ON la.fecha_turno = b.Fecha
       AND la.turno       = b.Turno
       AND la.torre       = b.Torre
),
/* =========================================================
   6) prev_ts por torre (secuencia real de muestras)
   ========================================================= */
seq AS (
    SELECT
        Torre,
        Turno,
        Dia_Op,
        ts_muestra,
        prev_ts = LAG(ts_muestra) OVER (PARTITION BY Torre ORDER BY ts_muestra)
    FROM b_join
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        bj.*,
        s.prev_ts
    FROM b_join bj
    INNER JOIN seq s
        ON  s.Torre  = bj.Torre
        AND s.Turno  = bj.Turno
        AND s.Dia_Op = bj.Dia_Op
        AND (
            (s.ts_muestra = bj.ts_muestra)
            OR (s.ts_muestra IS NULL AND bj.ts_muestra IS NULL)
        )
),
/* =========================================================
   7) Agregación al nivel del reporte (por Día operacional)
   ========================================================= */
agg AS (
    SELECT
        Dia = Dia_Op,

        Apilado_TMH_T1_TA = SUM(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='A' THEN Ton_Real END),
        Apilado_TMH_T1_TB = SUM(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='B' THEN Ton_Real END),
        Apilado_TMH_T2_TA = SUM(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='A' THEN Ton_Real END),
        Apilado_TMH_T2_TB = SUM(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='B' THEN Ton_Real END),

        Apilado_TMH_TA = SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN Ton_Real END),
        Apilado_TMH_TB = SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN Ton_Real END),

        HE_T1_TA = SUM(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='A' THEN Horas_Reales END),
        HE_T1_TB = SUM(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='B' THEN Horas_Reales END),
        HE_T2_TA = SUM(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='A' THEN Horas_Reales END),
        HE_T2_TB = SUM(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='B' THEN Horas_Reales END),

        HE_TA = SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN Horas_Reales END),
        HE_TB = SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN Horas_Reales END),

        TPH_T1_TA = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='A' THEN TPH_Real END),
		TPH_T1_TB = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='B' THEN TPH_Real END),
		TPH_T2_TA = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='A' THEN TPH_Real END),
		TPH_T2_TB = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='B' THEN TPH_Real END),
		
		TPH_TA = CASE 
            WHEN ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN Horas_Reales END),0) <= 0 THEN 0.0
            WHEN ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN Ton_Real END),0) <= 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN Ton_Real END),0)
                 / NULLIF(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN Horas_Reales END),0),0)
         END,
		TPH_TB = CASE 
            WHEN ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN Horas_Reales END),0) <= 0 THEN 0.0
            WHEN ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN Ton_Real END),0) <= 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN Ton_Real END),0)
                 / NULLIF(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN Horas_Reales END),0),0)
         END,
		
		Factor_T1_TA = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='A' THEN Factor_Masa END),
		Factor_T1_TB = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='B' THEN Factor_Masa END),
		Factor_T2_TA = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='A' THEN Factor_Masa END),
		Factor_T2_TB = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='B' THEN Factor_Masa END),

        HoraMuestra_TA = MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ts_muestra END),
        HoraMuestra_TB = MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ts_muestra END),

        PrevTS_T1_TA = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='A' THEN prev_ts END),
        PrevTS_T1_TB = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='B' THEN prev_ts END),
        PrevTS_T2_TA = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='A' THEN prev_ts END),
        PrevTS_T2_TB = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='B' THEN prev_ts END),

        Real_TM1_TA_Quim = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='A' THEN Peso_Quimico_kg_fix END),
        Real_TM1_TA_Fis  = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='A' THEN Peso_Total_kg_fix  END),
        Real_TM1_TB_Quim = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='B' THEN Peso_Quimico_kg_fix END),
        Real_TM1_TB_Fis  = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T1' AND Turno='B' THEN Peso_Total_kg_fix  END),

        Real_TM2_TA_Quim = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='A' THEN Peso_Quimico_kg_fix END),
        Real_TM2_TA_Fis  = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='A' THEN Peso_Total_kg_fix  END),
        Real_TM2_TB_Quim = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='B' THEN Peso_Quimico_kg_fix END),
        Real_TM2_TB_Fis  = MAX(CASE WHEN Torre='T2' AND Turno='B' THEN Peso_Total_kg_fix  END)
    FROM base
    GROUP BY Dia_Op
),
/* =========================================================
   8) Teóricos (K=17 / 55) con Δt/12 (si no hay prev o ts => 1.0)
   ========================================================= */
calc AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,

        Teo_TM1_TA_Quimico = CAST((17.0 * ISNULL(a.Factor_T1_TA,0) * ISNULL(a.HE_T1_TA,0) / 12.0)
                           * (CASE WHEN a.PrevTS_T1_TA IS NULL OR a.HoraMuestra_TA IS NULL THEN 1.0
                                   ELSE (DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.PrevTS_T1_TA, a.HoraMuestra_TA)/3600.0)/12.0 END) AS decimal(18,6)),
        Teo_TM1_TA_Fisico  = CAST((55.0 * ISNULL(a.Factor_T1_TA,0) * ISNULL(a.HE_T1_TA,0) / 12.0)
                           * (CASE WHEN a.PrevTS_T1_TA IS NULL OR a.HoraMuestra_TA IS NULL THEN 1.0
                                   ELSE (DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.PrevTS_T1_TA, a.HoraMuestra_TA)/3600.0)/12.0 END) AS decimal(18,6)),

        Teo_TM1_TB_Quimico = CAST((17.0 * ISNULL(a.Factor_T1_TB,0) * ISNULL(a.HE_T1_TB,0) / 12.0)
                           * (CASE WHEN a.PrevTS_T1_TB IS NULL OR a.HoraMuestra_TB IS NULL THEN 1.0
                                   ELSE (DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.PrevTS_T1_TB, a.HoraMuestra_TB)/3600.0)/12.0 END) AS decimal(18,6)),
        Teo_TM1_TB_Fisico  = CAST((55.0 * ISNULL(a.Factor_T1_TB,0) * ISNULL(a.HE_T1_TB,0) / 12.0)
                           * (CASE WHEN a.PrevTS_T1_TB IS NULL OR a.HoraMuestra_TB IS NULL THEN 1.0
                                   ELSE (DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.PrevTS_T1_TB, a.HoraMuestra_TB)/3600.0)/12.0 END) AS decimal(18,6)),

        Teo_TM2_TA_Quimico = CAST((17.0 * ISNULL(a.Factor_T2_TA,0) * ISNULL(a.HE_T2_TA,0) / 12.0)
                           * (CASE WHEN a.PrevTS_T2_TA IS NULL OR a.HoraMuestra_TA IS NULL THEN 1.0
                                   ELSE (DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.PrevTS_T2_TA, a.HoraMuestra_TA)/3600.0)/12.0 END) AS decimal(18,6)),
        Teo_TM2_TA_Fisico  = CAST((55.0 * ISNULL(a.Factor_T2_TA,0) * ISNULL(a.HE_T2_TA,0) / 12.0)
                           * (CASE WHEN a.PrevTS_T2_TA IS NULL OR a.HoraMuestra_TA IS NULL THEN 1.0
                                   ELSE (DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.PrevTS_T2_TA, a.HoraMuestra_TA)/3600.0)/12.0 END) AS decimal(18,6)),

        Teo_TM2_TB_Quimico = CAST((17.0 * ISNULL(a.Factor_T2_TB,0) * ISNULL(a.HE_T2_TB,0) / 12.0)
                           * (CASE WHEN a.PrevTS_T2_TB IS NULL OR a.HoraMuestra_TB IS NULL THEN 1.0
                                   ELSE (DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.PrevTS_T2_TB, a.HoraMuestra_TB)/3600.0)/12.0 END) AS decimal(18,6)),
        Teo_TM2_TB_Fisico  = CAST((55.0 * ISNULL(a.Factor_T2_TB,0) * ISNULL(a.HE_T2_TB,0) / 12.0)
                           * (CASE WHEN a.PrevTS_T2_TB IS NULL OR a.HoraMuestra_TB IS NULL THEN 1.0
                                   ELSE (DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.PrevTS_T2_TB, a.HoraMuestra_TB)/3600.0)/12.0 END) AS decimal(18,6))
    FROM agg a
)
SELECT
    /* =========================
       Layout completo del reporte
       ========================= */
    Dia = c.Dia,

    /* Apilado (NULL -> 0) */
    [TA_T1]      = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_T1_TA,0),
    [TB_T1]      = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_T1_TB,0),
    [Dia_T1]     = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_T1_TA,0) + ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_T1_TB,0),

    [TA_T2]      = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_T2_TA,0),
    [TB_T2]      = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_T2_TB,0),
    [Dia_T2]     = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_T2_TA,0) + ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_T2_TB,0),

    [TA_Total]   = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_TA,0),
    [TB_Total]   = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_TB,0),
    [Dia_Total]  = ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_TA,0) + ISNULL(c.Apilado_TMH_TB,0),

    /* HE (NULL -> 0) */
    [HE_T1_TA]      = ISNULL(c.HE_T1_TA,0),
    [HE_T1_TB]      = ISNULL(c.HE_T1_TB,0),
    [HE_T2_TA]      = ISNULL(c.HE_T2_TA,0),
    [HE_T2_TB]      = ISNULL(c.HE_T2_TB,0),
    [HE_Total_TA]   = ISNULL(c.HE_TA,0),
    [HE_Total_TB]   = ISNULL(c.HE_TB,0),

    /* TPH (NULL se mantiene si no hay HE; individuales NULL->0 opcional, aquí los dejo como vienen) */
    [TPH_T1_TA]     = ISNULL(c.TPH_T1_TA,0),
	[TPH_T1_TB]     = ISNULL(c.TPH_T1_TB,0),
	[TPH_T2_TA]     = ISNULL(c.TPH_T2_TA,0),
	[TPH_T2_TB]     = ISNULL(c.TPH_T2_TB,0),
	[TPH_Total_TA]  = ISNULL(c.TPH_TA,0),
	[TPH_Total_TB]  = ISNULL(c.TPH_TB,0),

    /* Factor */
    [Factor_T1_TA]  = ISNULL(c.Factor_T1_TA,0),
	[Factor_T1_TB]  = ISNULL(c.Factor_T1_TB,0),
	[Factor_T2_TA]  = ISNULL(c.Factor_T2_TA,0),
	[Factor_T2_TB]  = ISNULL(c.Factor_T2_TB,0),

    /* Horario muestra (NO rellenar con 0) */
    [Horario_Toma_Muestra_Turno_A] = c.HoraMuestra_TA,
    [Horario_Toma_Muestra_Turno_B] = c.HoraMuestra_TB,

    /* =========================
       Pesos: ORDEN solicitado
       Reales TM1 -> Teóricos TM1 -> Reales TM2 -> Teóricos TM2
       ========================= */

    /* Reales TM1 (NULL -> 0) */
    [Real_TM1_TA_Quimico] = ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Quim,0),
    [Real_TM1_TA_Fisico]  = ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Fis,0),
    [Real_TM1_TB_Quimico] = ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Quim,0),
    [Real_TM1_TB_Fisico]  = ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Fis,0),

    /* Teóricos TM1 (NULL -> 0) */
    [Teo_TM1_TA_Quimico]  = ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Quimico,0),
    [Teo_TM1_TA_Fisico]   = ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Fisico,0),
    [Teo_TM1_TB_Quimico]  = ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Quimico,0),
    [Teo_TM1_TB_Fisico]   = ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Fisico,0),

    /* Reales TM2 (NULL -> 0) */
    [Real_TM2_TA_Quimico] = ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Quim,0),
    [Real_TM2_TA_Fisico]  = ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Fis,0),
    [Real_TM2_TB_Quimico] = ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Quim,0),
    [Real_TM2_TB_Fisico]  = ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Fis,0),

    /* Teóricos TM2 (NULL -> 0) */
    [Teo_TM2_TA_Quimico]  = ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Quimico,0),
    [Teo_TM2_TA_Fisico]   = ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Fisico,0),
    [Teo_TM2_TB_Quimico]  = ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Quimico,0),
    [Teo_TM2_TB_Fisico]   = ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Fisico,0),

    /* =========================
       Representatividad numérica
       ========================= */
    [Rep_TM1_TA_Quimico] =
        CASE
            WHEN c.Teo_TM1_TA_Quimico IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Quimico,0)=0 THEN 0
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Quimico,0)>0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Quim,0) / NULLIF(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Quimico,0)
        END,
    [Rep_TM1_TA_Fisico] =
        CASE
            WHEN c.Teo_TM1_TA_Fisico IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Fisico,0)=0 THEN 0
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Fisico,0)>0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Fis,0) / NULLIF(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Fisico,0)
        END,
    [Rep_TM1_TB_Quimico] =
        CASE
            WHEN c.Teo_TM1_TB_Quimico IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Quimico,0)=0 THEN 0
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Quimico,0)>0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Quim,0) / NULLIF(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Quimico,0)
        END,
    [Rep_TM1_TB_Fisico] =
        CASE
            WHEN c.Teo_TM1_TB_Fisico IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Fisico,0)=0 THEN 0
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Fisico,0)>0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Fis,0) / NULLIF(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Fisico,0)
        END,

    [Rep_TM2_TA_Quimico] =
        CASE
            WHEN c.Teo_TM2_TA_Quimico IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Quimico,0)=0 THEN 0
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Quimico,0)>0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Quim,0) / NULLIF(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Quimico,0)
        END,
    [Rep_TM2_TA_Fisico] =
        CASE
            WHEN c.Teo_TM2_TA_Fisico IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Fisico,0)=0 THEN 0
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Fisico,0)>0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Fis,0) / NULLIF(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Fisico,0)
        END,
    [Rep_TM2_TB_Quimico] =
        CASE
            WHEN c.Teo_TM2_TB_Quimico IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Quimico,0)=0 THEN 0
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Quimico,0)>0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Quim,0) / NULLIF(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Quimico,0)
        END,
    [Rep_TM2_TB_Fisico] =
        CASE
            WHEN c.Teo_TM2_TB_Fisico IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Fisico,0)=0 THEN 0
            WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Fisico,0)>0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Fis,0) / NULLIF(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Fisico,0)
        END,

    /* =========================
       Estado textual: Tambor detenido
       ========================= */
    [Estado_Rep_TM1_TA_Quimico] =
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Quimico,0)=0 THEN 'Tambor detenido' ELSE NULL END,
    [Estado_Rep_TM1_TA_Fisico] =
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TA_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TA_Fisico,0)=0 THEN 'Tambor detenido' ELSE NULL END,
    [Estado_Rep_TM1_TB_Quimico] =
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Quimico,0)=0 THEN 'Tambor detenido' ELSE NULL END,
    [Estado_Rep_TM1_TB_Fisico] =
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM1_TB_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM1_TB_Fisico,0)=0 THEN 'Tambor detenido' ELSE NULL END,

    [Estado_Rep_TM2_TA_Quimico] =
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Quimico,0)=0 THEN 'Tambor detenido' ELSE NULL END,
    [Estado_Rep_TM2_TA_Fisico] =
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TA_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TA_Fisico,0)=0 THEN 'Tambor detenido' ELSE NULL END,
    [Estado_Rep_TM2_TB_Quimico] =
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Quim,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Quimico,0)=0 THEN 'Tambor detenido' ELSE NULL END,
    [Estado_Rep_TM2_TB_Fisico] =
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.Real_TM2_TB_Fis,0)=0 AND ISNULL(c.Teo_TM2_TB_Fisico,0)=0 THEN 'Tambor detenido' ELSE NULL END,

    [Limite_Representatividad] = CAST(75.0 AS decimal(5,2))
FROM calc c;

name: v_reporte_srr_excel_exacto
definition:
CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_srr_excel_exacto
AS
WITH srr AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        Torre,
        Ton_Real,
        Horas_Reales,
        TPH_Real,
        Factor_Masa,
        ts_toma_muestra,
        PesoReal_Quimico,
        PesoReal_Fisico,
        PesoTeo_Quimico,
        PesoTeo_Fisico
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_base_turno_torre_excel
    WHERE Torre IN ('T3', 'TM3', 'SRR')  -- dejamos robusto por si hay variaciones
),
pvt AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,

        /* =========================
           Apilado SRR (Ton_Real)
           ========================= */
        SUM(CASE WHEN Turno = 'A' THEN ISNULL(Ton_Real, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) AS Apilado_SRR_TA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Turno = 'B' THEN ISNULL(Ton_Real, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) AS Apilado_SRR_TB,
        SUM(ISNULL(Ton_Real, 0.0))                                         AS Apilado_SRR_Dia,

        /* =========================
           Horas Operación T3
           ========================= */
        SUM(CASE WHEN Turno = 'A' THEN ISNULL(Horas_Reales, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) AS Horas_Operacion_T3_TA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Turno = 'B' THEN ISNULL(Horas_Reales, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) AS Horas_Operacion_T3_TB,

        /* =========================
           TPH Tambor 3 (ya viene calculado)
           Blindaje: si HE<=0 o Ton<=0 => 0
           ========================= */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ISNULL(Horas_Reales,0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) <= 0
              OR SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ISNULL(Ton_Real,0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) <= 0
            THEN 0.0
            ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ISNULL(TPH_Real,0.0) END)
        END AS TPH_Tambor_3_TA,

        CASE
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ISNULL(Horas_Reales,0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) <= 0
              OR SUM(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ISNULL(Ton_Real,0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) <= 0
            THEN 0.0
            ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ISNULL(TPH_Real,0.0) END)
        END AS TPH_Tambor_3_TB,

        /* =========================
           Factor Masa Teórica (ya viene calculado)
           ========================= */
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ISNULL(Factor_Masa, 0.0) END) AS Factor_Masa_Teorica_T3_TA,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ISNULL(Factor_Masa, 0.0) END) AS Factor_Masa_Teorica_T3_TB,

        /* =========================
           Horario toma de muestra
           ========================= */
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ts_toma_muestra END) AS Horario_Toma_Muestra_Turno_A,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ts_toma_muestra END) AS Horario_Toma_Muestra_Turno_B,

        /* =========================
           Pesos reales
           ========================= */
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ISNULL(PesoReal_Quimico, 0.0) END) AS Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Quimico,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ISNULL(PesoReal_Fisico,  0.0) END) AS Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Fisico,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ISNULL(PesoReal_Quimico, 0.0) END) AS Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Quimico,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ISNULL(PesoReal_Fisico,  0.0) END) AS Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Fisico,

        /* =========================
           Pesos teóricos
           ========================= */
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ISNULL(PesoTeo_Quimico, 0.0) END) AS Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Quimico,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='A' THEN ISNULL(PesoTeo_Fisico,  0.0) END) AS Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Fisico,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ISNULL(PesoTeo_Quimico, 0.0) END) AS Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Quimico,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Turno='B' THEN ISNULL(PesoTeo_Fisico,  0.0) END) AS Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Fisico

    FROM srr
    GROUP BY Fecha
)
SELECT
    /* Dia */
    Fecha AS Dia,

    /* Apilado SRR */
    ISNULL(Apilado_SRR_TA, 0.0)  AS Apilado_SRR_TA,
    ISNULL(Apilado_SRR_TB, 0.0)  AS Apilado_SRR_TB,
    ISNULL(Apilado_SRR_Dia, 0.0) AS Apilado_SRR_Dia,

    /* Horas Operación */
    ISNULL(Horas_Operacion_T3_TA, 0.0) AS Horas_Operacion_T3_TA,
    ISNULL(Horas_Operacion_T3_TB, 0.0) AS Horas_Operacion_T3_TB,

    /* TPH Tambor 3 */
    ISNULL(TPH_Tambor_3_TA, 0.0) AS TPH_Tambor_3_TA,
    ISNULL(TPH_Tambor_3_TB, 0.0) AS TPH_Tambor_3_TB,

    /* Factor Masa Teórica */
    ISNULL(Factor_Masa_Teorica_T3_TA, 0.0) AS Factor_Masa_Teorica_T3_TA,
    ISNULL(Factor_Masa_Teorica_T3_TB, 0.0) AS Factor_Masa_Teorica_T3_TB,

    /* Horarios toma de muestra */
    Horario_Toma_Muestra_Turno_A,
    Horario_Toma_Muestra_Turno_B,

    /* Pesos reales */
    ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Quimico, 0.0) AS Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Quimico,
    ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Fisico,  0.0) AS Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Fisico,
    ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Quimico, 0.0) AS Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Quimico,
    ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Fisico,  0.0) AS Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Fisico,

    /* Pesos teóricos */
    ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Quimico, 0.0) AS Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Quimico,
    ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Fisico,  0.0) AS Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Fisico,
    ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Quimico, 0.0) AS Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Quimico,
    ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Fisico,  0.0) AS Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Fisico,

    /* Representatividad (NUMÉRICA, 0–100) */
    Fecha AS Dia_Representatividad,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Quimico,0)=0 AND ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Quimico,0)=0
        THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Quimico,0) / NULLIF(ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Quimico,0),0)
    END AS Representatividad_TM3_Turno_A_Quimico,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Fisico,0)=0 AND ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Fisico,0)=0
        THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Fisico,0) / NULLIF(ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Fisico,0),0)
    END AS Representatividad_TM3_Turno_A_Fisico,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Quimico,0)=0 AND ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Quimico,0)=0
        THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Quimico,0) / NULLIF(ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Quimico,0),0)
    END AS Representatividad_TM3_Turno_B_Quimico,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Fisico,0)=0 AND ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Fisico,0)=0
        THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Fisico,0) / NULLIF(ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Fisico,0),0)
    END AS Representatividad_TM3_Turno_B_Fisico,

    /* Límite fijo */
    CAST(75.0 AS float) AS Limite_Representatividad,

    /* Estado textual (exacto): “Tambor detenido” cuando Real=0 y Teo=0 */
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Quimico,0)=0 AND ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Quimico,0)=0
        THEN 'Tambor detenido'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Estado_TM3_Turno_A_Quimico,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TA_Fisico,0)=0 AND ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TA_Fisico,0)=0
        THEN 'Tambor detenido'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Estado_TM3_Turno_A_Fisico,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Quimico,0)=0 AND ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Quimico,0)=0
        THEN 'Tambor detenido'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Estado_TM3_Turno_B_Quimico,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Real_TM3_TB_Fisico,0)=0 AND ISNULL(Peso_Muestra_Teorica_TM3_TB_Fisico,0)=0
        THEN 'Tambor detenido'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Estado_TM3_Turno_B_Fisico

FROM pvt;

CREATE   VIEW
    [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_plan_produccion_catodica_diaria_test]
AS

WITH Registros AS
(
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.fecha AS Fecha,
        p.produccion_catodos
            AS Produccion_Catodos_Plan,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY p.fecha
            ORDER BY p.id DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[planes_mensuales] p

    WHERE p.fecha IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    id,
    Fecha,
    Produccion_Catodos_Plan,

    CASE
        WHEN Produccion_Catodos_Plan IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_PLAN'

        WHEN Produccion_Catodos_Plan < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_Plan_Produccion_Catodica

FROM Registros

WHERE rn = 1;

CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr_leyes_tm AS

WITH base_tms AS (
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        'A' AS Turno,
        'TM1' AS TM,

        Flag_Apilado_Valido,
        Flag_TMS_Valido,
        Observacion_TMS,
        Factor_Ajuste_Camiones_Usado,

        TMH_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A AS TMH_Con_Sal_SRR,
        TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_A AS TMS_Con_Sal_SRR,
        TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A AS TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Fecha,
        'B' AS Turno,
        'TM1' AS TM,

        Flag_Apilado_Valido,
        Flag_TMS_Valido,
        Observacion_TMS,
        Factor_Ajuste_Camiones_Usado,

        TMH_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B AS TMH_Con_Sal_SRR,
        TMS_TM1_Con_Sal_SRR_B AS TMS_Con_Sal_SRR,
        TMS_TM1_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B AS TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Fecha,
        'A' AS Turno,
        'TM2' AS TM,

        Flag_Apilado_Valido,
        Flag_TMS_Valido,
        Observacion_TMS,
        Factor_Ajuste_Camiones_Usado,

        TMH_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A AS TMH_Con_Sal_SRR,
        TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_A AS TMS_Con_Sal_SRR,
        TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A AS TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Fecha,
        'B' AS Turno,
        'TM2' AS TM,

        Flag_Apilado_Valido,
        Flag_TMS_Valido,
        Observacion_TMS,
        Factor_Ajuste_Camiones_Usado,

        TMH_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B AS TMH_Con_Sal_SRR,
        TMS_TM2_Con_Sal_SRR_B AS TMS_Con_Sal_SRR,
        TMS_TM2_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B AS TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr
)

SELECT
    b.Fecha,
    b.Turno,
    b.TM,

    b.Flag_Apilado_Valido,
    b.Flag_TMS_Valido,
    b.Observacion_TMS,
    b.Factor_Ajuste_Camiones_Usado,

    b.TMH_Con_Sal_SRR,
    b.TMS_Con_Sal_SRR,
    b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR,

    l.Representatividad_TM,

    l.CuT,
    l.Fuente_CuT,

    l.CuS,
    l.Fuente_CuS,

    l.FeT,
    l.Fuente_FeT,

    l.FeS,
    l.Fuente_FeS,

    l.CO3,
    l.Fuente_CO3,

    l.ConsH,
    l.Fuente_ConsH,

    l.Malla_Menos_1_2,
    l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_1_2,

    l.Malla_Menos_100,
    l.Fuente_Malla_Menos_100,

    l.CuFe,
    l.Fuente_CuFe,

    l.Caolinita,
    l.Fuente_Caolinita,

    l.CaolBeta,
    l.Fuente_CaolBeta,

    l.Cuarzo,
    l.Fuente_Cuarzo,

    CASE
        WHEN b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR IS NULL
          OR l.CuT IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * l.CuT / 100.0
    END AS Fino_CuT,

    CASE
        WHEN b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR IS NULL
          OR l.CuS IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * l.CuS / 100.0
    END AS Fino_CuS,

    CASE
        WHEN b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR IS NULL
          OR l.FeT IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * l.FeT / 100.0
    END AS Fino_FeT,

    CASE
        WHEN b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR IS NULL
          OR l.FeS IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE b.TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * l.FeS / 100.0
    END AS Fino_FeS,

    CASE
        WHEN l.CuT IS NULL
          OR l.CuT = 0
          OR l.CuS IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE l.CuS / NULLIF(l.CuT, 0)
    END AS RS_CuS_CuT

FROM base_tms b

LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_validadas_tm_turno l
    ON l.Fecha = b.Fecha
   AND l.Turno = b.Turno
   AND l.TM = b.TM;

definition:
CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr_leyes_dia AS

SELECT
    Fecha,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR ELSE 0 END)
        AS TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_Dia,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN Fino_CuT ELSE 0 END)
        AS Fino_CuT_Dia,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN Fino_CuS ELSE 0 END)
        AS Fino_CuS_Dia,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN Fino_FeT ELSE 0 END)
        AS Fino_FeT_Dia,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN Fino_FeS ELSE 0 END)
        AS Fino_FeS_Dia,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * CuT ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS CuT_Pond,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * CuS ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS CuS_Pond,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * FeT ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS FeT_Pond,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * FeS ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS FeS_Pond,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * CO3 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS CO3_Pond,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * ConsH ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS ConsH_Pond,

    SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR * Malla_Menos_100 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN TMS_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS Malla_Menos_100_Pond,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN Fino_CuT ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE
            SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN Fino_CuS ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Flag_TMS_Valido = 1 THEN Fino_CuT ELSE 0 END), 0)
    END AS RS_CuS_CuT_Pond

FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr_leyes_tm

GROUP BY Fecha;

name: v_apilado_base_mina_stock_srr
definition:
CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_base_mina_stock_srr AS

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

        CASE
            WHEN Turno IN ('TA', 'A') THEN 'A'
            WHEN Turno IN ('TB', 'B') THEN 'B'
            ELSE Turno
        END AS Turno,

        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN Origen = 'Stock' 
                 AND Fase <> 'SRR'
                    THEN COALESCE(Ton, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Ton_Stock_Camiones,

        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN Origen = 'Mina'
                    THEN COALESCE(Ton, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Ton_Mina_Camiones,

        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN Origen = 'Stock'
                 AND Fase = 'SRR'
                    THEN COALESCE(Ton, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Ton_SRR

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE Fecha IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        CAST(Fecha AS date),
        CASE
            WHEN Turno IN ('TA', 'A') THEN 'A'
            WHEN Turno IN ('TB', 'B') THEN 'B'
            ELSE Turno
        END
)

SELECT
    Fecha,
    Turno,

    Ton_Stock_Camiones,
    Ton_Mina_Camiones,
    Ton_SRR,

    Ton_Stock_Camiones + Ton_Mina_Camiones AS Ton_Stock_Mina_Camiones,

    CASE
        WHEN Ton_Stock_Camiones + Ton_Mina_Camiones = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE Ton_Stock_Camiones 
             / NULLIF(Ton_Stock_Camiones + Ton_Mina_Camiones, 0)
    END AS Prop_Stock_Camiones,

    CASE
        WHEN Ton_Stock_Camiones + Ton_Mina_Camiones = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE Ton_Mina_Camiones
             / NULLIF(Ton_Stock_Camiones + Ton_Mina_Camiones, 0)
    END AS Prop_Mina_Camiones

FROM base;

name: sp_sincronizar_bd_ton
definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_sincronizar_bd_ton]
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin    date
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @FechaCorteContingencia date = '2026-09-01';

    /* ============================================================
       1. Validar parámetros
       ============================================================ */
    IF @fecha_inicio IS NULL
       OR @fecha_fin IS NULL
       OR @fecha_inicio > @fecha_fin
    BEGIN
        THROW 50001,
              'El rango de fechas ingresado no es válido.',
              1;
    END;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #src;

    /* ============================================================
       2. Evaluabilidad operacional GLOBAL
          SIN CAMBIOS.
       ============================================================ */
    ;WITH evaluabilidad AS
    (
        SELECT
            Fecha = CAST(Fecha AS date),

            Turno_Evaluable_TA =
                MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN Turno = 'A'
                            THEN CAST(Turno_Evaluable AS tinyint)
                    END
                ),

            Turno_Evaluable_TB =
                MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN Turno = 'B'
                            THEN CAST(Turno_Evaluable AS tinyint)
                    END
                )

        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_estado_apilado_turno_representatividad

        WHERE Fecha >= @fecha_inicio
          AND Fecha < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)

        GROUP BY
            CAST(Fecha AS date)
    )

    /* ============================================================
       3. Preparar origen completo T1 + T2 + SRR
       ============================================================ */
    SELECT
        Fecha =
            CAST(v.Fecha AS date),

        /* ========================================================
           Tonelajes T1/T2
           ======================================================== */
        Apilado_TMH_CV08_TA =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                        THEN c.TMH_TM1_TA_Resuelto
                    ELSE v.[Apilado TMH CV-08 TA]
                END
                AS decimal(18,3)
            ),

        Apilado_TMH_CV08_TB =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                        THEN c.TMH_TM1_TB_Resuelto
                    ELSE v.[Apilado TMH CV-08 TB]
                END
                AS decimal(18,3)
            ),

        Apilado_TMH_CV108_TA =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                        THEN c.TMH_TM2_TA_Resuelto
                    ELSE v.[Apilado TMH CV-108 TA]
                END
                AS decimal(18,3)
            ),

        Apilado_TMH_CV108_TB =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                        THEN c.TMH_TM2_TB_Resuelto
                    ELSE v.[Apilado TMH CV-108 TB]
                END
                AS decimal(18,3)
            ),

        /* ========================================================
           Representatividad T1
           ======================================================== */
        Rep_TM1_TA_Qui =
            CAST(v.[Rep. TM1 TA Qui.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_TM1_TA_Fis =
            CAST(v.[Rep. TM1 TA Fis.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_TM1_TB_Qui =
            CAST(v.[Rep. TM1 TB Qui.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_TM1_TB_Fis =
            CAST(v.[Rep. TM1 TB Fis.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        /* ========================================================
           Representatividad T2
           ======================================================== */
        Rep_TM2_TA_Qui =
            CAST(v.[Rep. TM2 TA Qui.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_TM2_TA_Fis =
            CAST(v.[Rep. TM2 TA Fis.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_TM2_TB_Qui =
            CAST(v.[Rep. TM2 TB Qui.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_TM2_TB_Fis =
            CAST(v.[Rep. TM2 TB Fis.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        /* ========================================================
           Flags químicos T1/T2
           SIN CAMBIO METODOLÓGICO
           ======================================================== */
        Muestra_representativa_TM1_TA =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(c.Evaluable_TM1_TA_Resuelto, 0) = 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM1 TA Qui.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_A, 0) <= 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM1 TA Qui.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                END
                AS int
            ),

        Muestra_representativa_TM1_TB =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(c.Evaluable_TM1_TB_Resuelto, 0) = 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM1 TB Qui.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_B, 0) <= 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM1 TB Qui.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                END
                AS int
            ),

        Muestra_representativa_TM2_TA =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(c.Evaluable_TM2_TA_Resuelto, 0) = 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM2 TA Qui.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_A, 0) <= 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM2 TA Qui.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                END
                AS int
            ),

        Muestra_representativa_TM2_TB =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(c.Evaluable_TM2_TB_Resuelto, 0) = 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM2 TB Qui.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_B, 0) <= 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM2 TB Qui.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                END
                AS int
            ),

        /* ========================================================
           Flags físicos T1/T2
           ======================================================== */
        FISICO_TM1_TA =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(c.Evaluable_TM1_TA_Resuelto, 0) = 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM1 TA Fis.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_A, 0) <= 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM1 TA Fis.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                END
                AS int
            ),

        FISICO_TM1_TB =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(c.Evaluable_TM1_TB_Resuelto, 0) = 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM1 TB Fis.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_B, 0) <= 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM1 TB Fis.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                END
                AS int
            ),

        FISICO_TM2_TA =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(c.Evaluable_TM2_TA_Resuelto, 0) = 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM2 TA Fis.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_A, 0) <= 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM2 TA Fis.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                END
                AS int
            ),

        FISICO_TM2_TB =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                    THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(c.Evaluable_TM2_TB_Resuelto, 0) = 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM2 TB Fis.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_B, 0) <= 0
                                THEN NULL
                            WHEN v.[Rep. TM2 TB Fis.] >= 0.75
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                END
                AS int
            ),

        /* ========================================================
           Torre 3 / SRR
           SIN CAMBIOS
           ======================================================== */
        Apilado_TMH_CV01_TA =
            CAST(
                v.[Apilado TMH CV-01 TA]
                AS decimal(18,3)
            ),

        Apilado_TMH_CV01_TB =
            CAST(
                v.[Apilado TMH CV-01 TB]
                AS decimal(18,3)
            ),

        Rep_SRR_TA_Qui =
            CAST(v.[Rep. SRR TA Qui.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_SRR_TA_Fis =
            CAST(v.[Rep. SRR TA Fis.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_SRR_TB_Qui =
            CAST(v.[Rep. SRR TB Qui.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Rep_SRR_TB_Fis =
            CAST(v.[Rep. SRR TB Fis.] AS decimal(18,10)),

        Muestra_representativa_TM3_TA =
            CAST(v.[Muestra representativa TM3 TA] AS int),

        Muestra_representativa_TM3_TB =
            CAST(v.[Muestra representativa TM3 TB] AS int),

        FISICO_TM3_TA =
            CAST(v.[FISICO TM3 TA] AS int),

        FISICO_TM3_TB =
            CAST(v.[FISICO TM3 TB] AS int),

        /* ========================================================
           Evaluabilidad global
           SIN CAMBIOS
           ======================================================== */
        e.Turno_Evaluable_TA,
        e.Turno_Evaluable_TB,

        /* ========================================================
           NUEVO:
           Evaluabilidad independiente T1/T2 persistible.

           Antes del corte se conserva NULL en estas columnas.
           El histórico continúa resolviéndose en la vista.
           ======================================================== */
        Evaluable_TM1_TA =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                        THEN c.Evaluable_TM1_TA_Resuelto
                    ELSE NULL
                END
                AS tinyint
            ),

        Evaluable_TM1_TB =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                        THEN c.Evaluable_TM1_TB_Resuelto
                    ELSE NULL
                END
                AS tinyint
            ),

        Evaluable_TM2_TA =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                        THEN c.Evaluable_TM2_TA_Resuelto
                    ELSE NULL
                END
                AS tinyint
            ),

        Evaluable_TM2_TB =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia
                        THEN c.Evaluable_TM2_TB_Resuelto
                    ELSE NULL
                END
                AS tinyint
            ),

        /* Control técnico interno. No se persiste. */
        Contingencia_T12_Disponible =
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN c.Fecha IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
                AS tinyint
            )

    INTO #src

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_bd_ton_oficial AS v

    LEFT JOIN evaluabilidad AS e
      ON e.Fecha = CAST(v.Fecha AS date)

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_datos_apilado_tmh_v2 AS a
      ON a.Fecha = CAST(v.Fecha AS date)

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_bd_ton_t12_contingencia_test AS c
      ON c.Fecha = CAST(v.Fecha AS date)
     AND CAST(v.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaCorteContingencia

    WHERE v.Fecha >= @fecha_inicio
      AND v.Fecha < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin);


    /* ============================================================
       4. Validar existencia
       ============================================================ */
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #src
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 50002,
              'v_bd_ton_oficial no devolvió registros para el rango solicitado.',
              1;
    END;


    /* ============================================================
       5. Validar una fila por fecha
       ============================================================ */
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT
            Fecha
        FROM #src
        GROUP BY Fecha
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 50003,
              'La vista devolvió más de un registro para una misma fecha.',
              1;
    END;


    /* ============================================================
       5.1 Validar cobertura de PI/TUM desde corte
       ============================================================ */
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #src
        WHERE Fecha >= @FechaCorteContingencia
          AND Contingencia_T12_Disponible = 0
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 50004,
              'Falta cobertura de v_bd_ton_t12_contingencia_test para una o más fechas posteriores al 01-09-2026.',
              1;
    END;


    DECLARE @filas_actualizadas int = 0;
    DECLARE @filas_insertadas  int = 0;


    BEGIN TRY

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        /* ========================================================
           6. Actualizar fechas existentes
           ======================================================== */
        UPDATE destino
        SET
            destino.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TA =
                origen.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TA,

            destino.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TB =
                origen.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TB,

            destino.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TA =
                origen.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TA,

            destino.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TB =
                origen.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TB,

            destino.Rep_TM1_TA_Qui =
                origen.Rep_TM1_TA_Qui,

            destino.Rep_TM1_TA_Fis =
                origen.Rep_TM1_TA_Fis,

            destino.Rep_TM1_TB_Qui =
                origen.Rep_TM1_TB_Qui,

            destino.Rep_TM1_TB_Fis =
                origen.Rep_TM1_TB_Fis,

            destino.Rep_TM2_TA_Qui =
                origen.Rep_TM2_TA_Qui,

            destino.Rep_TM2_TA_Fis =
                origen.Rep_TM2_TA_Fis,

            destino.Rep_TM2_TB_Qui =
                origen.Rep_TM2_TB_Qui,

            destino.Rep_TM2_TB_Fis =
                origen.Rep_TM2_TB_Fis,

            destino.Muestra_representativa_TM1_TA =
                origen.Muestra_representativa_TM1_TA,

            destino.Muestra_representativa_TM1_TB =
                origen.Muestra_representativa_TM1_TB,

            destino.Muestra_representativa_TM2_TA =
                origen.Muestra_representativa_TM2_TA,

            destino.Muestra_representativa_TM2_TB =
                origen.Muestra_representativa_TM2_TB,

            destino.FISICO_TM1_TA =
                origen.FISICO_TM1_TA,

            destino.FISICO_TM1_TB =
                origen.FISICO_TM1_TB,

            destino.FISICO_TM2_TA =
                origen.FISICO_TM2_TA,

            destino.FISICO_TM2_TB =
                origen.FISICO_TM2_TB,

            /* SRR */
            destino.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TA =
                origen.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TA,

            destino.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TB =
                origen.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TB,

            destino.Rep_SRR_TA_Qui =
                origen.Rep_SRR_TA_Qui,

            destino.Rep_SRR_TA_Fis =
                origen.Rep_SRR_TA_Fis,

            destino.Rep_SRR_TB_Qui =
                origen.Rep_SRR_TB_Qui,

            destino.Rep_SRR_TB_Fis =
                origen.Rep_SRR_TB_Fis,

            destino.Muestra_representativa_TM3_TA =
                origen.Muestra_representativa_TM3_TA,

            destino.Muestra_representativa_TM3_TB =
                origen.Muestra_representativa_TM3_TB,

            destino.FISICO_TM3_TA =
                origen.FISICO_TM3_TA,

            destino.FISICO_TM3_TB =
                origen.FISICO_TM3_TB,

            destino.Turno_Evaluable_TA =
                origen.Turno_Evaluable_TA,

            destino.Turno_Evaluable_TB =
                origen.Turno_Evaluable_TB,

            /* NUEVO */
            destino.Evaluable_TM1_TA =
                origen.Evaluable_TM1_TA,

            destino.Evaluable_TM1_TB =
                origen.Evaluable_TM1_TB,

            destino.Evaluable_TM2_TA =
                origen.Evaluable_TM2_TA,

            destino.Evaluable_TM2_TB =
                origen.Evaluable_TM2_TB

        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.BD_Ton AS destino

        INNER JOIN #src AS origen
          ON origen.Fecha = destino.Fecha;

        SET @filas_actualizadas = @@ROWCOUNT;


        /* ========================================================
           7. Insertar fechas nuevas
           ======================================================== */
        INSERT INTO inventar_SpcHidr.BD_Ton
        (
            Fecha,

            Apilado_TMH_CV08_TA,
            Apilado_TMH_CV08_TB,
            Apilado_TMH_CV108_TA,
            Apilado_TMH_CV108_TB,

            Rep_TM1_TA_Qui,
            Rep_TM1_TA_Fis,
            Rep_TM1_TB_Qui,
            Rep_TM1_TB_Fis,

            Rep_TM2_TA_Qui,
            Rep_TM2_TA_Fis,
            Rep_TM2_TB_Qui,
            Rep_TM2_TB_Fis,

            Muestra_representativa_TM1_TA,
            Muestra_representativa_TM1_TB,
            Muestra_representativa_TM2_TA,
            Muestra_representativa_TM2_TB,

            FISICO_TM1_TA,
            FISICO_TM1_TB,
            FISICO_TM2_TA,
            FISICO_TM2_TB,

            Apilado_TMH_CV01_TA,
            Apilado_TMH_CV01_TB,

            Rep_SRR_TA_Qui,
            Rep_SRR_TA_Fis,
            Rep_SRR_TB_Qui,
            Rep_SRR_TB_Fis,

            Muestra_representativa_TM3_TA,
            Muestra_representativa_TM3_TB,

            FISICO_TM3_TA,
            FISICO_TM3_TB,

            Turno_Evaluable_TA,
            Turno_Evaluable_TB,

            /* NUEVO */
            Evaluable_TM1_TA,
            Evaluable_TM1_TB,
            Evaluable_TM2_TA,
            Evaluable_TM2_TB
        )

        SELECT
            origen.Fecha,

            origen.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TA,
            origen.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TB,
            origen.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TA,
            origen.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TB,

            origen.Rep_TM1_TA_Qui,
            origen.Rep_TM1_TA_Fis,
            origen.Rep_TM1_TB_Qui,
            origen.Rep_TM1_TB_Fis,

            origen.Rep_TM2_TA_Qui,
            origen.Rep_TM2_TA_Fis,
            origen.Rep_TM2_TB_Qui,
            origen.Rep_TM2_TB_Fis,

            origen.Muestra_representativa_TM1_TA,
            origen.Muestra_representativa_TM1_TB,
            origen.Muestra_representativa_TM2_TA,
            origen.Muestra_representativa_TM2_TB,

            origen.FISICO_TM1_TA,
            origen.FISICO_TM1_TB,
            origen.FISICO_TM2_TA,
            origen.FISICO_TM2_TB,

            origen.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TA,
            origen.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TB,

            origen.Rep_SRR_TA_Qui,
            origen.Rep_SRR_TA_Fis,
            origen.Rep_SRR_TB_Qui,
            origen.Rep_SRR_TB_Fis,

            origen.Muestra_representativa_TM3_TA,
            origen.Muestra_representativa_TM3_TB,

            origen.FISICO_TM3_TA,
            origen.FISICO_TM3_TB,

            origen.Turno_Evaluable_TA,
            origen.Turno_Evaluable_TB,

            /* NUEVO */
            origen.Evaluable_TM1_TA,
            origen.Evaluable_TM1_TB,
            origen.Evaluable_TM2_TA,
            origen.Evaluable_TM2_TB

        FROM #src AS origen

        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.BD_Ton AS destino
            WHERE destino.Fecha = origen.Fecha
        );

        SET @filas_insertadas = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH

        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;

    END CATCH;


    /* ============================================================
       8. Resumen
       CONTRATO PYTHON/DASH INTACTO
       ============================================================ */
    SELECT
        Fecha_Inicio = @fecha_inicio,
        Fecha_Fin    = @fecha_fin,

        Filas_Origen =
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #src),

        Filas_Actualizadas =
            @filas_actualizadas,

        Filas_Insertadas =
            @filas_insertadas,

        Fechas_Sin_Evaluabilidad =
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM #src
            WHERE Turno_Evaluable_TA IS NULL
               OR Turno_Evaluable_TB IS NULL
        );

END;

name: v_planes_mensuales_diarios_test
definition:
CREATE   VIEW
    [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_planes_mensuales_diarios_test]
AS

WITH PlanesRankeados AS
(
    SELECT
        pm.id,
        pm.fecha,

        pm.cut,
        pm.cu_fino,

        pm.rotopala1,
        pm.rotopala2,
        pm.camiones,

        pm.produccion_catodos,

        pm.srr,
        pm.cut_srr,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY pm.fecha
            ORDER BY pm.id DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[planes_mensuales] pm

    WHERE pm.fecha IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    id,
    fecha AS Fecha,

    /* ========================================================
       CAMPOS DE APILADO
       Solo se conservan para diagnóstico.
       No reemplazan la fuente ya validada del reporte.
       ======================================================== */

    cut
        AS Ley_CuT_Plan_Fuente,

    cu_fino
        AS Cobre_Fino_Apilado_Plan_Fuente,

    /* ========================================================
       ROTOPALAS
       ======================================================== */

    rotopala1
        AS TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan,

    rotopala2
        AS TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan,

    /* ========================================================
       CAMIONES
       ======================================================== */

    camiones
        AS Camiones_TMS_Plan,

    /* ========================================================
       PRODUCCIÓN CATÓDICA
       ======================================================== */

    produccion_catodos
        AS Produccion_Catodos_Plan,

    /* ========================================================
       SRR

       En enero, los NULL de SRR y CuT SRR corresponden
       a valores históricos iguales a cero.
       ======================================================== */

    COALESCE(srr, 0)
        AS SRR_TMS_Plan,

    COALESCE(cut_srr, 0)
        AS Ley_CuT_Plan_SRR,

    /* ========================================================
       BANDERAS DE CONTROL
       ======================================================== */

    CASE
        WHEN rotopala1 IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_PLAN'
        WHEN rotopala1 < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_Rotopala_1_Plan,

    CASE
        WHEN rotopala2 IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_PLAN'
        WHEN rotopala2 < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_Rotopala_2_Plan,

    CASE
        WHEN camiones IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_PLAN'
        WHEN camiones < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_Camiones_Plan,

    CASE
        WHEN produccion_catodos IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_PLAN'
        WHEN produccion_catodos < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_Produccion_Catodos_Plan,

    CASE
        WHEN srr IS NULL
            THEN 'OK_CERO_DESDE_NULL'
        WHEN srr < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_SRR_TMS_Plan,

    CASE
        WHEN cut_srr IS NULL
            THEN 'OK_CERO_DESDE_NULL'
        WHEN cut_srr < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_Ley_CuT_SRR_Plan,

    CASE
        WHEN cut IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_PLAN'

        WHEN cut < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'

        WHEN cut > 2
            THEN 'REVISAR_VALOR_ALTO'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_Ley_CuT_Apilado_Fuente,

    CASE
        WHEN cu_fino IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_PLAN'

        WHEN cu_fino < 0
            THEN 'PLAN_NEGATIVO'

        WHEN cu_fino > 1000
            THEN 'REVISAR_VALOR_ALTO'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS Flag_Cobre_Fino_Apilado_Fuente

FROM PlanesRankeados

WHERE rn = 1;

name: v_apilado_proporcion_final

CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_proporcion_final AS

WITH tms_turno AS (
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        'A' AS Turno,
        TMS_Total_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_A AS Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Fecha,
        'B' AS Turno,
        TMS_Total_Sin_Sal_Con_SRR_B AS Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_tms_sin_sal_con_srr
),

base AS (
    SELECT
        t.Fecha,
        t.Turno,

        p.Ton_Stock_Camiones,
        p.Ton_Mina_Camiones,
        p.Ton_Stock_Mina_Camiones,

        p.Prop_Stock_Camiones,
        p.Prop_Mina_Camiones,

        p.Ton_SRR AS TMS_SRR,

        t.Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR,

        t.Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR - COALESCE(p.Ton_SRR, 0) AS Apilado_Menos_SRR

    FROM tms_turno t

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_apilado_base_mina_stock_srr p
        ON p.Fecha = t.Fecha
       AND p.Turno = t.Turno
)

SELECT
    Fecha,
    Turno,

    Ton_Stock_Camiones,
    Ton_Mina_Camiones,
    Ton_Stock_Mina_Camiones,

    Prop_Stock_Camiones,
    Prop_Mina_Camiones,

    TMS_SRR,
    Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR,
    Apilado_Menos_SRR,

    Apilado_Menos_SRR * Prop_Stock_Camiones AS TMS_Stock,
    Apilado_Menos_SRR * Prop_Mina_Camiones  AS TMS_Mina,

    CASE
        WHEN Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (Apilado_Menos_SRR * Prop_Stock_Camiones)
             / NULLIF(Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR, 0)
    END AS Prop_Final_Stock,

    CASE
        WHEN Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (Apilado_Menos_SRR * Prop_Mina_Camiones)
             / NULLIF(Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR, 0)
    END AS Prop_Final_Mina,

    CASE
        WHEN Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE TMS_SRR / NULLIF(Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR, 0)
    END AS Prop_Final_SRR,

    CASE
        WHEN Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE
            (
                (Apilado_Menos_SRR * Prop_Stock_Camiones)
              + (Apilado_Menos_SRR * Prop_Mina_Camiones)
              + TMS_SRR
            ) / NULLIF(Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR, 0)
    END AS Prop_Final_Total,

    (
        COALESCE(Apilado_Menos_SRR * Prop_Stock_Camiones, 0)
      + COALESCE(Apilado_Menos_SRR * Prop_Mina_Camiones, 0)
      + COALESCE(TMS_SRR, 0)
    ) - COALESCE(Apilado_TMS_Con_SRR, 0) AS Check_Distribucion_Apilado

FROM base;

name: resumen_mina

CREATE VIEW [inventar_SpcHidr].[resumen_mina] AS 
SELECT
   mov_cam.Fecha AS Fecha,
   mov_cam.Turno AS Turno,
   mov_cam.Origen AS Origen,
   mov_cam.Fase AS Fase,
   
   -- Tonelaje
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton) AS Ton,
   
   -- Leyes Ponderadas
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.CuTG00) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS PONDCuTG00,
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.CusG01) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS PONDCusG01,
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.RS) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS PONDRS,
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.C03G02) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS PONDC03G02,
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.RecLixG03) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS PONDRecLixG03,
   
   -- Granulometría Ponderada
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.[100G07]) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS POND100G07,
   
   -- Mineralogía Ponderada
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.ClayBG10) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS PONDClayBG10,
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.CUFE) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS PONDCUFE,
   SUM(mov_cam.Ton * mov_cam.FE) / NULLIF(SUM(mov_cam.Ton),0) AS PONDFE

FROM
   mov_cam
GROUP BY
   mov_cam.Fecha,
   mov_cam.Turno,
   mov_cam.Origen,
   mov_cam.Fase;

CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_bd_ton_reportabilidad
AS

SELECT
    /* ============================================================
       Contrato histórico de BD_Ton
       Se enumeran explícitamente para no exponer las nuevas
       columnas técnicas dos veces.
       ============================================================ */
    b.id_bd_ton,
    b.Fecha,

    b.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TA,
    b.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TB,
    b.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TA,
    b.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TB,

    b.Rep_TM1_TA_Qui,
    b.Rep_TM1_TA_Fis,
    b.Rep_TM1_TB_Qui,
    b.Rep_TM1_TB_Fis,

    b.Rep_TM2_TA_Qui,
    b.Rep_TM2_TA_Fis,
    b.Rep_TM2_TB_Qui,
    b.Rep_TM2_TB_Fis,

    b.Muestra_representativa_TM1_TA,
    b.Muestra_representativa_TM1_TB,
    b.Muestra_representativa_TM2_TA,
    b.Muestra_representativa_TM2_TB,

    b.FISICO_TM1_TA,
    b.FISICO_TM1_TB,
    b.FISICO_TM2_TA,
    b.FISICO_TM2_TB,

    b.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TA,
    b.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TB,

    b.Rep_SRR_TA_Qui,
    b.Rep_SRR_TA_Fis,
    b.Rep_SRR_TB_Qui,
    b.Rep_SRR_TB_Fis,

    b.Muestra_representativa_TM3_TA,
    b.Muestra_representativa_TM3_TB,

    b.FISICO_TM3_TA,
    b.FISICO_TM3_TB,

    b.Turno_Evaluable_TA,
    b.Turno_Evaluable_TB,


    /* ============================================================
       Evaluabilidad Torre 1 / CV008

       < 01-09-2026:
           lógica histórica exacta.

       >= 01-09-2026:
           valor PI/TUM ya persistido por sp_sincronizar_bd_ton.
       ============================================================ */
    Evaluable_TM1_TA =
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-09-01'
                    THEN b.Evaluable_TM1_TA

                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                    THEN CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_A, 0) > 0
                            THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END

                WHEN b.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TA IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS tinyint
        ),

    Evaluable_TM1_TB =
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-09-01'
                    THEN b.Evaluable_TM1_TB

                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                    THEN CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_B, 0) > 0
                            THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END

                WHEN b.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TB IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS tinyint
        ),


    /* ============================================================
       Evaluabilidad Torre 2 / CV108
       ============================================================ */
    Evaluable_TM2_TA =
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-09-01'
                    THEN b.Evaluable_TM2_TA

                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                    THEN CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_A, 0) > 0
                            THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END

                WHEN b.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TA IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS tinyint
        ),

    Evaluable_TM2_TB =
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-09-01'
                    THEN b.Evaluable_TM2_TB

                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                    THEN CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_B, 0) > 0
                            THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END

                WHEN b.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TB IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS tinyint
        ),


    /* ============================================================
       Evaluabilidad Torre 3 / SRR
       SIN CAMBIOS
       ============================================================ */
    Evaluable_TM3_TA =
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                 AND b.Turno_Evaluable_TA IS NULL
                    THEN NULL

                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                 AND b.Turno_Evaluable_TA = 1
                 AND b.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TA IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                    THEN 0

                WHEN b.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TA IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS tinyint
        ),

    Evaluable_TM3_TB =
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                 AND b.Turno_Evaluable_TB IS NULL
                    THEN NULL

                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                 AND b.Turno_Evaluable_TB = 1
                 AND b.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TB IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                    THEN 0

                WHEN b.Apilado_TMH_CV01_TB IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS tinyint
        ),


    /* ============================================================
       Evaluabilidad combinada TM1 + TM2
       SIN CAMBIOS
       ============================================================ */
    Evaluable_Combinado_TA =
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                    THEN b.Turno_Evaluable_TA

                WHEN b.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TA IS NOT NULL
                  OR b.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TA IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS tinyint
        ),

    Evaluable_Combinado_TB =
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                    THEN b.Turno_Evaluable_TB

                WHEN b.Apilado_TMH_CV08_TB IS NOT NULL
                  OR b.Apilado_TMH_CV108_TB IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END
            AS tinyint
        ),


    /* ============================================================
       Trazabilidad
       ============================================================ */
    Fuente_Evaluabilidad =
        CASE
            WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-09-01'
             AND b.Evaluable_TM1_TA IS NOT NULL
             AND b.Evaluable_TM1_TB IS NOT NULL
             AND b.Evaluable_TM2_TA IS NOT NULL
             AND b.Evaluable_TM2_TB IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'OPERACIONAL_PI_TUM_POR_TORRE'

            WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-09-01'
                THEN 'SIN_CAPA_PI_TUM_T12'

            WHEN b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
                THEN 'OPERACIONAL_POR_TORRE'

            ELSE 'HISTORICO_POR_TONELAJE_TORRE'
        END

FROM inventar_SpcHidr.BD_Ton AS b

/* Sólo se necesita para metodología histórica 2026 pre-corte */
LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_datos_apilado_tmh_v2 AS a
    ON a.Fecha = b.Fecha
   AND b.Fecha >= '2026-01-01'
   AND b.Fecha <  '2026-09-01';

name: res_parcelas_apilado
