            WHEN s.campaña_anterior_pad IS NULL THEN
                s.tms_total_apilado * s.avance_porcentaje
            WHEN s.campaña_anterior_pad <> s.[campaña_id] THEN
                s.tms_total_apilado * s.avance_porcentaje
            WHEN s.modulo_anterior_pad = s.modulo_id THEN
                s.tms_total_apilado
                * CASE
                    WHEN s.avance_porcentaje - s.avance_anterior_pad < 0.0 THEN 0.0
                    ELSE s.avance_porcentaje - s.avance_anterior_pad
                  END
            ELSE
                COALESCE(s.tms_anterior_pad, 0.0)
                    * CASE
                        WHEN 1.0 - COALESCE(s.avance_anterior_pad, 1.0) < 0.0 THEN 0.0
                        ELSE 1.0 - COALESCE(s.avance_anterior_pad, 1.0)
                      END
                + s.tms_total_apilado * s.avance_porcentaje
        END AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario,
        CASE
            WHEN s.campaña_anterior_pad IS NULL
                THEN 'INICIO_SERIE'
            WHEN s.campaña_anterior_pad <> s.[campaña_id]
                THEN 'CAMBIO_CAMPANA_REVISAR'
            WHEN s.modulo_anterior_pad = s.modulo_id
                 AND s.avance_porcentaje < s.avance_anterior_pad
                THEN 'MISMO_MODULO_AVANCE_DISMINUYE_CERO'
            WHEN s.modulo_anterior_pad = s.modulo_id
                THEN 'MISMO_MODULO_INCREMENTO'
            WHEN s.modulo_numero_anterior_pad IS NOT NULL
                 AND s.modulo_numero IS NOT NULL
                 AND ABS(s.modulo_numero - s.modulo_numero_anterior_pad) > 1
                THEN 'CAMBIO_MODULO_SALTO_REVISAR'
            ELSE 'CAMBIO_MODULO_CON_REMANENTE'
        END AS metodo_calculo
    FROM Secuencia s
)
SELECT
    c.fecha AS fecha_reporte,
    c.pad_id,
    c.[campaña_id],
    c.modulo_id,
    CAST(0.0 AS float) AS volumen_diario_m3,
    c.avance_porcentaje,
    c.avance_incremental,
    CAST(c.tms_total_apilado AS float) AS tms_total_apilado,
    CAST(c.finos_totales_apilados AS float) AS finos_totales_apilados,
    CAST(c.tonelaje_reclamado_diario AS float) AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario,
    c.fecha AS fecha_operacion,

    /* Diagnóstico V4 */
    c.modulo_numero,
    c.avance_acumulado_pad,
    c.cantidad_modulos_fuente,
    CAST(c.tms_base_modulo AS float) AS tms_base_modulo,
    CAST(c.m3_totales AS float) AS m3_totales,
    CAST(c.densidad_exacta AS float) AS densidad_exacta,
    CAST(c.volumen_camiones_aprobado_m3 AS float) AS volumen_camiones_aprobado_m3,
    CAST(c.tms_camiones_aprobado AS float) AS tms_camiones_aprobado,
    c.fecha_corte_camiones,
    c.campaña_anterior_pad,
    c.modulo_anterior_pad,
    c.modulo_numero_anterior_pad,
    c.avance_anterior_pad,
    CAST(c.tms_anterior_pad AS float) AS tms_anterior_pad,
    c.metodo_calculo
FROM Calculo c;

name: v_sal_distribuida_correa_test
definition:
CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_sal_distribuida_correa_test
AS

SELECT
    s.Fecha,

    s.CV201_TA,
    s.CV201_TB,
    s.CV202_TA,
    s.CV202_TB,

    s.Sal_Pesometros_TA,
    s.Sal_Pesometros_TB,
    s.Sal_Pesometros_Dia,

    s.Sal_Topografia_Dia,

    s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida,
    s.Flag_Sal_Ajuste_Valido,

    /* =========================================================
       REGLA ESPECÍFICA PARA BALANCE DIARIO

       No exige masa positiva en ambos turnos.
       Solo necesitamos:
       - deltas basales válidos
       - topografía disponible y > 0
       - alguna señal diaria de CV201/CV202
       ========================================================= */
    CASE
        WHEN s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN s.Sal_Topografia_Dia IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN s.Sal_Topografia_Dia <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN
            s.CV201_TA
          + s.CV201_TB
          + s.CV202_TA
          + s.CV202_TB <= 0
            THEN 0
        ELSE 1
    END AS Flag_Sal_Balance_Valida,

    /* =========================================================
       PARTICIPACIÓN DIARIA CV201
       ========================================================= */
    CASE
        WHEN
            s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 1
            AND s.Sal_Topografia_Dia > 0
            AND (
                s.CV201_TA
              + s.CV201_TB
              + s.CV202_TA
              + s.CV202_TB
            ) > 0
        THEN
            (s.CV201_TA + s.CV201_TB)
            /
            NULLIF(
                s.CV201_TA
              + s.CV201_TB
              + s.CV202_TA
              + s.CV202_TB,
                0
            )
        ELSE 0
    END AS Participacion_CV201,

    /* =========================================================
       PARTICIPACIÓN DIARIA CV202
       ========================================================= */
    CASE
        WHEN
            s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 1
            AND s.Sal_Topografia_Dia > 0
            AND (
                s.CV201_TA
              + s.CV201_TB
              + s.CV202_TA
              + s.CV202_TB
            ) > 0
        THEN
            (s.CV202_TA + s.CV202_TB)
            /
            NULLIF(
                s.CV201_TA
              + s.CV201_TB
              + s.CV202_TA
              + s.CV202_TB,
                0
            )
        ELSE 0
    END AS Participacion_CV202,

    /* =========================================================
       F10 - SAL ASIGNADA A CV201
       ========================================================= */
    CASE
        WHEN
            s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 1
            AND s.Sal_Topografia_Dia > 0
            AND (
                s.CV201_TA
              + s.CV201_TB
              + s.CV202_TA
              + s.CV202_TB
            ) > 0
        THEN
            s.Sal_Topografia_Dia
            * (s.CV201_TA + s.CV201_TB)
            /
            NULLIF(
                s.CV201_TA
              + s.CV201_TB
              + s.CV202_TA
              + s.CV202_TB,
                0
            )
        ELSE 0
    END AS Sal_CV201_Dia,

    /* =========================================================
       F11 - SAL ASIGNADA A CV202
       ========================================================= */
    CASE
        WHEN
            s.Flag_Sal_Basica_Valida = 1
            AND s.Sal_Topografia_Dia > 0
            AND (
                s.CV201_TA
              + s.CV201_TB
              + s.CV202_TA
              + s.CV202_TB
            ) > 0
        THEN
            s.Sal_Topografia_Dia
            * (s.CV202_TA + s.CV202_TB)
            /
            NULLIF(
                s.CV201_TA
              + s.CV201_TB
              + s.CV202_TA
              + s.CV202_TB,
                0
            )
        ELSE 0
    END AS Sal_CV202_Dia

FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_sal_ajustada AS s;

definition:
/* ============================================================================
   RIPIOS V4.9.1 — CANDIDATA CON CONTRATO OFICIAL DE 35 COLUMNAS (PRUEBA)

   OBJETIVO
   --------
   Resolver el único bloqueo detectado en la prevalidación:

       vista oficial   = 35 columnas
       candidata V4.9 = 8 columnas

   Esta vista de prueba:
     - conserva exactamente el orden y los tipos de las 35 columnas oficiales;
     - mantiene PAD 1 desde la vista productiva vigente;
     - usa PAD 2 desde la lógica V4.9 validada;
     - no reemplaza la vista oficial;
     - no modifica el SP oficial;
     - no actualiza Datos_conciliados_of.

   NOTA DE COMPATIBILIDAD
   ----------------------
   La columna regla_corte_camiones conserva varchar(27). Por ello se publican
   códigos resumidos compatibles con el contrato actual.
============================================================================ */

CREATE   VIEW
[inventar_SpcHidr].[vista_reclamo_diario_calculado_v4_9_1_contrato_test]
AS

/* ========================================================================
   PAD 1 — CONTRATO PRODUCTIVO ACTUAL
========================================================================= */
SELECT
    p.fecha_reporte,
    p.pad_id,
    p.[campaña_id],
    p.modulo_id,
    p.volumen_diario_m3,
    p.avance_porcentaje,
    p.avance_incremental,
    p.tms_total_apilado,
    p.finos_totales_apilados,
    p.tonelaje_reclamado_diario,
    p.fecha_operacion,
    p.modulo_numero,
    p.avance_acumulado_pad,
    p.cantidad_modulos_fuente,
    p.tms_base_modulo,
    p.m3_totales,
    p.densidad_exacta,
    p.volumen_camiones_aprobado_m3,
    p.tms_camiones_aprobado,
    p.periodo_reporte,
    p.fecha_corte_camiones,
    p.estado_configuracion_corte,
    p.fuente_configuracion_corte,
    p.regla_corte_camiones,
    p.medicion_valida,
    p.motivo_medicion,
    p.fuente_control_medicion,
    p.fecha_estado_utilizado,
    p.regla_estado_topografico,
    p.campaña_anterior_pad,
    p.modulo_anterior_pad,
    p.modulo_numero_anterior_pad,
    p.avance_anterior_pad,
    p.tms_anterior_pad,
    p.metodo_calculo

FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[vista_reclamo_diario_calculado] p

WHERE p.pad_id = 1


UNION ALL


/* ========================================================================
   PAD 2 — V4.9 TOPOGRAFÍA, MAPEADA AL CONTRATO OFICIAL
========================================================================= */
SELECT
    CAST(s.fecha_reporte AS date)
        AS fecha_reporte,

    CAST(s.pad_id AS int)
        AS pad_id,

    CAST(s.[campaña_id] AS int)
        AS [campaña_id],

    CAST(s.modulo_id AS int)
        AS modulo_id,

    CAST(COALESCE(b.volumen_diario_m3, 0.0) AS float)
        AS volumen_diario_m3,

    CAST(s.avance_porcentaje AS float)
        AS avance_porcentaje,

    CAST(s.avance_incremental AS float)
        AS avance_incremental,

    CAST(s.tms_disponible_roto AS float)
        AS tms_total_apilado,

    CAST(COALESCE(b.finos_totales_apilados, 0.0) AS float)
        AS finos_totales_apilados,

    CAST(s.tonelaje_reclamado_diario AS float)
        AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario,

    CAST(s.fecha_operacion AS date)
        AS fecha_operacion,

    CAST(s.modulo_numero AS int)
        AS modulo_numero,

    CAST(b.avance_acumulado_pad AS float)
        AS avance_acumulado_pad,

    CAST(b.cantidad_modulos_fuente AS int)
        AS cantidad_modulos_fuente,

    CAST(b.tms_base_modulo AS float)
        AS tms_base_modulo,

    CAST(b.m3_totales AS float)
        AS m3_totales,

    CAST(b.densidad_exacta AS float)
        AS densidad_exacta,

    CAST(b.volumen_camiones_aprobado_m3 AS float)
        AS volumen_camiones_aprobado_m3,

    CAST(b.tms_camiones_aprobado AS float)
        AS tms_camiones_aprobado,

    CAST(b.periodo_reporte AS date)
        AS periodo_reporte,

    CAST(b.fecha_corte_camiones AS date)
        AS fecha_corte_camiones,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN b.fecha_corte_sesion IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CORTE_EXPLICITO_SP'
            WHEN b.estado_configuracion_corte = 'PERIODO_CERRADO'
                THEN 'PERIODO_CERRADO'
            ELSE 'PERIODO_ABIERTO'
        END
        AS varchar(20)
    ) AS estado_configuracion_corte,

    CAST(b.fuente_configuracion_corte AS varchar(150))
        AS fuente_configuracion_corte,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN b.fecha_corte_sesion IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CORTE_EXPLICITO_SP'
            WHEN b.estado_configuracion_corte = 'PERIODO_CERRADO'
                THEN 'CORTE_PERIODO_CERRADO'
            WHEN b.fecha_ultima_carga_periodo IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CORTE_ULTIMA_CARGA'
            WHEN b.fecha_corte_camiones IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CORTE_CONFIG_RESPALDO'
            ELSE 'SIN_CORTE_CAMIONES'
        END
        AS varchar(27)
    ) AS regla_corte_camiones,

    CAST(s.medicion_valida AS bit)
        AS medicion_valida,

    CAST(s.motivo_medicion AS varchar(250))
        AS motivo_medicion,

    CAST(b.fuente_control_medicion AS varchar(250))
        AS fuente_control_medicion,

    CAST(b.fecha_estado_utilizado AS date)
        AS fecha_estado_utilizado,

    CAST(b.regla_estado_topografico AS varchar(29))
        AS regla_estado_topografico,

    CAST(s.campaña_anterior AS int)
        AS campaña_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.modulo_id_anterior AS int)
        AS modulo_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.modulo_numero_anterior AS int)
        AS modulo_numero_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.avance_topografia_anterior AS float)
        AS avance_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.tms_disponible_anterior AS float)
        AS tms_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.metodo_calculo AS varchar(34))
        AS metodo_calculo

FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].
     [vista_reclamo_diario_calculado_v4_9_pad2_test] s

INNER JOIN [inventar_SpcHidr].
           [vista_reclamo_diario_calculado_v4_9_base_test] b
    ON  b.fecha_operacion = s.fecha_operacion
    AND b.pad_id          = s.pad_id
    AND b.[campaña_id]    = s.[campaña_id]
    AND b.modulo_id       = s.modulo_id

WHERE s.pad_id = 2;

name: sp_actualizar_campana_parcela_control
definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE inventar_SpcHidr.sp_actualizar_campana_parcela_control
    @pad_id     INT = NULL,
    @parcela_id INT = NULL,
    @campana_id INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    ;WITH camp_rango AS (
        SELECT
            c.[id_campaña]                          AS campana_id,
            pa.id_pad,
            MAX(c.[numero_campaña])                 AS numero_campana,
            MIN(CAST(c.fecha_inicio  AS DATE))      AS camp_fecha_ini,
            MAX(CAST(c.fecha_termino AS DATE))      AS camp_fecha_fin
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.[campaña] c
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.modulo  mc ON mc.id_modulo  = c.id_modulo
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.parcela pc ON pc.id_parcela = mc.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.[pad]   pa ON pa.id_pad     = pc.id_pad
        GROUP BY c.[id_campaña], pa.id_pad
    ),

    universo AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            m.campana_id    AS campaña_id,
            m.pad_id,
            m.parcela_id    AS id_parcela,
            m.modulo_id
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mapa_campana_modulo_parcela m
        WHERE (@pad_id     IS NULL OR m.pad_id     = @pad_id)
          AND (@parcela_id IS NULL OR m.parcela_id = @parcela_id)
          AND (@campana_id IS NULL OR m.campana_id = @campana_id)
    ),

    base AS (
        SELECT
            u.campaña_id,
            u.pad_id,
            u.id_parcela,
            u.modulo_id,
            p.numero                        AS num_parcela,
            mo.numero                       AS num_modulo,
            pa.nombre                       AS nombre_pad,
            CAST(p.numero  AS VARCHAR(10))  AS nombre_parcela,
            CAST(mo.numero AS VARCHAR(10))  AS nombre_modulo,
            apc.col_numero,
            UPPER(pa.nombre)                AS tipo_pad,
            cr.numero_campana,
            cr.camp_fecha_ini,
            cr.camp_fecha_fin
        FROM universo u
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.modulo  mo ON mo.id_modulo  = u.modulo_id
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.parcela p  ON p.id_parcela  = u.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.[pad]   pa ON pa.id_pad     = u.pad_id
        LEFT  JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.aux_parcela_columna apc
            ON apc.parcela_id = u.id_parcela
        LEFT  JOIN camp_rango cr
            ON cr.campana_id = u.campaña_id
           AND cr.id_pad     = u.pad_id
    ),

    carguio AS (
        SELECT
            m.campana_id                            AS campaña_id,
            m.modulo_id,
            m.parcela_id                            AS id_parcela,
            m.pad_id,
            CAST(m.fecha_ini_carguio AS DATE)       AS fecha_ini_carguio,
            CAST(m.fecha_fin_carguio AS DATE)       AS fecha_fin_carguio,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY m.campana_id, m.parcela_id
                ORDER BY m.fecha_ini_carguio, m.modulo_id
            )                                       AS secuencia_carguio
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mapa_campana_modulo_parcela m
        WHERE m.fecha_ini_carguio IS NOT NULL
          AND (@pad_id     IS NULL OR m.pad_id     = @pad_id)
          AND (@parcela_id IS NULL OR m.parcela_id = @parcela_id)
          AND (@campana_id IS NULL OR m.campana_id = @campana_id)
    ),

    reclamo AS (
        SELECT
            m.campana_id                            AS campaña_id,
            m.modulo_id,
            m.parcela_id                            AS id_parcela,
            m.pad_id,
            CAST(m.fecha_ini_reclamo AS DATE)       AS fecha_ini_retiro,
            CAST(m.fecha_fin_reclamo AS DATE)       AS fecha_fin_retiro,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY m.campana_id, m.parcela_id
                ORDER BY m.fecha_ini_reclamo, m.modulo_id
            )                                       AS secuencia_retiro
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mapa_campana_modulo_parcela m
        WHERE m.fecha_ini_reclamo IS NOT NULL
          AND (@pad_id     IS NULL OR m.pad_id     = @pad_id)
          AND (@parcela_id IS NULL OR m.parcela_id = @parcela_id)
          AND (@campana_id IS NULL OR m.campana_id = @campana_id)
    ),

    riego_oxido AS (
        SELECT
            b.campaña_id,
            b.modulo_id,
            b.id_parcela,
            MIN(CAST(f.fecha_registro AS DATE)) AS fecha_primer_riego,
            MAX(CAST(f.fecha_registro AS DATE)) AS fecha_ultimo_riego
        FROM base b
        INNER JOIN carguio ca
            ON  ca.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND ca.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND ca.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_flujos_oxido_unpivot f
            ON  f.parcela_numero = b.col_numero
            AND f.caudal > 1
            AND CAST(f.fecha_registro AS DATE) >= ca.fecha_ini_carguio
            AND CAST(f.fecha_registro AS DATE) <= ISNULL(b.camp_fecha_fin, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
        WHERE b.tipo_pad LIKE '%OXIDO%'
          AND b.col_numero IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY b.campaña_id, b.modulo_id, b.id_parcela
    ),

    riego_sulfuro AS (
        SELECT
            b.campaña_id,
            b.modulo_id,
            b.id_parcela,
            MIN(CAST(f.fecha_registro AS DATE)) AS fecha_primer_riego,
            MAX(CAST(f.fecha_registro AS DATE)) AS fecha_ultimo_riego
        FROM base b
        INNER JOIN carguio ca
            ON  ca.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND ca.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND ca.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_flujos_sulfuro_unpivot f
            ON  f.parcela_numero = b.col_numero
            AND f.caudal > 1
            AND CAST(f.fecha_registro AS DATE) >= ca.fecha_ini_carguio
            AND CAST(f.fecha_registro AS DATE) <= ISNULL(b.camp_fecha_fin, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
        WHERE b.tipo_pad LIKE '%SULFURO%'
          AND b.col_numero IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY b.campaña_id, b.modulo_id, b.id_parcela
    ),

    drenaje_oxido AS (
        SELECT
            b.campaña_id,
            b.modulo_id,
            b.id_parcela,
            MIN(CAST(d.fecha_registro AS DATE)) AS fecha_ini_drenaje,
            MAX(CAST(d.fecha_registro AS DATE)) AS fecha_fin_drenaje
        FROM base b
        INNER JOIN carguio ca
            ON  ca.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND ca.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND ca.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_drena_oxido_unpivot d
            ON  d.parcela_numero = b.col_numero
            AND d.cu_pp > 0
            AND CAST(d.fecha_registro AS DATE) >= ca.fecha_ini_carguio
            AND CAST(d.fecha_registro AS DATE) <= ISNULL(b.camp_fecha_fin, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
        WHERE b.tipo_pad LIKE '%OXIDO%'
          AND b.col_numero IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY b.campaña_id, b.modulo_id, b.id_parcela
    ),

    drenaje_sulfuro AS (
        SELECT
            b.campaña_id,
            b.modulo_id,
            b.id_parcela,
            MIN(CAST(d.fecha_registro AS DATE)) AS fecha_ini_drenaje,
            MAX(CAST(d.fecha_registro AS DATE)) AS fecha_fin_drenaje
        FROM base b
        INNER JOIN carguio ca
            ON  ca.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND ca.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND ca.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_drena_sulfuro_unpivot d
            ON  d.parcela_numero = b.col_numero
            AND d.cu_pp > 0
            AND CAST(d.fecha_registro AS DATE) >= ca.fecha_ini_carguio
            AND CAST(d.fecha_registro AS DATE) <= ISNULL(b.camp_fecha_fin, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
        WHERE b.tipo_pad LIKE '%SULFURO%'
          AND b.col_numero IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY b.campaña_id, b.modulo_id, b.id_parcela
    ),

    tonelajes AS (
        SELECT
            mt.[campaña_id],
            mt.modulo_id,
            SUM(mt.TMH)                                                         AS tmh_cargado,
            SUM(mt.TMS)                                                         AS tms_cargado,
            CASE WHEN SUM(mt.TMH) > 0
                 THEN SUM(mt.Humedad    * mt.TMH) / SUM(mt.TMH) END            AS humedad_promedio,
            CASE WHEN SUM(mt.TMS) > 0
                 THEN SUM(mt.Sal        * mt.TMS) / SUM(mt.TMS) END            AS sal_promedio,
            CASE WHEN SUM(mt.TMS) > 0
                 THEN SUM(mt.[CuT_TM]  * mt.TMS) / SUM(mt.TMS) END            AS cut_tm_total,
            CASE WHEN SUM(mt.TMS) > 0
                 THEN SUM(mt.[CuS_TM]  * mt.TMS) / SUM(mt.TMS) END            AS cus_tm_total,
            CASE WHEN SUM(mt.TMS) > 0
                 THEN SUM(mt.[Cu_Insoluble] * mt.TMS) / SUM(mt.TMS) END        AS cu_insoluble_total,
            MAX(mt.[Altura Módulo])                                             AS altura_modulo_max
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.modulos_turnos mt
        WHERE mt.[campaña_id] IS NOT NULL
          AND mt.modulo_id    IS NOT NULL
          AND (@pad_id     IS NULL OR mt.pad_id     = @pad_id)
          AND (@campana_id IS NULL OR mt.[campaña_id] = @campana_id)
        GROUP BY mt.[campaña_id], mt.modulo_id
    ),

    resultado AS (
        SELECT
            b.campaña_id,
            b.modulo_id,
            b.id_parcela,
            b.pad_id,
            b.numero_campana,
            b.nombre_pad,
            b.nombre_parcela,
            b.nombre_modulo,

            ca.secuencia_carguio,
            rc.secuencia_retiro,

            ca.fecha_ini_carguio,
            ca.fecha_fin_carguio,

            ca.fecha_fin_carguio AS fecha_ini_reposo,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                THEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego)
            END AS fecha_fin_reposo,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                THEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego)
            END AS fecha_ini_operacion,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                 AND COALESCE(do2.fecha_fin_drenaje, ds.fecha_fin_drenaje)
                     >= COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego)
                THEN COALESCE(do2.fecha_fin_drenaje, ds.fecha_fin_drenaje)
            END AS fecha_fin_operacion,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                 AND COALESCE(do2.fecha_ini_drenaje, ds.fecha_ini_drenaje)
                     >= COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego)
                THEN COALESCE(do2.fecha_ini_drenaje, ds.fecha_ini_drenaje)
            END AS fecha_ini_drenaje,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                 AND COALESCE(do2.fecha_ini_drenaje, ds.fecha_ini_drenaje)
                     >= COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego)
                THEN COALESCE(do2.fecha_fin_drenaje, ds.fecha_fin_drenaje)
            END AS fecha_fin_drenaje,

            rc.fecha_ini_retiro,
            rc.fecha_fin_retiro,

            t.tmh_cargado,
            t.tms_cargado,
            t.humedad_promedio,
            t.sal_promedio,
            t.cut_tm_total,
            t.cus_tm_total,
            t.cu_insoluble_total,
            t.altura_modulo_max,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                THEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego)
            END AS fecha_primer_riego,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                THEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_ultimo_riego, rs.fecha_ultimo_riego)
            END AS fecha_ultimo_riego,

            DATEDIFF(DAY, ca.fecha_ini_carguio, ca.fecha_fin_carguio) AS dias_carguio,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, ca.fecha_fin_carguio,
                                   COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego))
            END AS dias_reposo,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) >= ca.fecha_fin_carguio
                 AND COALESCE(do2.fecha_fin_drenaje, ds.fecha_fin_drenaje)
                     >= COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego)
                THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego),
                                   COALESCE(do2.fecha_fin_drenaje, ds.fecha_fin_drenaje))
            END AS dias_operacion,

            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(do2.fecha_ini_drenaje, ds.fecha_ini_drenaje) IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE(do2.fecha_fin_drenaje, ds.fecha_fin_drenaje) IS NOT NULL
                THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, COALESCE(do2.fecha_ini_drenaje, ds.fecha_ini_drenaje),
                                   COALESCE(do2.fecha_fin_drenaje, ds.fecha_fin_drenaje))
            END AS dias_drenaje,

            DATEDIFF(DAY, rc.fecha_ini_retiro, rc.fecha_fin_retiro) AS dias_retiro,

            CASE
                WHEN rc.fecha_ini_retiro IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'reclamo'
                WHEN COALESCE(do2.fecha_ini_drenaje, ds.fecha_ini_drenaje) IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'drenaje'
                WHEN COALESCE(ro.fecha_primer_riego, rs.fecha_primer_riego) IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'operacion'
                WHEN ca.fecha_fin_carguio IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'reposo'
                WHEN ca.fecha_ini_carguio IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'carguio'
                ELSE 'sin_dato'
            END AS estado_ciclo

        FROM base b
        LEFT JOIN carguio ca
            ON  ca.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND ca.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND ca.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        LEFT JOIN reclamo rc
            ON  rc.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND rc.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND rc.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        LEFT JOIN riego_oxido ro
            ON  ro.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND ro.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND ro.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        LEFT JOIN riego_sulfuro rs
            ON  rs.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND rs.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND rs.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        LEFT JOIN drenaje_oxido do2
            ON  do2.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND do2.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND do2.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        LEFT JOIN drenaje_sulfuro ds
            ON  ds.campaña_id = b.campaña_id
            AND ds.modulo_id  = b.modulo_id
            AND ds.id_parcela = b.id_parcela
        LEFT JOIN tonelajes t
            ON  t.[campaña_id] = b.campaña_id
            AND t.modulo_id    = b.modulo_id
    )

    MERGE inventar_SpcHidr.campana_parcela_control AS tgt
    USING resultado AS src
        ON  tgt.campana_id  = src.campaña_id
        AND tgt.pad_id      = src.pad_id
        AND tgt.parcela_id  = src.id_parcela
        AND tgt.modulo_id   = src.modulo_id

    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
        tgt.numero_campana      = src.numero_campana,
        tgt.nombre_pad          = src.nombre_pad,
        tgt.nombre_parcela      = src.nombre_parcela,
        tgt.nombre_modulo       = src.nombre_modulo,
        tgt.secuencia_carguio   = src.secuencia_carguio,
        tgt.secuencia_retiro    = src.secuencia_retiro,
        tgt.fecha_ini_carguio   = src.fecha_ini_carguio,
        tgt.fecha_fin_carguio   = src.fecha_fin_carguio,
        tgt.fecha_ini_reposo    = src.fecha_ini_reposo,
        tgt.fecha_fin_reposo    = src.fecha_fin_reposo,
        tgt.fecha_ini_operacion = src.fecha_ini_operacion,
        tgt.fecha_fin_operacion = src.fecha_fin_operacion,
        tgt.fecha_ini_drenaje   = src.fecha_ini_drenaje,
        tgt.fecha_fin_drenaje   = src.fecha_fin_drenaje,
        tgt.fecha_ini_retiro    = src.fecha_ini_retiro,
        tgt.fecha_fin_retiro    = src.fecha_fin_retiro,
        tgt.tmh_cargado         = src.tmh_cargado,
        tgt.tms_cargado         = src.tms_cargado,
        tgt.humedad_promedio    = src.humedad_promedio,
        tgt.sal_promedio        = src.sal_promedio,
        tgt.cut_tm_total        = src.cut_tm_total,
        tgt.cus_tm_total        = src.cus_tm_total,
        tgt.cu_insoluble_total  = src.cu_insoluble_total,
        tgt.altura_modulo_max   = src.altura_modulo_max,
        tgt.fecha_primer_riego  = src.fecha_primer_riego,
        tgt.fecha_ultimo_riego  = src.fecha_ultimo_riego,
        tgt.dias_carguio        = src.dias_carguio,
        tgt.dias_reposo         = src.dias_reposo,
        tgt.dias_operacion      = src.dias_operacion,
        tgt.dias_drenaje        = src.dias_drenaje,
        tgt.dias_retiro         = src.dias_retiro,
        tgt.estado_ciclo        = src.estado_ciclo,
        tgt.fecha_actualizacion = GETDATE()

    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (
        campana_id, pad_id, parcela_id, modulo_id,
        numero_campana, nombre_pad, nombre_parcela, nombre_modulo,
        secuencia_carguio, secuencia_retiro,
        fecha_ini_carguio, fecha_fin_carguio,
        fecha_ini_reposo, fecha_fin_reposo,
        fecha_ini_operacion, fecha_fin_operacion,
        fecha_ini_drenaje, fecha_fin_drenaje,
        fecha_ini_retiro, fecha_fin_retiro,
        tmh_cargado, tms_cargado,
        humedad_promedio, sal_promedio,
        cut_tm_total, cus_tm_total, cu_insoluble_total,
        altura_modulo_max,
        fecha_primer_riego, fecha_ultimo_riego,
        dias_carguio, dias_reposo, dias_operacion, dias_drenaje, dias_retiro,
        estado_ciclo, fecha_creacion, fecha_actualizacion
    ) VALUES (
        src.campaña_id, src.pad_id, src.id_parcela, src.modulo_id,
        src.numero_campana, src.nombre_pad, src.nombre_parcela, src.nombre_modulo,
        src.secuencia_carguio, src.secuencia_retiro,
        src.fecha_ini_carguio, src.fecha_fin_carguio,
        src.fecha_ini_reposo, src.fecha_fin_reposo,
        src.fecha_ini_operacion, src.fecha_fin_operacion,
        src.fecha_ini_drenaje, src.fecha_fin_drenaje,
        src.fecha_ini_retiro, src.fecha_fin_retiro,
        src.tmh_cargado, src.tms_cargado,
        src.humedad_promedio, src.sal_promedio,
        src.cut_tm_total, src.cus_tm_total, src.cu_insoluble_total,
        src.altura_modulo_max,
        src.fecha_primer_riego, src.fecha_ultimo_riego,
        src.dias_carguio, src.dias_reposo, src.dias_operacion, src.dias_drenaje, src.dias_retiro,
        src.estado_ciclo, GETDATE(), GETDATE()
    );

    SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS filas_afectadas, GETDATE() AS ejecutado_en;
END;

CREATE VIEW [inventar_SpcHidr].[vista_resumen_datos_filtrados] AS WITH grp AS (
	SELECT
		df.fecha_turno,
		MIN(df.cv006_tot) AS min_cv006_tot,
		MAX(df.cv006_tot) AS max_cv006_tot,
		MIN(df.cv201_tot) / 1000.0 AS min_cv201_tot,
		MAX(df.cv201_tot) / 1000.0 AS max_cv201_tot,
		MIN(df.cv202_tot) / 1000.0 AS min_cv202_tot,
		MAX(df.cv202_tot) / 1000.0 AS max_cv202_tot,
		MIN(df.cv008_tot) AS min_cv008_tot,
		MAX(df.cv008_tot) AS max_cv008_tot,
		MIN(df.cv108_tot) AS min_cv108_tot,
		MAX(df.cv108_tot) AS max_cv108_tot,
		MIN(df.cv003_tot) AS min_cv003_tot,
		MAX(df.cv003_tot) AS max_cv003_tot,
		MIN(df.cv002_tot) AS min_cv002_tot,
		MAX(df.cv002_tot) AS max_cv002_tot,
		MIN(df.cv001_tot) AS min_cv001_tot,
		MAX(df.cv001_tot) AS max_cv001_tot,
		MIN(df.cv025tot) AS min_cv025tot,
		MAX(df.cv025tot) AS max_cv025tot,
		MIN(df.cv025_tot) AS min_cv025_tot,
		MAX(df.cv025_tot) AS max_cv025_tot,
		MIN(df.nivel_silo_a) AS min_niv_silo_a,
		MAX(df.nivel_silo_a) AS max_niv_silo_a,
		MIN(df.nivel_silo_b) AS min_niv_silo_b,
		MAX(df.nivel_silo_b) AS max_niv_silo_b,
		MIN(df.nivel_harnero_a) AS min_niv_har_a,
		MAX(df.nivel_harnero_a) AS max_niv_har_a,
		MIN(df.nivel_harnero_b) AS min_niv_har_b,
		MAX(df.nivel_harnero_b) AS max_niv_har_b,
		MIN(df.nivel_harnero_c) AS min_niv_har_c,
		MAX(df.nivel_harnero_c) AS max_niv_har_c,
		MIN(df.nivel_harnero_d) AS min_niv_har_d,
		MAX(df.nivel_harnero_d) AS max_niv_har_d,
		MIN(df.nivel_harnero_e) AS min_niv_har_e,
		MAX(df.nivel_harnero_e) AS max_niv_har_e,
		MIN(df.nivel_chancado_a) AS min_niv_cha_a,
		MAX(df.nivel_chancado_a) AS max_niv_cha_a,
		MIN(df.nivel_chancado_b) AS min_niv_cha_b,
		MAX(df.nivel_chancado_b) AS max_niv_cha_b,
		MIN(df.nivel_chancado_c) AS min_niv_cha_c,
		MAX(df.nivel_chancado_c) AS max_niv_cha_c,
		MIN(df.nivel_chancado_d) AS min_niv_cha_d,
		MAX(df.nivel_chancado_d) AS max_niv_cha_d,
		MIN(df.nivel_chancado_e) AS min_niv_cha_e,
		MAX(df.nivel_chancado_e) AS max_niv_cha_e,
		SUM(CASE WHEN df.RC002CORR IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rc_002,
		SUM(CASE WHEN df.RC001CORR IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rc_001
	FROM
		inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados AS df
	GROUP BY
		df.fecha_turno
),
grp_with_next AS (
	SELECT
		g.*,
		LEAD (g.min_cv006_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv006_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv201_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv201_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv202_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv202_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv008_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv008_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv108_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv108_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv003_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv003_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv002_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv002_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv001_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv001_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv025tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv025tot,
		LEAD (g.min_cv025_tot) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_cv025_tot,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_silo_a) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_silo_a,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_silo_b) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_silo_b,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_har_a) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_har_a,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_har_b) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_har_b,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_har_c) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_har_c,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_har_d) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_har_d,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_har_e) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_har_e,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_cha_a) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_cha_a,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_cha_b) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_cha_b,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_cha_c) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_cha_c,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_cha_d) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_cha_d,
		LEAD (g.min_niv_cha_e) OVER (ORDER BY g.fecha_turno) AS next_min_niv_cha_e
	FROM
		grp AS g
) SELECT
	gwn.fecha_turno,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_cv006_tot - gwn.min_cv006_tot, gwn.max_cv006_tot - gwn.min_cv006_tot) AS cv006_tot,
	CASE
		WHEN gwn.max_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot < 0 THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv201_tot IS NULL
			AND gwn.max_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 10000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv201_tot IS NULL THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot < 0
			AND gwn.max_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 10000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot < 0 THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 10000 THEN
			gwn.next_min_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot
		WHEN gwn.max_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 10000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv201_tot - gwn.min_cv201_tot
		ELSE
			0
	END AS cv201_tot,
	CASE
		WHEN gwn.max_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot < 0 THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv202_tot IS NULL
			AND gwn.max_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 10000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv202_tot IS NULL THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot < 0
			AND gwn.max_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 10000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot < 0 THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 10000 THEN
			gwn.next_min_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot
		WHEN gwn.max_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 10000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv202_tot - gwn.min_cv202_tot
		ELSE
			0
	END AS cv202_tot,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_cv008_tot - gwn.min_cv008_tot, gwn.max_cv008_tot - gwn.min_cv008_tot) AS cv008_tot,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_cv108_tot - gwn.min_cv108_tot, gwn.max_cv108_tot - gwn.min_cv108_tot) AS cv108_tot,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_cv003_tot - gwn.min_cv003_tot, gwn.max_cv003_tot - gwn.min_cv003_tot) AS cv003_tot,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_cv002_tot - gwn.min_cv002_tot, gwn.max_cv002_tot - gwn.min_cv002_tot) AS cv002_tot,
	CASE
		WHEN COALESCE(gwn.next_min_cv001_tot - gwn.min_cv001_tot, gwn.max_cv001_tot - gwn.min_cv001_tot) > 100000 THEN
			0
		ELSE
			COALESCE(gwn.next_min_cv001_tot - gwn.min_cv001_tot, gwn.max_cv001_tot - gwn.min_cv001_tot)
	END AS cv001_tot,
	gwn.rc_002,
	gwn.rc_001,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_cv025tot - gwn.min_cv025tot, gwn.max_cv025tot - gwn.min_cv025tot) AS cv025tot,
	CASE
		WHEN gwn.max_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot < 0 THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv025_tot IS NULL
			AND gwn.max_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 100000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv025_tot IS NULL THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot < 0
			AND gwn.max_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 100000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot < 0 THEN
			0
		WHEN gwn.next_min_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 100000 THEN
			gwn.next_min_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot
		WHEN gwn.max_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot BETWEEN 0
			AND 100000 THEN
			gwn.max_cv025_tot - gwn.min_cv025_tot
		ELSE
			0
	END AS cv025_tot,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_silo_a - gwn.min_niv_silo_a, gwn.max_niv_silo_a - gwn.min_niv_silo_a) AS niv_silo_a,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_silo_b - gwn.min_niv_silo_b, gwn.max_niv_silo_b - gwn.min_niv_silo_b) AS niv_silo_b,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_har_a - gwn.min_niv_har_a, gwn.max_niv_har_a - gwn.min_niv_har_a) AS niv_har_a,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_har_b - gwn.min_niv_har_b, gwn.max_niv_har_b - gwn.min_niv_har_b) AS niv_har_b,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_har_c - gwn.min_niv_har_c, gwn.max_niv_har_c - gwn.min_niv_har_c) AS niv_har_c,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_har_d - gwn.min_niv_har_d, gwn.max_niv_har_d - gwn.min_niv_har_d) AS niv_har_d,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_har_e - gwn.min_niv_har_e, gwn.max_niv_har_e - gwn.min_niv_har_e) AS niv_har_e,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_cha_a - gwn.min_niv_cha_a, gwn.max_niv_cha_a - gwn.min_niv_cha_a) AS niv_cha_a,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_cha_b - gwn.min_niv_cha_b, gwn.max_niv_cha_b - gwn.min_niv_cha_b) AS niv_cha_b,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_cha_c - gwn.min_niv_cha_c, gwn.max_niv_cha_c - gwn.min_niv_cha_c) AS niv_cha_c,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_cha_d - gwn.min_niv_cha_d, gwn.max_niv_cha_d - gwn.min_niv_cha_d) AS niv_cha_d,
	COALESCE(gwn.next_min_niv_cha_e - gwn.min_niv_cha_e, gwn.max_niv_cha_e - gwn.min_niv_cha_e) AS niv_cha_e
FROM
	grp_with_next AS gwn;

name: sp_upgraddiagrams

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams
	AS
	BEGIN
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagrams') IS NOT NULL
			return 0;
	
		CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagrams
		(
			name sysname NOT NULL,
			principal_id int NOT NULL,	-- we may change it to varbinary(85)
			diagram_id int PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY,
			version int,
	
			definition varbinary(max)
			CONSTRAINT UK_principal_name UNIQUE
			(
				principal_id,
				name
			)
		);


		/* Add this if we need to have some form of extended properties for diagrams */
		/*
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagram_properties') IS NULL
		BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagram_properties
			(
				diagram_id int,
				name sysname,
				value varbinary(max) NOT NULL
			)
		END
		*/

		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.dtproperties') IS NOT NULL
		begin
			insert into dbo.sysdiagrams
			(
				[name],
				[principal_id],
				[version],
				[definition]
			)
			select	 
				convert(sysname, dgnm.[uvalue]),
				DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(N'dbo'),			-- will change to the sid of sa
				0,							-- zero for old format, dgdef.[version],
				dgdef.[lvalue]
			from dbo.[dtproperties] dgnm
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dggd on dggd.[property] = 'DtgSchemaGUID' and dggd.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]	
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dgdef on dgdef.[property] = 'DtgSchemaDATA' and dgdef.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]
				
			where dgnm.[property] = 'DtgSchemaNAME' and dggd.[uvalue] like N'_EA3E6268-D998-11CE-9454-00AA00A3F36E_' 
			return 2;
		end
		return 1;
	END

name: sp_rep_prod_sync_schema
definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE inventar_SpcHidr.sp_rep_prod_sync_schema
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @schema SYSNAME = 'inventar_SpcHidr';
    DECLARE @src_table SYSNAME = 'Datos_conciliados_of';
    DECLARE @tgt1 SYSNAME = 'rep_prod_ajustado';
    DECLARE @tgt2 SYSNAME = 'rep_prod_ajustado_stg';

    DECLARE @missing TABLE
    (
        target_table SYSNAME,
        column_name SYSNAME,
        data_type SYSNAME,
        char_len INT NULL,
        num_prec INT NULL,
        num_scale INT NULL,
        dt_prec INT NULL
    );

    -- missing para rep_prod_ajustado
    INSERT INTO @missing (target_table, column_name, data_type, char_len, num_prec, num_scale, dt_prec)
    SELECT
        @tgt1,
        s.COLUMN_NAME,
        s.DATA_TYPE,
        s.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
        s.NUMERIC_PRECISION,
        s.NUMERIC_SCALE,
        s.DATETIME_PRECISION
    FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS s
    LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS t
        ON  t.TABLE_SCHEMA = s.TABLE_SCHEMA
        AND t.TABLE_NAME   = @tgt1
        AND t.COLUMN_NAME  = s.COLUMN_NAME
    WHERE s.TABLE_SCHEMA = @schema
      AND s.TABLE_NAME   = @src_table
      AND t.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL;

    -- missing para rep_prod_ajustado_stg
    INSERT INTO @missing (target_table, column_name, data_type, char_len, num_prec, num_scale, dt_prec)
    SELECT
        @tgt2,
        s.COLUMN_NAME,
        s.DATA_TYPE,
        s.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
        s.NUMERIC_PRECISION,
        s.NUMERIC_SCALE,
        s.DATETIME_PRECISION
    FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS s
    LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS t
        ON  t.TABLE_SCHEMA = s.TABLE_SCHEMA
        AND t.TABLE_NAME   = @tgt2
        AND t.COLUMN_NAME  = s.COLUMN_NAME
    WHERE s.TABLE_SCHEMA = @schema
      AND s.TABLE_NAME   = @src_table
      AND t.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL;

    DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';

    SELECT @sql = @sql +
        N'ALTER TABLE ' + QUOTENAME(@schema) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(m.target_table) +
        N' ADD ' + QUOTENAME(m.column_name) + N' ' +
        CASE
            WHEN m.data_type IN ('varchar','nvarchar','char','nchar') THEN
                m.data_type + N'(' + CASE WHEN m.char_len = -1 THEN N'MAX' ELSE CAST(m.char_len AS NVARCHAR(20)) END + N')'
            WHEN m.data_type IN ('decimal','numeric') THEN
                m.data_type + N'(' + CAST(m.num_prec AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N',' + CAST(m.num_scale AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N')'
            WHEN m.data_type = 'datetime2' THEN
                m.data_type + N'(' + CAST(COALESCE(m.dt_prec, 7) AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N')'
            ELSE
                m.data_type
        END
        + N' NULL;'
        + CHAR(10)
    FROM @missing m;

    IF LEN(@sql) > 0
    BEGIN
        EXEC sp_executesql @sql;
    END
END

CREATE VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_bd_ton_oficial
AS

WITH ton_t12 AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,

        NULLIF(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Torre = 'T1' AND Turno = 'A'
                        THEN Ton_Real
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS [Apilado TMH CV-08 TA],

        NULLIF(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Torre = 'T1' AND Turno = 'B'
                        THEN Ton_Real
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS [Apilado TMH CV-08 TB],

        NULLIF(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Torre = 'T2' AND Turno = 'A'
                        THEN Ton_Real
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS [Apilado TMH CV-108 TA],

        NULLIF(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Torre = 'T2' AND Turno = 'B'
                        THEN Ton_Real
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS [Apilado TMH CV-108 TB]

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_diario_emulado_excel

    WHERE Torre IN ('T1', 'T2')

    GROUP BY
        Fecha
),

ton_srr AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,

        NULLIF(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Torre = 'SRR' AND Turno = 'A'
                        THEN Ton_Real
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS [Apilado TMH CV-01 TA],

        NULLIF(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Torre = 'SRR' AND Turno = 'B'
                        THEN Ton_Real
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS [Apilado TMH CV-01 TB]

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_diario_emulado_excel

    WHERE Torre = 'SRR'

    GROUP BY
        Fecha
)

SELECT
    t.Fecha,

    /* =========================================================
       Tonelajes Torres 1 y 2
       ========================================================= */

    t.[Apilado TMH CV-08 TA],
    t.[Apilado TMH CV-08 TB],
    t.[Apilado TMH CV-108 TA],
    t.[Apilado TMH CV-108 TB],

    /* =========================================================
       Representatividad Torres 1 y 2
       Se mantiene la lógica histórica sin cambios.
       ========================================================= */

    COALESCE(r.TM1_TurnoA_Quimico, 0)
        AS [Rep. TM1 TA Qui.],

    COALESCE(r.TM1_TurnoA_Fisico, 0)
        AS [Rep. TM1 TA Fis.],

    COALESCE(r.TM1_TurnoB_Quimico, 0)
        AS [Rep. TM1 TB Qui.],

    COALESCE(r.TM1_TurnoB_Fisico, 0)
        AS [Rep. TM1 TB Fis.],

    COALESCE(r.TM2_TurnoA_Quimico, 0)
        AS [Rep. TM2 TA Qui.],

    COALESCE(r.TM2_TurnoA_Fisico, 0)
        AS [Rep. TM2 TA Fis.],

    COALESCE(r.TM2_TurnoB_Quimico, 0)
        AS [Rep. TM2 TB Qui.],

    COALESCE(r.TM2_TurnoB_Fisico, 0)
        AS [Rep. TM2 TB Fis.],

    /* =========================================================
       Flags químicos Torres 1 y 2
       ========================================================= */

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.TM1_TurnoA_Quimico, 0) >= 0.75
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS [Muestra representativa TM1 TA],

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.TM1_TurnoB_Quimico, 0) >= 0.75
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS [Muestra representativa TM1 TB],

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.TM2_TurnoA_Quimico, 0) >= 0.75
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS [Muestra representativa TM2 TA],

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.TM2_TurnoB_Quimico, 0) >= 0.75
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS [Muestra representativa TM2 TB],

    /* =========================================================
       Flags físicos Torres 1 y 2
       ========================================================= */

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.TM1_TurnoA_Fisico, 0) >= 0.75
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS [FISICO TM1 TA],

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.TM1_TurnoB_Fisico, 0) >= 0.75
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS [FISICO TM1 TB],

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.TM2_TurnoA_Fisico, 0) >= 0.75
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS [FISICO TM2 TA],

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.TM2_TurnoB_Fisico, 0) >= 0.75
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS [FISICO TM2 TB],

    /* =========================================================
       Torre 3 / SRR
       ========================================================= */

    s.[Apilado TMH CV-01 TA],
    s.[Apilado TMH CV-01 TB],

    r.SRR_TurnoA_Quimico
        AS [Rep. SRR TA Qui.],

    r.SRR_TurnoA_Fisico
        AS [Rep. SRR TA Fis.],

    r.SRR_TurnoB_Quimico
        AS [Rep. SRR TB Qui.],

    r.SRR_TurnoB_Fisico
        AS [Rep. SRR TB Fis.],

    /* =========================================================
       Flags químicos SRR

       NULL = turno no evaluable o sin flujo SRR.
       0    = evaluable, pero no representativo.
       1    = representatividad >= 0,75.
       ========================================================= */

    CASE
        WHEN r.SRR_TurnoA_Quimico IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN r.SRR_TurnoA_Quimico >= 0.75
            THEN 1

        ELSE 0
    END AS [Muestra representativa TM3 TA],

    CASE
        WHEN r.SRR_TurnoB_Quimico IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN r.SRR_TurnoB_Quimico >= 0.75
            THEN 1

        ELSE 0
    END AS [Muestra representativa TM3 TB],

    /* =========================================================
       Flags físicos SRR
       ========================================================= */

    CASE
        WHEN r.SRR_TurnoA_Fisico IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN r.SRR_TurnoA_Fisico >= 0.75
            THEN 1

        ELSE 0
    END AS [FISICO TM3 TA],

    CASE
        WHEN r.SRR_TurnoB_Fisico IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN r.SRR_TurnoB_Fisico >= 0.75
            THEN 1

        ELSE 0
    END AS [FISICO TM3 TB]

FROM ton_t12 AS t

LEFT JOIN ton_srr AS s
    ON s.Fecha = t.Fecha

LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.representatividad_torres_resultado AS r
    ON r.Dia = t.Fecha;

CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_representatividad_diaria_calculada
AS

WITH representatividad_t12 AS
(
    SELECT
        r.Fecha AS Dia,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN r.Torre = 'T1'
                 AND r.Turno = 'A'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Quimico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM1_TurnoA_Quimico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN r.Torre = 'T1'
                 AND r.Turno = 'A'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Fisico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM1_TurnoA_Fisico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN r.Torre = 'T1'
                 AND r.Turno = 'B'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Quimico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM1_TurnoB_Quimico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN r.Torre = 'T1'
                 AND r.Turno = 'B'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Fisico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM1_TurnoB_Fisico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN r.Torre = 'T2'
                 AND r.Turno = 'A'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Quimico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM2_TurnoA_Quimico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN r.Torre = 'T2'
                 AND r.Turno = 'A'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Fisico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM2_TurnoA_Fisico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN r.Torre = 'T2'
                 AND r.Turno = 'B'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Quimico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM2_TurnoB_Quimico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN r.Torre = 'T2'
                 AND r.Turno = 'B'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Fisico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM2_TurnoB_Fisico

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_diario_emulado_excel AS r

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_peso_real_torre_turno_excel AS pr
        ON pr.Torre = r.Torre
       AND pr.Fecha = r.Fecha
       AND pr.Turno = r.Turno

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_peso_teorico_turno_torre_representatividad_resuelto AS pt
        ON pt.Torre = r.Torre
       AND pt.Fecha = r.Fecha
       AND pt.Turno = r.Turno

    WHERE r.Torre IN ('T1','T2')

    GROUP BY
        r.Fecha
),

representatividad_srr AS
(
    /* SRR se mantiene íntegramente con metodología vigente */
    SELECT
        Fecha AS Dia,

        CAST(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno = 'A'
                        THEN Representatividad_Quimica
                END
            ) AS float
        ) AS SRR_TurnoA_Quimico,

        CAST(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno = 'A'
                        THEN Representatividad_Fisica
                END
            ) AS float
        ) AS SRR_TurnoA_Fisico,

        CAST(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno = 'B'
                        THEN Representatividad_Quimica
                END
            ) AS float
        ) AS SRR_TurnoB_Quimico,

        CAST(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno = 'B'
                        THEN Representatividad_Fisica
                END
            ) AS float
        ) AS SRR_TurnoB_Fisico

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_representatividad_srr_turno_calculada

    GROUP BY Fecha
)

SELECT
    t12.Dia,

    t12.TM1_TurnoA_Quimico,
    t12.TM1_TurnoA_Fisico,
    t12.TM1_TurnoB_Quimico,
    t12.TM1_TurnoB_Fisico,

    t12.TM2_TurnoA_Quimico,
    t12.TM2_TurnoA_Fisico,
    t12.TM2_TurnoB_Quimico,
    t12.TM2_TurnoB_Fisico,

    srr.SRR_TurnoA_Quimico,
    srr.SRR_TurnoA_Fisico,
    srr.SRR_TurnoB_Quimico,
    srr.SRR_TurnoB_Fisico

FROM representatividad_t12 AS t12

LEFT JOIN representatividad_srr AS srr
    ON srr.Dia = t12.Dia;
