        FROM ModulosActivos ma
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.campaña c
            ON ma.[campaña_id] = c.[id_campaña]
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.modulo m
            ON ma.modulo_id = m.id_modulo
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.parcela p

        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.pad pd

        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.control_ley_ripio clr
            ON clr.Campana = c.[numero_campaña]
           AND clr.Parcela = p.numero
           AND UPPER(clr.PAD) LIKE UPPER(pd.nombre) + '%'
        WHERE pd.id_pad = 1
    )

        t.Tonelaje,

/* ================================================================
   F33 - TRANSFERENCIA DE COBRE DESDE PAD DUMP MINERAL A SOLUCION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   F37 = DPLS
   F38 = Feed DUMP

   Densidad de soluciones asumida:
       1.0 t/m3

   Cobre fino:
       CuF37 = F37 * Ley37 / 100
       CuF38 = F38 * Ley38 / 100

   Balance de cobre del nodo solucion:
       F33 + CuF38 = CuF35 + CuF37

   Como CuF35 = 0:

       F33 = CuF37 - CuF38

   F33 representa directamente toneladas de cobre fino:
       Ley F33 = 100 %
       CuF33    = F33
================================================================ */

;WITH F37 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu

    FROM #flujos_resultado

    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F37'
),

F38 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu

    FROM #flujos_resultado

    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F38'
),

Calculo_F33 AS
(
    SELECT
        /* Cobre fino DPLS */
        F37.Tonelaje
        * F37.Ley_Cu
        / 100.0 AS CuF37,

        /* Cobre fino Feed DUMP */
        F38.Tonelaje
        * F38.Ley_Cu
        / 100.0 AS CuF38

    FROM F37
    CROSS JOIN F38
)

(

/* ================================================================

   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Relación:

       F42 -> PAD2 -> proporción de F14

   IMPORTANTE:
       - NO se recalculan F14/F15.
       - Se consumen directamente desde #flujos_resultado.
       - Así F40/F42 heredan exactamente la misma lógica validada
         de masa, humedad, CuT y fecha operacional.
================================================================ */

;WITH Base_F1415 AS
(
    SELECT
        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN codigo_flujo = 'F14'
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje)
            END
        ) AS F14_TMS,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN codigo_flujo = 'F15'
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje)
            END
        ) AS F15_TMS

    FROM #flujos_resultado

    WHERE codigo_flujo IN ('F14', 'F15')
),

Proporcion AS
(
    SELECT
        F14_TMS,
        F15_TMS,

        CASE
            /* Si falta una de las bases, no inventar proporción */
            WHEN F14_TMS IS NULL
              OR F15_TMS IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN F14_TMS + F15_TMS = 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                F14_TMS
                / NULLIF(F14_TMS + F15_TMS, 0)
        END AS Prop_F14,

        CASE
            WHEN F14_TMS IS NULL
              OR F15_TMS IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            WHEN F14_TMS + F15_TMS = 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                F15_TMS
                / NULLIF(F14_TMS + F15_TMS, 0)
        END AS Prop_F15

    FROM Base_F1415
),

        SUM

        / 10.0 AS Ley_Cu

    WHERE t.fecha_registro >= @fecha_inicio

              SELECT 1
              FROM #flujos_resultado AS r

/* ================================================================
   F39 / F41 / F44 / F45 / F46
   RIEGO A PARCELAS CLASIFICADO POR NATURALEZA DE SOLUCION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------

   Fuente:
       inventar_SpcHidr.v_riego_parcelas_origen

   Mapeo:

       OX + REFINO   -> F39
       OX + ILS      -> F41
       OX + DPLS     -> F46

       SULF + REFINO -> F44
       SULF + ILS    -> F45

   Concentraciones:

       F39 -> conc_cu.oxidos_refino_cu
       F41 -> conc_cu.oxidos_ils_a_piscina_cu
       F46 -> conc_cu.dump_dpls_cu

       F44 -> conc_cu.sulfuros_refino_cu
       F45 -> conc_cu.sulfuros_ils_a_piscina_cu

   Integracion:
       caudal_riego [m3/h]
       x duración real del intervalo [h]

   Densidad de solución:
       1 t/m3

   Conversión ley:
       g/L / 10 = % Cu
================================================================ */

;WITH Configuracion AS
(
    SELECT 'F39' AS codigo_flujo, 'OX' AS pila_codigo, 'REFINO' AS origen_riego
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F41', 'OX',   'ILS'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F46', 'OX',   'DPLS'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F44', 'SULF', 'REFINO'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F45', 'SULF', 'ILS'
),

/* ================================================================
   Concentraciones diarias

   Se consolida por fecha para impedir multiplicación de filas
   si conc_cu contiene más de un registro para un mismo día.
================================================================ */
Concentraciones AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(c.fecha_registro AS date) AS Fecha,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.oxidos_refino_cu)
        ) AS Cu_Refino_Ox,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.oxidos_ils_a_piscina_cu)
        ) AS Cu_ILS_Ox,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.dump_dpls_cu)
        ) AS Cu_DPLS,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.sulfuros_refino_cu)
        ) AS Cu_Refino_Sulf,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.sulfuros_ils_a_piscina_cu)
        ) AS Cu_ILS_Sulf

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.conc_cu AS c

    WHERE CAST(c.fecha_registro AS date)
          BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin

    GROUP BY
        CAST(c.fecha_registro AS date)
),

/* ================================================================
   Caudal de cada parcela integrado por duración real
================================================================ */
Riego_Base AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(v.fecha_registro AS date) AS Fecha,

        UPPER(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(v.pila_codigo))
        ) AS pila_codigo,

        UPPER(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(v.origen_riego))
        ) AS origen_riego,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, v.caudal_riego)
        *
        (
            DATEDIFF_BIG
            (
                SECOND,
                v.fecha_registro,
                v.intervalo_fin
            )
            / 3600.0
        ) AS Volumen

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_riego_parcelas_origen AS v

    WHERE CAST(v.fecha_registro AS date)
          BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin

      AND v.intervalo_fin > v.fecha_registro

      AND UPPER(
              LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(v.estado_operacional,'')))
          ) = 'ACTIVO'

      AND TRY_CONVERT(float, v.caudal_riego) >= 0
),

/* ================================================================
   Asignar concentración según PAD + naturaleza
================================================================ */
Riego_Con_Ley AS
(
    SELECT
        r.Fecha,
        r.pila_codigo,
        r.origen_riego,
        r.Volumen,

        CASE

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'OX'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'REFINO'
                THEN c.Cu_Refino_Ox

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'OX'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'ILS'
                THEN c.Cu_ILS_Ox

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'OX'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'DPLS'
                THEN c.Cu_DPLS

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'SULF'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'REFINO'
                THEN c.Cu_Refino_Sulf

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'SULF'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'ILS'
                THEN c.Cu_ILS_Sulf

            ELSE NULL

        END AS Cu_g_L

    FROM Riego_Base AS r

    LEFT JOIN Concentraciones AS c
        ON c.Fecha = r.Fecha
),

Resumen AS
(
    SELECT
        pila_codigo,
        origen_riego,

        SUM(Volumen) AS Tonelaje,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN Volumen > 0
                 AND Cu_g_L IS NULL
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Registros_Sin_Ley,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN Cu_g_L IS NOT NULL
                THEN Volumen * Cu_g_L
            END
        ) AS Suma_Cu_Ponderada,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN Cu_g_L IS NOT NULL
                THEN Volumen
            END
        ) AS Volumen_Con_Ley

    FROM Riego_Con_Ley

    WHERE origen_riego IN ('REFINO', 'ILS', 'DPLS')

    GROUP BY
        pila_codigo,
        origen_riego
)

INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)

SELECT
    cfg.codigo_flujo,

    CAST(
        COALESCE(r.Tonelaje, 0)
        AS decimal(18,6)
    ) AS Tonelaje,

    CAST
    (
        CASE

            /* No existe ese tipo de riego durante el período */
            WHEN COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) = 0
                THEN 0

            /* Hay masa real pero falta concentración:
               no inventar ley */
            WHEN COALESCE(r.Registros_Sin_Ley,0) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                (
                    r.Suma_Cu_Ponderada
                    /
                    NULLIF(r.Volumen_Con_Ley,0)
                )
                / 10.0
        END

        AS decimal(18,6)
    ) AS Ley_Cu

FROM Configuracion AS cfg

LEFT JOIN Resumen AS r
    ON  r.pila_codigo = cfg.pila_codigo
    AND r.origen_riego = cfg.origen_riego;

    /* Registrar los aportes que dejarian caudal negativo antes de acotarlos. */
    INSERT INTO #ajustes_acotados
        (codigo_flujo, tonelaje_base, masa_manual, resultado_crudo, ajuste_maximo)
    SELECT
        r.codigo_flujo,
        COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0),
        m.masa_manual,
        COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) + m.masa_manual,
        -COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0)
    FROM #flujos_resultado AS r
    INNER JOIN #aportes_manuales AS m
        ON m.codigo_flujo = r.codigo_flujo
       AND m.aplicado = 0
    WHERE COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) + m.masa_manual < 0;

    /* Aplicar aporte manual antes de que un flujo dependiente lea el resultado.
       Guarda: el resultado se acota a cero; un caudal negativo no es fisico y
       se propaga a todos los flujos derivados aguas abajo. */
    UPDATE r
       SET r.Ley_Cu = CASE
                          WHEN COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) + m.masa_manual <= 0 THEN 0
                          ELSE ((COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) * COALESCE(r.Ley_Cu,0) / 100.0) + m.fcu_manual)
                               * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) + m.masa_manual,0)
                      END,
           r.Tonelaje = CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) + m.masa_manual < 0 THEN 0
                            ELSE COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) + m.masa_manual
                        END
    FROM #flujos_resultado AS r
    INNER JOIN #aportes_manuales AS m
        ON m.codigo_flujo = r.codigo_flujo
       AND m.aplicado = 0;

    UPDATE m
       SET m.aplicado = 1
    FROM #aportes_manuales AS m
    WHERE m.aplicado = 0
      AND EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM #flujos_resultado AS r
              WHERE r.codigo_flujo = m.codigo_flujo
          );

/* ================================================================
   F51 - SOLUCION PLS SULFUROS -> ILS SULFUROS
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Balance piscina ILS Sulfuros:

       F51 = F45 + F62 + F63

   F45 = salida ILS hacia riego
   F62 = evaporacion
   F63 = delta inventario ILS

   Cobre:
       CuF51 = CuF45 + CuF63
       F62 no transporta Cu
================================================================ */

;WITH F45 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0) AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F45'
),
F62 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F62'
),
F63 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0) AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F63'
),
Calculo AS
(
    SELECT
          F45.Tonelaje
        + F62.Tonelaje
        + F63.Tonelaje AS Tonelaje_F51,

        (
            F45.Tonelaje * F45.Ley_Cu / 100.0
        )
        +
        (
            F63.Tonelaje * F63.Ley_Cu / 100.0
        ) AS FCu_F51

    FROM F45
    CROSS JOIN F62
    CROSS JOIN F63
)

        (

        (

/* ================================================================
   F53 - DPLS HACIA PLS OX
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Balance de masa nodo DPLS:

       F37 = F69 + F53 + F71 + F46

   Despejando:

       F53 = F37 - F69 - F71 - F46

   Donde:
       F37 = ingreso desde PAD DUMP
       F69 = variacion inventario DPLS
       F71 = perdida por evaporacion
       F46 = salida hacia PAD Ox
       F53 = salida hacia PLS Ox

   Balance de cobre:

       CuF37 = CuF69 + CuF53 + CuF71 + CuF46

   Como F71 corresponde a evaporacion:
       CuF71 = 0

   Entonces:

       CuF53 = CuF37 - CuF69 - CuF46

   IMPORTANTE:
       - Se elimina el antiguo factor fijo 0.95.
       - La evaporacion queda representada explicitamente por F71.
       - No se fuerza F53 >= 0.
================================================================ */

;WITH F37 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F37'
),

F46 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F46'
),

F69 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F69'
),

F71 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F71'
),

Calculo AS
(
    SELECT

        /* ========================================================
           MASA
           ======================================================== */
          F37.Tonelaje
        - F69.Tonelaje
        - F71.Tonelaje
        - F46.Tonelaje
            AS Tonelaje_F53,


        /* ========================================================
           COBRE FINO
           ======================================================== */
        (
            F37.Tonelaje
            * F37.Ley_Cu
            / 100.0
        )
        -
        (
            F69.Tonelaje
            * F69.Ley_Cu
            / 100.0
        )
        -
        (
            F46.Tonelaje
            * F46.Ley_Cu
            / 100.0
        )
            AS FCu_F53

    FROM F37
    CROSS JOIN F46
    CROSS JOIN F69
    CROSS JOIN F71
)

INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(

            THEN 0

        WHEN Tonelaje_F53 = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            FCu_F53
            / NULLIF(Tonelaje_F53, 0)
            * 100.0
    END

FROM Calculo;

-- F100
-- Electrolito Rico hacia EW
--
-- Fuente única nueva:
--   sx_ep_flujos_niveles
--
-- Caudales:
--   er_ecc1_m3h
--   er_ecc2_m3h
--   er_ecc3_m3h
--
-- Concentraciones:
--   er_ecc1_gl
--   er_ecc2_gl
--   er_ecc3_gl
--
-- Granularidad:
--   diaria
--
-- Integracion:
--   m3/h * 24 h/dia = m3/dia

;WITH base_f100 AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(s.fecha_registro AS date) AS fecha,

        (
            COALESCE(s.er_ecc1_m3h, 0)
          + COALESCE(s.er_ecc2_m3h, 0)
          + COALESCE(s.er_ecc3_m3h, 0)
        ) * 24.0 AS volumen_m3_dia,

        COALESCE(s.er_ecc1_m3h, 0) AS q1,
        COALESCE(s.er_ecc2_m3h, 0) AS q2,
        COALESCE(s.er_ecc3_m3h, 0) AS q3,

        NULLIF(s.er_ecc1_gl, 0) AS c1,
        NULLIF(s.er_ecc2_gl, 0) AS c2,
        NULLIF(s.er_ecc3_gl, 0) AS c3

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.sx_ep_flujos_niveles s

    WHERE s.fecha_registro >= @fecha_inicio
      AND s.fecha_registro < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
)
INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F100',

    COALESCE(
        SUM(volumen_m3_dia),
        0
    ) AS Tonelaje,

    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN c1 IS NOT NULL THEN q1 * c1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN c2 IS NOT NULL THEN q2 * c2 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN c3 IS NOT NULL THEN q3 * c3 ELSE 0 END
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(
                CASE WHEN c1 IS NOT NULL THEN q1 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN c2 IS NOT NULL THEN q2 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN c3 IS NOT NULL THEN q3 ELSE 0 END
            ),
            0
        ),
        0
    ) / 10.0 AS Ley_Cu

FROM base_f100;

/* ================================================================
   F108 - VARIACION DE INVENTARIO DE COBRE COLGADO
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Fuente:
       inventar_SpcHidr.inventario_cobre_colgado_diario

   Campo:
       inventario_total_ton

   Metodologia:

       Inventario inicial = estado en @fecha_inicio

       Inventario final   = estado en @fecha_fin + 1 día

       F108 =
           Inventario(@fecha_fin + 1)
         - Inventario(@fecha_inicio)

   Ejemplo:
       Periodo balanceado: 01-08-2026 al 16-08-2026

       Inventario inicial: 01-08-2026
       Inventario final  : 17-08-2026

   Unidad:
       toneladas de Cu

   Ley:
       100 %

   IMPORTANTE:
       - Se utiliza @ff_mas_1, ya declarado como:
             DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)

       - inventario_total_ton es el inventario calculado
         por el sistema.

       - excel_total_ton se mantiene solamente como referencia.

       - No requiere integración temporal ni factor x24.
================================================================ */

;WITH base_f108 AS
(
    SELECT

        /* ========================================================
           INVENTARIO INICIAL
           Fecha = @fecha_inicio
           ======================================================== */
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                TRY_CONVERT(
                    decimal(18,6),
                    p.inventario_total_ton
                )

            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.inventario_cobre_colgado_diario AS p

            WHERE p.fecha_operacional = @fecha_inicio

            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(
                    p.updated_at,
                    p.imported_at
                ) DESC,
                p.id_registro DESC

        ) AS Inventario_Inicial,


        /* ========================================================
           INVENTARIO FINAL
           Fecha = @fecha_fin + 1 día
           ======================================================== */
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                TRY_CONVERT(
                    decimal(18,6),
                    p.inventario_total_ton
                )

            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.inventario_cobre_colgado_diario AS p

            WHERE p.fecha_operacional = @ff_mas_1

            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(
                    p.updated_at,
                    p.imported_at
                ) DESC,
                p.id_registro DESC

        ) AS Inventario_Final
)

-- F120: flujo de agua make-up hacia la piscina Feed DUMP.
-- No existe medicion directa por flujometro, por lo que se estima por balance de masa/volumen del nodo.
-- Balance del nodo Feed DUMP:
--     Entradas = F52 + F120
--     Salidas  = F38 + F70 + F72
-- Despejando:
--     F120 = F38 + F70 + F72 - F52
-- donde:
--     F70 = variacion de inventario del nodo en el periodo
--     F72 = perdida por evaporacion (ahora calculada con la tasa de evaporacion real, ver seccion 8)
-- entonces:
--     F120 = F38 + F70 + F72 - F52
-- Si el resultado es negativo, se interpreta como que no se requiere make-up externo en el periodo,
-- dado que la entrada F52 y/o la disminucion de inventario cubren las salidas del sistema.

;WITH f38 AS (
    SELECT Tonelaje

    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F38'

    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F52'
)

    CASE

        ELSE COALESCE(f38.Tonelaje, 0) + COALESCE(f70.Tonelaje, 0) + COALESCE(f72.Tonelaje, 0) - COALESCE(f52.Tonelaje, 0)
    END,

/* ================================================================
   F23 - TRANSFERENCIA DE COBRE PAD OXIDOS
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Representa el cobre transferido desde el mineral hacia
   la solucion durante la lixiviacion del PAD Oxidos.

   Entradas liquidas al PAD:
       F39 = Refino
       F41 = ILS
       F43 = otra entrada de solucion contemplada por el modelo
       F46 = DPLS

   Salida liquida:
       F48 = drenaje hacia PLS Oxidos

   Balance de cobre fino:

       CuF23 =
           CuF48
         - CuF39
         - CuF41
         - CuF43
         - CuF46

   F23 ya representa toneladas de cobre fino:
       Ley_Cu = 100 %
================================================================ */

;WITH F39 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F39'
),

F41 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F41'
),

F43 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F43'
),

F46 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F46'
),

F48 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F48'
)

INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F23',

      (F48.Tonelaje * F48.Ley_Cu / 100.0)

    - (F39.Tonelaje * F39.Ley_Cu / 100.0)

    - (F41.Tonelaje * F41.Ley_Cu / 100.0)

    - (F43.Tonelaje * F43.Ley_Cu / 100.0)

    - (F46.Tonelaje * F46.Ley_Cu / 100.0),

    100.0

FROM F39
CROSS JOIN F41
CROSS JOIN F43
CROSS JOIN F46
CROSS JOIN F48;

    /* Registrar los aportes que dejarian caudal negativo antes de acotarlos. */
    INSERT INTO #ajustes_acotados
        (codigo_flujo, tonelaje_base, masa_manual, resultado_crudo, ajuste_maximo)
    SELECT
        r.codigo_flujo,

/* ================================================================
   F24 - TRANSFERENCIA DE COBRE PAD SULFUROS
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Representa el cobre transferido desde el mineral hacia
   la solucion durante la lixiviacion del PAD Sulfuros.

   Entradas liquidas al PAD:
       F44 = Refino
       F45 = ILS

   Salidas liquidas:
       F49 = Bleed
       F50 = drenaje PLS Sulfuros

   Balance de cobre fino:

       CuF24 =
           CuF49
         + CuF50
         - CuF44
         - CuF45

   F58 corresponde a evaporacion:
       CuF58 = 0

   F24 ya representa toneladas de cobre fino:
       Ley_Cu = 100 %
================================================================ */

;WITH F44 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F44'
),

F45 AS
(

    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F45'
),

F49 AS
(

        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Tonelaje),0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F49'

F50 AS
(

        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float,Ley_Cu),0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F50'
)

(

    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F24',

      (F49.Tonelaje * F49.Ley_Cu / 100.0)

    + (F50.Tonelaje * F50.Ley_Cu / 100.0)

    - (F44.Tonelaje * F44.Ley_Cu / 100.0)

    - (F45.Tonelaje * F45.Ley_Cu / 100.0),

FROM F44
CROSS JOIN F45
CROSS JOIN F49
CROSS JOIN F50;

        @ton18_i decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley18_i decimal(18,6) = 0,

        @ton22_i decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley22_i decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @tms_ini_f16 decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley_ini_f16 decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @tms_ini_f17 decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley_ini_f17 decimal(18,6) = 0;
/* ================================================================
   BASE DEL DIA INICIAL PARA F16 / F17
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Se mantiene la intención histórica del bloque:

       @ton14_i / @ley14_i = alimentación del día inicial PAD2
       @ton15_i / @ley15_i = alimentación del día inicial PAD1

   CORRECCIONES:
       - Se elimina import_leyes_torres.
       - Se usan las mismas fuentes validadas de F12/F13/F14/F15.
       - control_apilado_diario.fecha YA es fecha operacional.
       - NO se aplica DATEADD(DAY,-1,...).

   IMPORTANTE:
       No se modifica todavía la definición posterior de
       @ton18_i / @ton19_i.
================================================================ */

;WITH Humedad AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        Humedad_TM1,
        Humedad_TM2

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.fn_humedad_resuelta_tm_turno_test
    (
        @fecha_inicio,
        DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_inicio)
    )
),

TMH AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        TM,
        TMH
    FROM #TMH_Principal_Balance
    WHERE Fecha = @fecha_inicio
),

Base AS
(
    SELECT
        t.Fecha,
        t.Turno,
        t.TM,
        t.TMH,

        CASE
            WHEN t.TM = 'TM1'
                THEN h.Humedad_TM1

            WHEN t.TM = 'TM2'
                THEN h.Humedad_TM2
        END AS Humedad,

        l.CuT

    FROM TMH AS t

    LEFT JOIN Humedad AS h
        ON  h.Fecha = t.Fecha
        AND h.Turno = t.Turno

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l
        ON  l.Fecha = t.Fecha
        AND l.Turno = t.Turno
        AND l.TM    = t.TM
),

Calculo AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        TM,
        TMH,
        Humedad,
        CuT,

        CASE
            WHEN TMH = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN Humedad IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                TMH
                *
                (
                    1.0
                    - TRY_CONVERT(float, Humedad) / 100.0
                )
        END AS TMS,

        CASE
            WHEN TMH = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN Humedad IS NULL
              OR CuT IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                (
                    TMH
                    *
                    (
                        1.0
                        - TRY_CONVERT(float, Humedad) / 100.0
                    )
                )
                * TRY_CONVERT(float, CuT)
                / 100.0

        END AS FCu

    FROM Base
),

Resumen_Dia AS
(
    SELECT
        /* --------------------------------------------------------
           Masa total TM1 + TM2 del día inicial
           -------------------------------------------------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM
                 (
                     CASE
                         WHEN TMH > 0
                          AND Humedad IS NULL
                             THEN 1
                         ELSE 0
                     END
                 ) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE SUM(TMS)
        END AS TMS_Dia,

        /* --------------------------------------------------------
           Cobre fino total del día inicial
           -------------------------------------------------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM
                 (
                     CASE
                         WHEN TMH > 0
                          AND
                              (
                                  Humedad IS NULL
                                  OR CuT IS NULL
                              )
                             THEN 1
                         ELSE 0
                     END
                 ) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE SUM(FCu)
        END AS FCu_Dia

    FROM Calculo
),

Pad_Dia AS
(
    SELECT
        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN cad.pad_id = 2
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, cad.volumen_diario_m3) > 0
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS PAD2_Activo,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN cad.pad_id = 1
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, cad.volumen_diario_m3) > 0
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS PAD1_Activo

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_apilado_diario AS cad

    /* fecha YA corresponde al día operacional */
    WHERE CAST(cad.fecha AS date) = @fecha_inicio
)

SELECT
    /* ============================================================
       PAD2 -> estado inicial utilizado por F16
       ============================================================ */
    @ton14_i =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(p.PAD2_Activo, 0) = 1
                THEN COALESCE(r.TMS_Dia, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END,

    @ley14_i =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(p.PAD2_Activo, 0) = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN COALESCE(r.TMS_Dia, 0) = 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                COALESCE(r.FCu_Dia, 0)
                / NULLIF(r.TMS_Dia, 0)
                * 100.0
        END,

    /* ============================================================
       PAD1 -> estado inicial utilizado por F17
       ============================================================ */
    @ton15_i =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(p.PAD1_Activo, 0) = 1

            ELSE 0
        END,

            WHEN COALESCE(r.TMS_Dia, 0) = 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                COALESCE(r.FCu_Dia, 0)
                / NULLIF(r.TMS_Dia, 0)
                * 100.0
        END

FROM Resumen_Dia AS r
CROSS JOIN Pad_Dia AS p;
    SELECT

    BEGIN
        PRINT '';
        PRINT '*** ADVERTENCIA: aportes manuales que dejarian caudal negativo. Acotados a cero.';
        PRINT '    Flujo | Tonelaje BD | Ajuste solicitado | Sin guarda | Ajuste maximo admisible';

        DECLARE @ac_flujo varchar(10),
                @ac_base  decimal(18,6),
                @ac_manual decimal(18,6),
                @ac_crudo decimal(18,6),
                @ac_max   decimal(18,6);

        DECLARE cur_ajustes_acotados CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT codigo_flujo, tonelaje_base, masa_manual, resultado_crudo, ajuste_maximo
            FROM #ajustes_acotados
            ORDER BY codigo_flujo;

        OPEN cur_ajustes_acotados;
        FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ajustes_acotados
            INTO @ac_flujo, @ac_base, @ac_manual, @ac_crudo, @ac_max;

        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            PRINT '    ' + @ac_flujo
                + ' | ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(decimal(18,2), @ac_base))
                + ' | ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(decimal(18,2), @ac_manual))
                + ' | ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(decimal(18,2), @ac_crudo))
                + ' | ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(decimal(18,2), @ac_max));

            FETCH NEXT FROM cur_ajustes_acotados
                INTO @ac_flujo, @ac_base, @ac_manual, @ac_crudo, @ac_max;
        END;

        CLOSE cur_ajustes_acotados;
        DEALLOCATE cur_ajustes_acotados;
        PRINT '';
    END;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9) SALIDA FINAL
    --
    -- Este debe ser SIEMPRE el primer resultset del procedimiento: el cliente
    -- lo lee como la lista completa de flujos.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        codigo_flujo AS Flujo,
        TMS_Inicial,
        Ley_Cu_1,
        TMS_Final,
        Ley_Cu_2,
        Tonelaje,
        Ley_Cu,
        Tonelaje * Ley_Cu / 100.0 AS FCu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    ORDER BY
        TRY_CONVERT(int, REPLACE(codigo_flujo, 'F', ''));

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 10) DETALLE DE AJUSTES ACOTADOS (solo diagnostico manual)
    --
    -- Se emite despues de la salida final y solo con @debug_acotados = 1.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @debug_acotados = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ajustes_acotados)
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            codigo_flujo                AS Flujo,
            tonelaje_base               AS Tonelaje_BD,
            masa_manual                 AS Ajuste_Solicitado,
            resultado_crudo             AS Resultado_Sin_Guarda,
            ajuste_maximo               AS Ajuste_Maximo_Admisible,
            masa_manual - ajuste_maximo AS Exceso
        FROM #ajustes_acotados
        ORDER BY Flujo;
    END;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ajustes_acotados;
END;

name: v_modulos_turnos_unificado_test
definition:
CREATE   VIEW [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_modulos_turnos_unificado_test]
AS

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        mt.*,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, mt.ACF_3) AS ACF_3_Num,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, mt.CSR_Cc)  AS CSR_CC_Num_Legacy,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, mt.CSR_Cps) AS CSR_CV_Num_Legacy,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, mt.CSR_Cu)  AS CSR_CPY_Num_Legacy

    FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[modulos_turnos] mt
),

flags AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,

        /* =====================================================
           GRANULOMETRÍA
           Bloque nuevo completo en cero + antiguo completo NULL
           => tratar como ausencia de información.
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN M1 IS NULL
             AND M34 IS NULL
             AND M12 IS NULL
             AND M14 IS NULL
             AND M10 IS NULL
             AND M35 IS NULL
             AND M100 IS NULL
             AND M150 IS NULL
             AND M200 IS NULL
             AND M325 IS NULL
             AND Bajo_Malla_325 IS NULL

             AND [1"]    IS NOT NULL
             AND [3/4"]  IS NOT NULL
             AND [1/2"]  IS NOT NULL
             AND [1/4"]  IS NOT NULL
             AND [#10]   IS NOT NULL
             AND [#35]   IS NOT NULL
             AND [#100]  IS NOT NULL
             AND [#150]  IS NOT NULL
             AND [#200]  IS NOT NULL
             AND [#325]  IS NOT NULL
             AND [-#325] IS NOT NULL

             AND CONVERT(float,[1"])    = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[3/4"])  = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[1/2"])  = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[1/4"])  = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[#10])   = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[#35])   = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[#100])  = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[#150])  = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[#200])  = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[#325])  = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[-#325]) = 0

            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero,

        /* =====================================================
           SRR
           Bandera de auditoría:
           indica que los 6 campos del bloque nuevo vienen en cero.
           OJO: cero NO implica necesariamente anomalía.
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN [SRR CuT]       IS NOT NULL
             AND [SRR CuS]       IS NOT NULL
             AND [SRR ClayBeta]  IS NOT NULL
             AND [SRR Malla 100] IS NOT NULL
             AND [SRR CO3]       IS NOT NULL
             AND [SRR Rec]       IS NOT NULL

             AND CONVERT(float,[SRR CuT])       = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[SRR CuS])       = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[SRR ClayBeta])  = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[SRR Malla 100]) = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[SRR CO3])       = 0
             AND CONVERT(float,[SRR Rec])       = 0

            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero

    FROM base b
)

SELECT

    /* =========================================================
       1. ESTRUCTURA
       ========================================================= */

    Campana,
    Parcela,
    Modulo,
    Fecha,
    PAD,
    Turno,

    mod_id,
    pad_id,
    parcela_id,
    modulo_id,
    campaña_id,

    /* =========================================================
       2. MASA / OPERACIÓN
       Aún históricos.
       ========================================================= */

    Humedad,
    TMH,
    TMS,
    Sal,

    [Altura Módulo],

    /* =========================================================
       3. QUÍMICA
       ========================================================= */

    CuT_TM,
    CuS_TM,

    CASE
        WHEN CuT_TM IS NULL
          OR CuS_TM IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE CuT_TM - CuS_TM
    END AS Cu_Insoluble,

    CASE
        WHEN CuT_TM IS NULL
          OR CuS_TM IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        WHEN CuT_TM = 0
            THEN 0

        ELSE CuS_TM / CuT_TM * 100.0
    END AS Tasa_Oxidacion,

    FeT,
    FeS,
    CO3,
    Cl_Sol_Ac,
    Consumo_H,
    Adición_H,

    /* =========================================================
       4. GRANULOMETRÍA
       Antiguo primero + nuevo como complemento.
       ========================================================= */

    CASE
        WHEN M1 IS NOT NULL THEN M1
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[1"])
    END AS M1,

    CASE
        WHEN M34 IS NOT NULL THEN M34
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[3/4"])
    END AS M34,

    CASE
        WHEN M12 IS NOT NULL THEN M12
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[1/2"])
    END AS M12,

    CASE
        WHEN M14 IS NOT NULL THEN M14
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[1/4"])
    END AS M14,

    CASE
        WHEN M10 IS NOT NULL THEN M10
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[#10])
    END AS M10,

    CASE
        WHEN M35 IS NOT NULL THEN M35
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[#35])
    END AS M35,

    CASE
        WHEN M100 IS NOT NULL THEN M100
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[#100])
    END AS M100,

    CASE
        WHEN M150 IS NOT NULL THEN M150
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[#150])
    END AS M150,

    CASE
        WHEN M200 IS NOT NULL THEN M200
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[#200])
    END AS M200,

    CASE
        WHEN M325 IS NOT NULL THEN M325
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[#325])
    END AS M325,

    CASE
        WHEN Bajo_Malla_325 IS NOT NULL THEN Bajo_Malla_325
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(float,[-#325])
    END AS Bajo_Malla_325,

    Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero,

    CASE
        WHEN Granulometria_Nueva_Default_Cero = 1
            THEN 'NUEVO_BLOQUE_CERO_NO_USADO'

        WHEN
               M1 IS NULL
           AND M34 IS NULL
           AND M12 IS NULL
           AND M14 IS NULL
           AND M10 IS NULL
           AND M35 IS NULL
           AND M100 IS NULL
           AND M150 IS NULL
           AND M200 IS NULL
           AND M325 IS NULL
           AND Bajo_Malla_325 IS NULL

           AND (
                  [1"] IS NOT NULL
               OR [3/4"] IS NOT NULL
               OR [1/2"] IS NOT NULL
               OR [1/4"] IS NOT NULL
               OR [#10] IS NOT NULL
               OR [#35] IS NOT NULL
               OR [#100] IS NOT NULL
               OR [#150] IS NOT NULL
               OR [#200] IS NOT NULL
               OR [#325] IS NOT NULL
               OR [-#325] IS NOT NULL
           )
            THEN 'NUEVO_COMPLEMENTO'

        WHEN
               (M1 IS NULL AND [1"] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M34 IS NULL AND [3/4"] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M12 IS NULL AND [1/2"] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M14 IS NULL AND [1/4"] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M10 IS NULL AND [#10] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M35 IS NULL AND [#35] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M100 IS NULL AND [#100] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M150 IS NULL AND [#150] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M200 IS NULL AND [#200] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (M325 IS NULL AND [#325] IS NOT NULL)
            OR (Bajo_Malla_325 IS NULL AND [-#325] IS NOT NULL)
            THEN 'MIXTA_HISTORICO_NUEVO'

        WHEN
               M1 IS NOT NULL
            OR M34 IS NOT NULL
            OR M12 IS NOT NULL
            OR M14 IS NOT NULL
            OR M10 IS NOT NULL
            OR M35 IS NOT NULL
            OR M100 IS NOT NULL
            OR M150 IS NOT NULL
            OR M200 IS NOT NULL
            OR M325 IS NOT NULL
            OR Bajo_Malla_325 IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'HISTORICO'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Fuente_Granulometria,

    /* =========================================================
       5. ACF
       Segundo bloque NO se usa como complemento.
       ========================================================= */

    ACF_3_Num AS ACF_3,
    ACF_4,
    ACF_5,
    ACF_6,
    ACF_7,

    CASE
        WHEN ACF_3_Num IS NOT NULL
          OR ACF_4 IS NOT NULL
          OR ACF_5 IS NOT NULL
          OR ACF_6 IS NOT NULL
          OR ACF_7 IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'HISTORICO_RAW'

        WHEN [ACF 3] IS NOT NULL
          OR [ACF 4] IS NOT NULL
          OR [ACF 5] IS NOT NULL
          OR [ACF 6] IS NOT NULL
          OR [ACF 7] IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'PENDIENTE_RECONSTRUCCION_FUENTE_ORIGINAL'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Estado_ACF,

    /* =========================================================
       6. CALIDAD
       Segundo bloque NO se usa como complemento.
       ========================================================= */

    calidad_1,
    calidad_2,
    calidad_3,

    CASE
        WHEN calidad_1 IS NOT NULL
          OR calidad_2 IS NOT NULL
          OR calidad_3 IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'HISTORICO_RAW'

        WHEN [Calidad 1] IS NOT NULL
          OR [Calidad 2] IS NOT NULL
          OR [Calidad 3] IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'PENDIENTE_RECONSTRUCCION_FUENTE_ORIGINAL'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Estado_Calidad,

    /* =========================================================
       7. RECUPERACIÓN GLOBAL
       ========================================================= */

    COALESCE(
        Recuperacion_global,
        CONVERT(float,[Recuperación global])
    ) AS Recuperacion_global,

    CASE
        WHEN Recuperacion_global IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'HISTORICO'

        WHEN [Recuperación global] IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUEVO_COMPLEMENTO'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Fuente_Recuperacion_global,

    /* =========================================================
       8. MINA / STOCK / SRR DISTRIBUCIÓN
       ========================================================= */

    Mina,
    stock,
    SRR,

    /* =========================================================
       9. NIR / MINERALOGÍA
       ========================================================= */

    Alunita,
    Biotita,
    Clorita,

    [Muscovita_Illita(Sericita) [%]]],

    OxidoFe,
    Betaclay,
    CuFe,

    CuT_PtXt,
    CuS_PtXt,
    CuSCN_PtXt,
    CuSFe_PtXt,
    Finos_cut,

    CUOXI,
    CUINS,

    /* =========================================================
       10. CSR

       CSR_Cc  -> csrCC
       CSR_Cps -> csrCV
       CSR_Cu  -> csrCPY

       Legacy numérico primero.
       ========================================================= */

    COALESCE(
        CSR_CC_Num_Legacy,
        CONVERT(float,csrCC)
    ) AS csrCC,

    COALESCE(
        CSR_CV_Num_Legacy,
        CONVERT(float,csrCV)
    ) AS csrCV,

    COALESCE(
        CSR_CPY_Num_Legacy,
        CONVERT(float,csrCPY)
    ) AS csrCPY,

    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CSR_Cc))) = 'oxido'
          OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CSR_Cps))) = 'oxido'
          OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CSR_Cu))) = 'oxido'
            THEN 'OXIDO'

        WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CSR_Cc))) = 'sin dato'
          OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CSR_Cps))) = 'sin dato'
          OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CSR_Cu))) = 'sin dato'
            THEN 'SIN_DATO'

        WHEN CSR_CC_Num_Legacy IS NOT NULL
          OR CSR_CV_Num_Legacy IS NOT NULL
          OR CSR_CPY_Num_Legacy IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUMERICO_LEGACY'

        WHEN csrCC IS NOT NULL
          OR csrCV IS NOT NULL
          OR csrCPY IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUMERICO_NUEVO'

        ELSE NULL
    END AS Estado_CSR,

    CASE
        WHEN CSR_CC_Num_Legacy IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'LEGACY_NUMERICO'

        WHEN csrCC IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUEVO_COMPLEMENTO'

        WHEN CSR_Cc IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'ESTADO_TEXTUAL_LEGACY'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Fuente_csrCC,

    CASE
        WHEN CSR_CV_Num_Legacy IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'LEGACY_NUMERICO'

        WHEN csrCV IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUEVO_COMPLEMENTO'

        WHEN CSR_Cps IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'ESTADO_TEXTUAL_LEGACY'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Fuente_csrCV,

    CASE
        WHEN CSR_CPY_Num_Legacy IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'LEGACY_NUMERICO'

        WHEN csrCPY IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUEVO_COMPLEMENTO'

        WHEN CSR_Cu IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'ESTADO_TEXTUAL_LEGACY'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Fuente_csrCPY,

    /* =========================================================
       11. SRR

       REGLA VALIDADA:

       1. Bloque nuevo tiene prioridad, incluso si viene en cero.
       2. Excepción:
             2026-05-13 turno B
          Hubo SRR real, el nuevo quedó en cero y el legacy
          conserva información útil.
       3. Si el bloque nuevo es NULL, legacy complementa.
       ========================================================= */

    CASE
        WHEN Fecha = CONVERT(date,'2026-05-13')
         AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Turno))) = 'B'
         AND SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
         AND SRR_CuT IS NOT NULL
            THEN SRR_CuT

        WHEN [SRR CuT] IS NOT NULL
            THEN CONVERT(float,[SRR CuT])

        ELSE SRR_CuT
    END AS SRR_CuT,

    CASE
        WHEN Fecha = CONVERT(date,'2026-05-13')
         AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Turno))) = 'B'
         AND SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
         AND SRR_CuS IS NOT NULL
            THEN SRR_CuS

        WHEN [SRR CuS] IS NOT NULL
            THEN CONVERT(float,[SRR CuS])

        ELSE SRR_CuS
    END AS SRR_CuS,

    CASE
        WHEN Fecha = CONVERT(date,'2026-05-13')
         AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Turno))) = 'B'
         AND SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
         AND SRR_ClayBeta IS NOT NULL
            THEN SRR_ClayBeta

        WHEN [SRR ClayBeta] IS NOT NULL
            THEN CONVERT(float,[SRR ClayBeta])

        ELSE SRR_ClayBeta
    END AS SRR_ClayBeta,

    CASE
        WHEN Fecha = CONVERT(date,'2026-05-13')
         AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Turno))) = 'B'
         AND SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
         AND SRR_Malla_100 IS NOT NULL
            THEN SRR_Malla_100

        WHEN [SRR Malla 100] IS NOT NULL
            THEN CONVERT(float,[SRR Malla 100])

        ELSE SRR_Malla_100
    END AS SRR_Malla_100,

    CASE
        WHEN Fecha = CONVERT(date,'2026-05-13')
         AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Turno))) = 'B'
         AND SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
         AND SRR_CO3 IS NOT NULL
            THEN SRR_CO3

        WHEN [SRR CO3] IS NOT NULL
            THEN CONVERT(float,[SRR CO3])

        ELSE SRR_CO3
    END AS SRR_CO3,

    CASE
        WHEN Fecha = CONVERT(date,'2026-05-13')
         AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Turno))) = 'B'
         AND SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
         AND SRR_Rec IS NOT NULL
            THEN SRR_Rec

        WHEN [SRR Rec] IS NOT NULL
            THEN CONVERT(float,[SRR Rec])

        ELSE SRR_Rec
    END AS SRR_Rec,

    SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero,

    CASE
        WHEN Fecha = CONVERT(date,'2026-05-13')
         AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Turno))) = 'B'
         AND SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
            THEN 'LEGACY_POR_ANOMALIA_20260513_B'

        WHEN Fecha = CONVERT(date,'2026-05-13')
         AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Turno))) = 'A'
         AND SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
            THEN 'NUEVO_CERO_DESCARTA_LEGACY_SIN_SRR'

        WHEN SRR_Nuevo_Bloque_Cero = 1
            THEN 'NUEVO_CERO_COHERENTE'

        WHEN [SRR CuT] IS NOT NULL
          OR [SRR CuS] IS NOT NULL
          OR [SRR ClayBeta] IS NOT NULL
          OR [SRR Malla 100] IS NOT NULL
          OR [SRR CO3] IS NOT NULL
          OR [SRR Rec] IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUEVO_HISTORICO'

        WHEN SRR_CuT IS NOT NULL
          OR SRR_CuS IS NOT NULL
          OR SRR_ClayBeta IS NOT NULL
          OR SRR_Malla_100 IS NOT NULL
          OR SRR_CO3 IS NOT NULL
          OR SRR_Rec IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'LEGACY_SRR'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Fuente_SRR,

    /* =========================================================
       12. GEOLOGÍA
       ========================================================= */

    Transicional,

    COALESCE(
        CONVERT(float,[Supérgeno]),
        Supergeno
    ) AS Supergeno,

    COALESCE(
        CONVERT(float,[Óxido]),
        Oxido
    ) AS Oxido,

    CASE
        WHEN [Supérgeno] IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUEVO_HISTORICO'

        WHEN Supergeno IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'LEGACY_COMPLEMENTO'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Fuente_Supergeno,

    CASE
        WHEN [Óxido] IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'NUEVO_HISTORICO'

        WHEN Oxido IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'LEGACY_COMPLEMENTO'

        ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
    END AS Fuente_Oxido

FROM flags;

name: vw_campana_periodo_modulo
definition:
/* ============================================================
   3) CAMPAÑAS CON VENTANA DE FECHAS POR MODULO
   - Usa LEAD para obtener fecha_fin
   - Base recomendada para control por campaña
   ============================================================ */
CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.vw_campana_periodo_modulo
AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        pmc.id_pad,
        pmc.nombre_pad,
        pmc.id_parcela,
        pmc.id_modulo,
        pmc.id_campaña,
        pmc.numero_campaña,
        pmc.fecha_inicio,
        LEAD(pmc.fecha_inicio) OVER (
            PARTITION BY pmc.id_modulo
            ORDER BY pmc.fecha_inicio
        ) AS fecha_inicio_siguiente
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vw_parcela_modulo_campana pmc
)
SELECT
    id_pad,
    nombre_pad,
    id_parcela,
    id_modulo,
    id_campaña,
    numero_campaña,
    fecha_inicio,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(DATEADD(DAY, -1, fecha_inicio_siguiente), '2099-12-31')
        AS date
    ) AS fecha_fin
FROM base;

name: v_peso_teorico_turno_torre_contingencia_test
definition:
CREATE VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_peso_teorico_turno_torre_contingencia_test
AS

WITH base AS
(
    SELECT
        pt.Fecha,
        pt.Turno,
        pt.Torre,

        pt.Horas_Reales,
        pt.Factor_Masa AS Factor_Masa_PI,

        pt.ts_ini,
        pt.ts_fin,

        pt.PesoBase_Quimico_12h,
        pt.PesoBase_Fisico_12h,

        pt.Fraccion_Muestreo AS Fraccion_Muestreo_PI,

        pt.PesoTeo_Quimico AS PesoTeo_Quimico_Actual,
        pt.PesoTeo_Fisico  AS PesoTeo_Fisico_Actual,

        Equipo =
            CASE pt.Torre
                WHEN 'T1' THEN 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                WHEN 'T2' THEN 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                ELSE NULL
            END

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_peso_teorico_turno_torre_excel AS pt
),

resuelto AS
(
    SELECT
        b.*,

        r.fuente_resuelta,
        r.valor_final_resuelto,
        r.tipo_tum,
        r.motivo_decision,

        Turno_TUM_Ini =
            CASE
                WHEN b.Turno = 'A'
                    THEN DATEADD(
                            HOUR,
                            8,
                            CAST(b.Fecha AS datetime2)
                         )

                WHEN b.Turno = 'B'
                    THEN DATEADD(
                            HOUR,
                            20,
                            CAST(b.Fecha AS datetime2)
                         )
            END,

        Turno_TUM_Fin =
            CASE
                WHEN b.Turno = 'A'
                    THEN DATEADD(
                            HOUR,
                            20,
                            CAST(b.Fecha AS datetime2)
                         )

                WHEN b.Turno = 'B'
                    THEN DATEADD(
                            HOUR,
                            8,
                            DATEADD(
                                DAY,
                                1,
                                CAST(b.Fecha AS datetime2)
                            )
                         )
            END

    FROM base AS b

    LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT fecha_operacional,turno,equipo_codigo,fuente_resuelta,
           valor_final_resuelto,tipo_tum,motivo_decision
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_totalizador_resuelto_turno WHERE fecha_operacional < '2026-09-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fecha_operacional,turno,equipo_codigo,fuente_resuelta,
           valor_final_resuelto,tipo_tum,motivo_decision
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_totalizador_resuelto_operacional_test WHERE fecha_operacional >= '2026-09-01'
) AS r
        ON r.fecha_operacional = b.Fecha
       AND r.turno = b.Turno
       AND r.equipo_codigo = b.Equipo
),

ventanas AS
(
    SELECT
        r.*,

        Overlap_Ini =
            CASE
                WHEN r.ts_ini > r.Turno_TUM_Ini
                    THEN r.ts_ini
                ELSE r.Turno_TUM_Ini
            END,

        Overlap_Fin =
            CASE
                WHEN r.ts_fin < r.Turno_TUM_Fin
                    THEN r.ts_fin
                ELSE r.Turno_TUM_Fin
            END

    FROM resuelto AS r
),

calculo AS
(
    SELECT
        v.*,

        Minutos_Overlap =
            CASE
                WHEN v.Overlap_Fin > v.Overlap_Ini
                    THEN DATEDIFF(
                            MINUTE,
                            v.Overlap_Ini,
                            v.Overlap_Fin
                         )
                ELSE 0
            END,

        Fraccion_Overlap_TUM =
            CASE
                WHEN v.Overlap_Fin > v.Overlap_Ini
                    THEN
                        DATEDIFF(
                            MINUTE,
                            v.Overlap_Ini,
                            v.Overlap_Fin
                        ) / 720.0
                ELSE NULL
            END,

        Factor_Masa_TUM =
            CASE
                WHEN v.valor_final_resuelto IS NULL
                    THEN NULL

                WHEN v.valor_final_resuelto < 0
                    THEN NULL

                WHEN v.valor_final_resuelto >= 22500.0
                    THEN 1.0

                ELSE
                    v.valor_final_resuelto / 22500.0
            END

    FROM ventanas AS v
)

SELECT
    Fecha,
    Turno,
    Torre,

    Horas_Reales,

    Factor_Masa_PI,

    ts_ini,
    ts_fin,

    PesoBase_Quimico_12h,
    PesoBase_Fisico_12h,

    Fraccion_Muestreo_PI,

    PesoTeo_Quimico_Actual,
    PesoTeo_Fisico_Actual,

    Fuente_Calculo =
        CASE
            /* Histórico previo al inicio de contingencia */
            WHEN Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN 'PI_INTERVALO_HISTORICO'

            /* SRR mantiene su metodología propia */
            WHEN Torre = 'SRR'
                THEN 'PI_INTERVALO_SRR'

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'PI'
                THEN 'PI_INTERVALO'

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'TUM'
                THEN 'TUM_TURNO'

            ELSE 'SIN_RESOLVER'
        END,

    Fuente_Resolver = fuente_resuelta,

    tipo_tum,
    motivo_decision,

    Ton_TUM_Turno = valor_final_resuelto,

    Turno_TUM_Ini,
    Turno_TUM_Fin,

    Overlap_Ini,
    Overlap_Fin,
    Minutos_Overlap,
    Fraccion_Overlap_TUM,

    Factor_Masa_TUM,

    Factor_Masa_Calculo =
        CASE
            WHEN Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN Factor_Masa_PI

            WHEN Torre = 'SRR'
                THEN Factor_Masa_PI

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'PI'
                THEN Factor_Masa_PI

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'TUM'
                THEN Factor_Masa_TUM

            ELSE NULL
        END,

    Fraccion_Calculo =
        CASE
            WHEN Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN Fraccion_Muestreo_PI

            WHEN Torre = 'SRR'
                THEN Fraccion_Muestreo_PI

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'PI'
                THEN Fraccion_Muestreo_PI

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'TUM'
                THEN Fraccion_Overlap_TUM

            ELSE NULL
        END,

    PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato =
        CASE
            WHEN Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN PesoTeo_Quimico_Actual

            WHEN Torre = 'SRR'
                THEN PesoTeo_Quimico_Actual

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'PI'
                THEN PesoTeo_Quimico_Actual

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'TUM'
             AND Minutos_Overlap > 0
             AND Factor_Masa_TUM IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    PesoBase_Quimico_12h
                    * Factor_Masa_TUM
                    * Fraccion_Overlap_TUM

            ELSE NULL
        END,

    PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato =
        CASE
            WHEN Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN PesoTeo_Fisico_Actual

            WHEN Torre = 'SRR'
                THEN PesoTeo_Fisico_Actual

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'PI'
                THEN PesoTeo_Fisico_Actual

            WHEN fuente_resuelta = 'TUM'
             AND Minutos_Overlap > 0
             AND Factor_Masa_TUM IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    PesoBase_Fisico_12h
                    * Factor_Masa_TUM
                    * Fraccion_Overlap_TUM

            ELSE NULL
        END

FROM calculo;

definition:
CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.v_representatividad_diaria_calculada_contingencia_test
AS

WITH representatividad_t12 AS
(
    SELECT
        pt.Fecha AS Dia,

        /* =========================================================
           TM1 - TURNO A - QUIMICO
        ========================================================= */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN pt.Torre = 'T1'
                 AND pt.Turno = 'A'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Quimico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM1_TurnoA_Quimico,

        /* TM1 - TURNO A - FISICO */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN pt.Torre = 'T1'
                 AND pt.Turno = 'A'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Fisico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM1_TurnoA_Fisico,

        /* =========================================================
           TM1 - TURNO B
        ========================================================= */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN pt.Torre = 'T1'
                 AND pt.Turno = 'B'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Quimico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM1_TurnoB_Quimico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN pt.Torre = 'T1'
                 AND pt.Turno = 'B'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Fisico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM1_TurnoB_Fisico,

        /* =========================================================
           TM2 - TURNO A
        ========================================================= */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN pt.Torre = 'T2'
                 AND pt.Turno = 'A'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Quimico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM2_TurnoA_Quimico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN pt.Torre = 'T2'
                 AND pt.Turno = 'A'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Fisico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM2_TurnoA_Fisico,

        /* =========================================================
           TM2 - TURNO B
        ========================================================= */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN pt.Torre = 'T2'
                 AND pt.Turno = 'B'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Quimico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Quimico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Quimico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM2_TurnoB_Quimico,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN pt.Torre = 'T2'
                 AND pt.Turno = 'B'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato IS NULL
                          OR pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato <= 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico IS NULL
                          OR pr.PesoReal_Fisico < 0
                            THEN NULL

                        WHEN pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                             / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato >= 1
                            THEN 1.0

                        ELSE
                            pr.PesoReal_Fisico
                            / pt.PesoTeo_Fisico_Candidato
                    END
            END
        ) AS TM2_TurnoB_Fisico

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_peso_teorico_turno_torre_contingencia_test AS pt

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_peso_real_torre_turno_excel AS pr
        ON pr.Torre = pt.Torre
       AND pr.Fecha = pt.Fecha
       AND pr.Turno = pt.Turno

    WHERE pt.Torre IN ('T1', 'T2')

    GROUP BY
        pt.Fecha
),

representatividad_srr AS
(
    /*
        SRR queda EXACTAMENTE con su metodología vigente.
        No forma parte del cambio T1/T2.
    */
    SELECT
        Fecha AS Dia,

        CAST(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno = 'A'
                        THEN Representatividad_Quimica
                END
            ) AS float
        ) AS SRR_TurnoA_Quimico,

        CAST(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno = 'A'
                        THEN Representatividad_Fisica
                END
            ) AS float
        ) AS SRR_TurnoA_Fisico,

        CAST(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno = 'B'
                        THEN Representatividad_Quimica
                END
            ) AS float
        ) AS SRR_TurnoB_Quimico,

        CAST(
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN Turno = 'B'
                        THEN Representatividad_Fisica
                END
            ) AS float
        ) AS SRR_TurnoB_Fisico

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_representatividad_srr_turno_calculada

    GROUP BY
        Fecha
)

SELECT
    t12.Dia,

    t12.TM1_TurnoA_Quimico,
    t12.TM1_TurnoA_Fisico,
    t12.TM1_TurnoB_Quimico,
    t12.TM1_TurnoB_Fisico,

    t12.TM2_TurnoA_Quimico,
    t12.TM2_TurnoA_Fisico,
    t12.TM2_TurnoB_Quimico,
    t12.TM2_TurnoB_Fisico,

    srr.SRR_TurnoA_Quimico,
    srr.SRR_TurnoA_Fisico,
    srr.SRR_TurnoB_Quimico,
    srr.SRR_TurnoB_Fisico

FROM representatividad_t12 AS t12

LEFT JOIN representatividad_srr AS srr
    ON srr.Dia = t12.Dia;
