name: sp_rep_conductor_post_ajuste
v_cv25_diario
definition:
CREATE VIEW [reclamo].[v_cv25_diario]
AS

WITH hr AS
(
    SELECT
        fecha_turno AS fecha,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN h.rotopala_id = 1
                THEN h.horas_operacion
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS horas_r1,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN h.rotopala_id = 2
                THEN h.horas_operacion
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS horas_r2,

        SUM(h.horas_operacion) AS horas_total,

        COUNT(DISTINCT h.turno) AS turnos_con_dato

    FROM [reclamo].[rotopala_horas_turno] h

    GROUP BY
        fecha_turno
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(cv.fecha, hr.fecha) AS fecha,

    cv.tmh_dia,
    cv.tms_dia,

    cv.tmh_cv025tot,
    cv.tmh_cv025_tot,

    cv.tag_utilizado,

    cv.flag AS flag_cv25,

    cv.tmh_cv025tot - cv.tmh_cv025_tot
        AS diferencia_entre_tags,

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Contraste de tags CV025
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN cv.tmh_cv025tot IS NULL
          OR cv.tmh_cv025_tot IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_CONTRASTE'

        WHEN cv.tmh_cv025_tot = 0
            THEN 'TAG_SECUNDARIO_CERO'

        WHEN
            ABS(cv.tmh_cv025tot - cv.tmh_cv025_tot)
            * 100.0 / cv.tmh_cv025_tot > 1
            THEN 'TAGS_DIFIEREN_SOBRE_1_PCT'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS flag_tags,

    hr.horas_r1,
    hr.horas_r2,
    hr.horas_total,
    hr.turnos_con_dato,

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- TMS estimado R1
    --
    -- Si CV025 = 0, no hubo operación:
    -- corresponde explícitamente 0 TMS.
    --
    -- Si CV025 > 0 pero no hay horas:
    -- no podemos repartir el tonelaje.
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(cv.tms_dia, 0) = 0
            THEN 0

        WHEN COALESCE(hr.horas_total, 0) = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            cv.tms_dia
            * hr.horas_r1
            / hr.horas_total
    END AS tms_estimado_r1,

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- TMS estimado R2
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(cv.tms_dia, 0) = 0
            THEN 0

        WHEN COALESCE(hr.horas_total, 0) = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            cv.tms_dia
            * hr.horas_r2
            / hr.horas_total
    END AS tms_estimado_r2,

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Estado del preliminar
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN cv.fecha IS NULL
            THEN 'SIN_CV25'

        WHEN COALESCE(cv.tms_dia, 0) = 0
            THEN 'CV25_CERO_SIN_OPERACION'

        WHEN COALESCE(hr.horas_total, 0) = 0
            THEN 'SIN_HORAS_NO_REPARTIBLE'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS flag_preliminar

FROM [reclamo].[cv25_diario] cv

FULL OUTER JOIN hr
    ON hr.fecha = cv.fecha;

name: v_bd_ton_t12_contingencia_opt_test
definition:
CREATE   VIEW
inventar_SpcHidr.v_bd_ton_t12_contingencia_opt_test
AS

WITH ton_intervalo AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha = CAST(r.Fecha AS date),

        Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TA =
            NULLIF
            (
                MAX
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN r.Torre = 'T1'
                         AND r.Turno = 'A'
                            THEN r.Ton_Real
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),

        Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TB =
            NULLIF
            (
                MAX
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN r.Torre = 'T1'
                         AND r.Turno = 'B'
                            THEN r.Ton_Real
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),

        Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TA =
            NULLIF
            (
                MAX
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN r.Torre = 'T2'
                         AND r.Turno = 'A'
                            THEN r.Ton_Real
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),

        Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TB =
            NULLIF
            (
                MAX
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN r.Torre = 'T2'
                         AND r.Turno = 'B'
                            THEN r.Ton_Real
                    END
                ),
                0
            )

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_reporte_diario_emulado_excel AS r
    WHERE r.Torre IN ('T1','T2')

    GROUP BY
        CAST(r.Fecha AS date)
),

/* ============================================================
   RESOLVER T1/T2

   La vista de resolver se referencia UNA sola vez.

   Luego se transforma:
       CV008 A -> TM1 TA
       CV008 B -> TM1 TB
       CV108 A -> TM2 TA
       CV108 B -> TM2 TB

   No cambia ninguna decisión PI/TUM.
   ============================================================ */
resolver_t12 AS
(
    SELECT
        r.fecha_operacional,

        /* FUENTE */
        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                 AND r.turno = 'A'
                    THEN r.fuente_resuelta
            END
        ) AS Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TA,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                 AND r.turno = 'B'
                    THEN r.fuente_resuelta
            END
        ) AS Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TB,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                 AND r.turno = 'A'
                    THEN r.fuente_resuelta
            END
        ) AS Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TA,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                 AND r.turno = 'B'
                    THEN r.fuente_resuelta
            END
        ) AS Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TB,

        /* TIPO TUM */
        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                 AND r.turno = 'A'
                    THEN r.tipo_tum
            END
        ) AS Tipo_TUM_TM1_TA,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                 AND r.turno = 'B'
                    THEN r.tipo_tum
            END
        ) AS Tipo_TUM_TM1_TB,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                 AND r.turno = 'A'
                    THEN r.tipo_tum
            END
        ) AS Tipo_TUM_TM2_TA,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                 AND r.turno = 'B'
                    THEN r.tipo_tum
            END
        ) AS Tipo_TUM_TM2_TB,

        /* VALOR FINAL DEL RESOLVER */
        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                 AND r.turno = 'A'
                    THEN r.valor_final_resuelto
            END
        ) AS Valor_Resolver_TM1_TA,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                 AND r.turno = 'B'
                    THEN r.valor_final_resuelto
            END
        ) AS Valor_Resolver_TM1_TB,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                 AND r.turno = 'A'
                    THEN r.valor_final_resuelto
            END
        ) AS Valor_Resolver_TM2_TA,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                 AND r.turno = 'B'
                    THEN r.valor_final_resuelto
            END
        ) AS Valor_Resolver_TM2_TB,

        /* MOTIVO */
        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                 AND r.turno = 'A'
                    THEN r.motivo_decision
            END
        ) AS Motivo_TM1_TA,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV008'
                 AND r.turno = 'B'
                    THEN r.motivo_decision
            END
        ) AS Motivo_TM1_TB,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                 AND r.turno = 'A'
                    THEN r.motivo_decision
            END
        ) AS Motivo_TM2_TA,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN r.equipo_codigo = 'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
                 AND r.turno = 'B'
                    THEN r.motivo_decision
            END
        ) AS Motivo_TM2_TB

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_totalizador_resuelto_turno_opt_test AS r

    WHERE r.equipo_codigo IN
    (
        'PRINCIPAL_CV008',
        'PRINCIPAL_CV108'
    )

    GROUP BY
        r.fecha_operacional
)

SELECT
    t.Fecha,

    /* ============================================================
       BASE ORIGINAL: intervalo real de muestreo
       ============================================================ */
    CAST(t.Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TA AS decimal(18,3))
        AS Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TA,

    CAST(t.Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TB AS decimal(18,3))
        AS Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TB,

    CAST(t.Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TA AS decimal(18,3))
        AS Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TA,

    CAST(t.Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TB AS decimal(18,3))
        AS Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TB,

    /* ============================================================
       PI OPERACIONAL
       ============================================================ */
    CAST(a.TMH_CV008_A AS decimal(18,3))
        AS TMH_PI_Operacional_TM1_TA,

    CAST(a.TMH_CV008_B AS decimal(18,3))
        AS TMH_PI_Operacional_TM1_TB,

    CAST(a.TMH_CV108_A AS decimal(18,3))
        AS TMH_PI_Operacional_TM2_TA,

    CAST(a.TMH_CV108_B AS decimal(18,3))
        AS TMH_PI_Operacional_TM2_TB,

    /* ============================================================
       RESOLVER
       ============================================================ */
    r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TA,
    r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TB,
    r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TA,
    r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TB,

    r.Tipo_TUM_TM1_TA,
    r.Tipo_TUM_TM1_TB,
    r.Tipo_TUM_TM2_TA,
    r.Tipo_TUM_TM2_TB,

    CAST(r.Valor_Resolver_TM1_TA AS decimal(18,3))
        AS Valor_Resolver_TM1_TA,

    CAST(r.Valor_Resolver_TM1_TB AS decimal(18,3))
        AS Valor_Resolver_TM1_TB,

    CAST(r.Valor_Resolver_TM2_TA AS decimal(18,3))
        AS Valor_Resolver_TM2_TA,

    CAST(r.Valor_Resolver_TM2_TB AS decimal(18,3))
        AS Valor_Resolver_TM2_TB,

    /* ============================================================
       TONELAJE FINAL BD TON

       HISTÓRICO:
           intervalo real

       >= 01-09:
           PI           -> intervalo real
           TUM > 0      -> turno TUM completo
           TUM = 0      -> NULL
           SIN_RESOLVER -> NULL
       ============================================================ */

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN t.Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN t.Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TA

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TA = 'PI'
                THEN t.Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TA

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TA = 'TUM'
             AND r.Valor_Resolver_TM1_TA > 0
                THEN r.Valor_Resolver_TM1_TA

            ELSE NULL
        END
        AS decimal(18,3)
    ) AS TMH_TM1_TA_Resuelto,

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN t.Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN t.Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TB

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TB = 'PI'
                THEN t.Ton_Intervalo_TM1_TB

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TB = 'TUM'
             AND r.Valor_Resolver_TM1_TB > 0
                THEN r.Valor_Resolver_TM1_TB

            ELSE NULL
        END
        AS decimal(18,3)
    ) AS TMH_TM1_TB_Resuelto,

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN t.Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN t.Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TA

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TA = 'PI'
                THEN t.Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TA

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TA = 'TUM'
             AND r.Valor_Resolver_TM2_TA > 0
                THEN r.Valor_Resolver_TM2_TA

            ELSE NULL
        END
        AS decimal(18,3)
    ) AS TMH_TM2_TA_Resuelto,

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN t.Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN t.Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TB

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TB = 'PI'
                THEN t.Ton_Intervalo_TM2_TB

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TB = 'TUM'
             AND r.Valor_Resolver_TM2_TB > 0
                THEN r.Valor_Resolver_TM2_TB

            ELSE NULL
        END
        AS decimal(18,3)
    ) AS TMH_TM2_TB_Resuelto,

    /* ============================================================
       EVALUABILIDAD INDIVIDUAL
       ============================================================ */

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN t.Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_A,0) > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TA = 'PI'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_A,0) > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TA = 'TUM'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN r.Valor_Resolver_TM1_TA > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            ELSE 0
        END
        AS tinyint
    ) AS Evaluable_TM1_TA_Resuelto,

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN t.Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_B,0) > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TB = 'PI'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV008_B,0) > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM1_TB = 'TUM'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN r.Valor_Resolver_TM1_TB > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            ELSE 0
        END
        AS tinyint
    ) AS Evaluable_TM1_TB_Resuelto,

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN t.Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_A,0) > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TA = 'PI'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_A,0) > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TA = 'TUM'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN r.Valor_Resolver_TM2_TA > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            ELSE 0
        END
        AS tinyint
    ) AS Evaluable_TM2_TA_Resuelto,

    CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN t.Fecha < '2026-09-01'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_B,0) > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TB = 'PI'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.TMH_CV108_B,0) > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            WHEN r.Fuente_Resolver_TM2_TB = 'TUM'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN r.Valor_Resolver_TM2_TB > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            ELSE 0
        END
        AS tinyint
    ) AS Evaluable_TM2_TB_Resuelto,

    /* ============================================================
       TRAZABILIDAD
       ============================================================ */
    r.Motivo_TM1_TA,
    r.Motivo_TM1_TB,
    r.Motivo_TM2_TA,
    r.Motivo_TM2_TB

FROM ton_intervalo AS t

LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_datos_apilado_tmh_v2 AS a
    ON a.Fecha = t.Fecha

LEFT JOIN resolver_t12 AS r
    ON r.fecha_operacional = t.Fecha;

name: v_preliminar_cv25
definition:
CREATE VIEW [reclamo].[v_preliminar_cv25]
AS

WITH abiertos AS
(
    SELECT
        mb.[campaña_id],
        mb.pad_id,
        mb.modulo_id,
        mb.modulo_numero,
        mb.rotopala_id,
        mb.orden_secuencia,
        mb.m3_totales,
        mb.densidad_oficial,
        mb.fecha_apertura,
        mb.fecha_cierre,

        (
            SELECT MAX(ta.fecha_medicion)
            FROM [reclamo].[topografia_avance] ta
            WHERE ta.[campaña_id] = mb.[campaña_id]
              AND ta.modulo_id = mb.modulo_id
              AND ta.estado = 'VIGENTE'
        ) AS ultima_medicion_topografica

    FROM [reclamo].[v_modulo_base] mb

    WHERE mb.estado_secuencia = 'ABIERTO'
      AND mb.rotopala_id IS NOT NULL
),

cv AS
(
    SELECT
        d.fecha,
        d.tms_estimado_r1,
        d.tms_estimado_r2,
        d.horas_r1,
        d.horas_r2,
        d.flag_preliminar

    FROM [reclamo].[v_cv25_diario] d

    -- Solo días operacionales ya cerrados.
    -- El día actual no se publica como preliminar.
    WHERE d.fecha < CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS date)
),

base AS
(
    SELECT
        cv.fecha,
        a.[campaña_id],
        a.pad_id,
        a.modulo_id,
        a.modulo_numero,
        a.rotopala_id,
        a.m3_totales,
        a.densidad_oficial,
        a.ultima_medicion_topografica,

        CASE
            WHEN a.rotopala_id = 1
                THEN cv.tms_estimado_r1
            ELSE cv.tms_estimado_r2
        END AS tms_rotopala_dia_total,

        CASE
            WHEN a.rotopala_id = 1
                THEN cv.horas_r1
            ELSE cv.horas_r2
        END AS horas_rotopala,

        cv.flag_preliminar,

        COUNT(*) OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY cv.fecha, a.rotopala_id
        ) AS modulos_abiertos

    FROM cv

    CROSS JOIN abiertos a

    WHERE
        (
            a.fecha_apertura IS NULL
            OR cv.fecha >= a.fecha_apertura
        )

        AND
        (
            a.fecha_cierre IS NULL
            OR cv.fecha <= a.fecha_cierre
        )

        AND
        (
            a.ultima_medicion_topografica IS NULL
            OR cv.fecha > a.ultima_medicion_topografica
        )
),

con_acumulado AS
(
    SELECT
        b.fecha AS fecha_operacion,
        b.[campaña_id],
        b.pad_id,
        b.modulo_id,
        b.modulo_numero,
        b.rotopala_id,
        b.horas_rotopala,
        b.modulos_abiertos,
        b.m3_totales,
        b.densidad_oficial,

        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- DIARIO
        --------------------------------------------------------
        CAST
        (
            b.tms_rotopala_dia_total / b.modulos_abiertos
            AS decimal(30,12)
        ) AS tms_preliminar_dia,

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN b.densidad_oficial = 0
                    THEN NULL
                ELSE
                    (
                        b.tms_rotopala_dia_total
                        / b.modulos_abiertos
                    )
                    / b.densidad_oficial
            END
            AS decimal(30,12)
        ) AS m3_preliminar_dia,

        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- ACUMULADO TMS
        --------------------------------------------------------
        SUM
        (
            CAST
            (
                b.tms_rotopala_dia_total / b.modulos_abiertos
                AS decimal(30,12)
            )
        )
        OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY
                b.[campaña_id],
                b.modulo_id

            ORDER BY b.fecha

            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS tms_preliminar_acum,

        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- ACUMULADO M3
        --------------------------------------------------------
        SUM
        (
            CAST
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN b.densidad_oficial = 0
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE
                        (
                            b.tms_rotopala_dia_total
                            / b.modulos_abiertos
                        )
                        / b.densidad_oficial
                END
                AS decimal(30,12)
            )
        )
        OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY
                b.[campaña_id],
                b.modulo_id

            ORDER BY b.fecha

            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS m3_preliminar_acum,

        CAST(
            'PRELIMINAR_CV25'
            AS varchar(40)
        ) AS fuente_reclamo,

        CAST(
            'CV25_REPARTIDO_POR_HORAS_ROTOPALA'
            AS varchar(80)
        ) AS metodo_calculo,

        b.flag_preliminar

    FROM base b

    WHERE b.tms_rotopala_dia_total IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    ca.fecha_operacion,
    ca.[campaña_id],
    ca.pad_id,
    ca.modulo_id,
    ca.modulo_numero,
    ca.rotopala_id,
    ca.horas_rotopala,
    ca.modulos_abiertos,

    ca.tms_preliminar_dia,
    ca.m3_preliminar_dia,

    ca.tms_preliminar_acum,
    ca.m3_preliminar_acum,

    CASE
        WHEN ca.m3_totales = 0
            THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST
        (
            ca.m3_preliminar_acum / ca.m3_totales
            AS float
        )
    END AS avance_preliminar_pct_total,

    ca.fuente_reclamo,
    ca.metodo_calculo,
    ca.flag_preliminar

FROM con_acumulado ca;

name: v_ajustes_aplicables
definition:
/* ============================================================================
   V6. reclamo.v_ajustes_aplicables

   Regla R10. Solo los ajustes APROBADOS afectan el calculo. Los PROPUESTOS
   quedan visibles en el dashboard pero con delta cero.

   TRASPASO_MODULO genera DOS efectos: descuenta del modulo origen y abona al
   modulo destino. Por eso la vista devuelve dos filas por ajuste de ese tipo.
   ============================================================================ */
CREATE   VIEW [reclamo].[v_ajustes_aplicables]
AS
SELECT
    a.fecha_operacion,
    a.[campaña_id],
    a.pad_id,
    a.modulo_id,
    a.tipo_ajuste,
    a.delta_m3,
    a.delta_tms,
    a.motivo,
    a.antecedente_tipo,
    a.antecedente_ref,
    a.usuario_solicita,
    a.usuario_aprueba,
    a.fecha_aprobacion,
    a.ajuste_id,
    CAST('ORIGEN' AS varchar(10))           AS rol_en_ajuste
FROM [reclamo].[ajuste_manual] a
WHERE a.estado = 'APROBADO'

UNION ALL

/* Contrapartida del traspaso: lo que sale del origen entra al destino. */
SELECT
    a.fecha_operacion,
    a.[campaña_id],
    a.pad_id,
    a.modulo_destino_id                     AS modulo_id,
    a.tipo_ajuste,
    -a.delta_m3                             AS delta_m3,
    -a.delta_tms                            AS delta_tms,
    a.motivo,
    a.antecedente_tipo,
    a.antecedente_ref,
    a.usuario_solicita,
    a.usuario_aprueba,
    a.fecha_aprobacion,
    a.ajuste_id,
    CAST('DESTINO' AS varchar(10))          AS rol_en_ajuste
FROM [reclamo].[ajuste_manual] a
WHERE a.estado = 'APROBADO'
  AND a.tipo_ajuste = 'TRASPASO_MODULO'
  AND a.modulo_destino_id IS NOT NULL;
